articles.titleEn: Fundmark Report 最新号（2026年10月号）
summaryLinesEn: 「Fundmark」は、国内で販売されている追加型投資信託の運用実績を用いて、各商品ごとにパフォーマンスの比較・評価を行っています。
そこで、NRIでは、独自の調査に基づき、運用方針や運用実態に沿って投資信託の分類 （Fundmark分類：約300分類）を行っています。
同一分類内において、投資信託のパフォーマンスを相対的に評価し、順位（ランキング）や☆印による5段階の評価（レーティング）を発表しています。

Fundmark Report 最新号（2026年10月号）を掲載しました。 詳細はこちらのPDFをご覧ください。

「Fundmark」は、国内で販売されている追加型投資信託の運用実績を用いて、各商品ごとにパフォーマンスの比較・評価を行っています。それぞれ運用方針の異なる投資信託には、多くの異なる要素が存在し、横並びで比較・評価を行うことは容易ではありません。 そこで、NRIでは、独自の調査に基づき、運用方針や運用実態に沿って投資信託の分類 （Fundmark分類：約300分類）を行っています。同一分類内において、投資信託のパフォーマンスを相対的に評価し、順位（ランキング）や☆印による5段階の評価（レーティング）を発表しています。 Fundmark Report最新号の本サイト掲載日は、毎月第９営業日です。（営業日は、土日祝日を除いた日を指します）
本コンテンツの一部または全部を、いかなる目的であれ、電子的、機械的、光学的、その他のいかなる手段によっても、弊社の書面による同意なしに、無断で複製・改変・転載または翻訳することは法律で禁じられています。

articles.title: Anthropic study warns that small AI models could soon replicate across everyday devices
articles.descEn: Small AI models may be just months away from spreading on their own across poorly secured consumer devices like smart TVs and robot vacuums, according to a new Anthropic study. In tests, one model already completed the full infection chain. CEO Dario Amodei has warned that a swarm like this could take over the entire internet with a persistent botnet within 6 to 12 months, causing hundreds of billions of dollars in damage.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic study warns that small AI models could soon replicate across everyday devices
summaryLinesEn: Anthropic researchers tested whether small language models could spread on their own across poorly secured consumer devices like smart TVs or connected home appliances and set themselves up on unfamiliar hardware.
A model needs to be small enough to run on consumer devices and capable enough to replicate itself, and no model currently meets both requirements.
In tests using off-the-shelf $55 TV boxes, the GLM-5.2 model already completed the full replication chain across all eight test nodes.

summaryLinesEn: Last week saw shares of Nvidia, CoreWeave Inc., Oracle Corp. and Nebius Group N.V. decline amid reports that OpenAI’s annualized net revenue was approximately $50 billion, roughly $20 billion below previously reported figures.

On theCUBE Pod: AI doubters get loud, and IBM seeks competitive advantage
Americans have big concerns about artificial intelligence , but that hasn’t stopped OpenAI Inc., Nvidia Corp., IBM Corp. and others from charging ahead.

Last week saw shares of Nvidia, CoreWeave Inc., Oracle Corp. and Nebius Group N.V. decline amid reports that OpenAI’s annualized net revenue was approximately $50 billion, roughly $20 billion below previously reported figures. Despite the ongoing public pushback against AI, John Furrier (pictured, right), research executive analyst at theCUBE Research, sees the uproar as temporary.

Munich-based Spranic is building a spatial memory layer that records physical spaces and how they change.
Physical AI needs context about its surroundings to adapt beyond a fixed set of instructions.

Munich-based Spranic is building a spatial memory layer that records physical spaces and how they change. Connecting that information with knowledge graphs could help robots interpret their environments across different tasks, according to Jordi Spranger (pictured), founder and chief executive officer of Spranic.

“Robots deserve the right context at the right time across domains,” he said. “This is the problem we’re tackling. We can see that this works really well for digital agents already. Now we’re bringing this to the physical world.”

sourceContent.headline: Some older Apple TV models are also getting Siri AI - Engadget
sourceContent.description: Siri AI functionality goes all the way back to back to the second-gen Apple TV 4K box from 2021.
paragraphs: Engadget has reached out to Apple to ask for some clarification here regarding the feature set.
This looks like a nifty bit of kit, but not everyone has $300 to spend on an updated streaming device.
Luckily, the company also revealed that Siri AI would work with several older Apple TV 4K models , which is a nice surprise.
Functionality goes all the way back to back to the second-gen 4K box from 2021.

Apple just announced a brand new Apple TV 4K streaming box that was designed to accommodate Siri AI. This looks like a nifty bit of kit, but not everyone has $300 to spend on an updated streaming device. Luckily, the company also revealed that Siri AI would work with several older Apple TV 4K models , which is a nice surprise.

Siri AI will be available as beta software in units going all the way back to the second-gen Apple TV 4K, which was released in 2021 . It'll be part of tvOS 27.2, which arrives this fall. We don't have an exact date just yet, but the new Apple TV 4K comes out on November 13, so it'll be on or before that.

summaryLinesEn: In the US, Google AI Pro costs $20 a month, while the Ultra tier costs at least $100.

sourceContent.headline: Wikipedians Believed AI Would Come and Go. They Were Wrong
sourceContent.description: In a world of AI Overviews, Wikipedia usage declines. But the real loss may be far more existential than website traffic.
paragraphs: Already in 2018 Google was training AI to write “Wikipedia-like articles,” and by October 2024, a Princeton University study found that about 5 percent of nearly 3,000 newly created articles on English Wikipedia in a single month (August 2024) contained a substantial amount of AI-generated content.

He was a nostalgic, Orwell thought, a “nineteenth-century liberal” who had spent 40 years repeating the same idea: that history was a battle between “the man of science who is working towards a planned World State” and “the reactionary who is trying to restore a disorderly past.”
If Wikipedia itself becomes corrupted by artificial intelligence, by what means will we prove when they are wrong?

Long before the storm of AI struck Wikipedia , the Wikimedia Foundation was making preparations. Wikipedians battened down the hatches and made confident-sounding predictions that it would break and wash over them. Large language models might even improve Wikipedia, it was said, automating more of the housekeeping—formatting, sources, citations, missing links—and so freeing up humans to do creative work. It was not so simple. In 2019, then-Wikimedia Foundation head Katherine Maher wrote an op-ed in The New York Times under the headline “ Without Humans, A.I. Can Wreak Havoc .” “Too often,” she wrote, “artificial intelligence is presented as an all-powerful solution to our problems, a scalable replacement for people.” The issue confronting Wikipedia, retaining human control over machines, was the same one soon being faced everywhere.

Already in 2018 Google was training AI to write “Wikipedia-like articles,” and by October 2024, a Princeton University study found that about 5 percent of nearly 3,000 newly created articles on English Wikipedia in a single month (August 2024) contained a substantial amount of AI-generated content. There were signs. ChatGPT was fond of em dashes—parenthetical statements that look like this one—and curly quotation marks. Sometimes, residues from the prompts used to compose articles were left behind (“Here is your Wikipedia article,” they might say.)

At first, Wikipedians tried to shape and control AI, to make its output “acceptable and constructive,” or to fix or remove if it proved otherwise. Generic fluff like “praising a village for its fertile farmlands, livestock, and scenic countryside” and fake sources were weeded out. By March 2026, AI content was found to violate its core principles so often that writing with large language models was banned outright, and their role restricted to translation and minor proofreading.

articles.title: Western mathematicians fear AI makes them dumber while China builds an entire alliance for it
articles.descEn: While 25 Fields Medal winners in the West warn against AI-generated proofs and parts of the community call for a boycott, China is going on the offensive. Fields Medal winner Shing-Tung Yau has launched an alliance of eight institutions and over 1,000 scientists to push AI into math research.
articles.titleEn: Western mathematicians fear AI makes them dumber while China builds an entire alliance for it
summaryLinesEn: As Western mathematicians push back against AI, China is doubling down.
Fields Medal winner Shing-Tung Yau and a group of leading Chinese mathematicians launched an alliance on Sunday in Beijing to push AI into math research.
The "Yau Laboratory Alliance for Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence" unites eight institutions and aims to build a network of over 1,000 researchers, the South China Morning Post reports.

paragraphs: As Western mathematicians push back against AI, China is doubling down.

As Western mathematicians push back against AI, China is doubling down. Fields Medal winner Shing-Tung Yau and a group of leading Chinese mathematicians launched an alliance on Sunday in Beijing to push AI into math research. The "Yau Laboratory Alliance for Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence" unites eight institutions and aims to build a network of over 1,000 researchers, the South China Morning Post reports. Yau warned that China is falling behind the US.

In the West, skepticism dominates. Twenty-five Fields Medal winners, including Terence Tao and Peter Scholze, worry that AI-generated proofs erode mathematical understanding and make researchers dependent on tools they can't follow. Parts of the community are calling for a boycott of AI-generated proofs, while others say they're shocked by the sheer volume of automated submissions. China, meanwhile, wants to build specialized models, develop machine-verifiable proofs, and create transparent AI reasoning.
Even among experts who use AI, there's no consensus on whether it produces genuine mathematical insight or just brute-forces its way through known methods, or if that distinction even matters. Ad Ad

articles.title: Actress Mia Goth says it’s ‘incomprehensible’ that Instagram allowed an AI image of her to spread
articles.descEn: A viral photo purporting to show Mia Goth in a T-shirt seemingly referencing her divorce spread from Instagram across the web. It was AI.
articles.titleEn: Actress Mia Goth says it’s ‘incomprehensible’ that Instagram allowed an AI image of her to spread
summaryLinesEn: In 2024, Scarlett Johansson said that OpenAI had used a soundalike for the voice of ChatGPT even after she declined to work with the company on the project.
Photorealistic AI videos of people, for example, may require an AI label — but Meta’s own rules include a carve-out that the label is not required for still images.

AI-generated content featuring real people, including public figures, regularly racks up millions of views on Instagram, and Meta executives have signaled that AI-generated content will be a key part of how users engage on the company’s platforms going forward.

articles.title: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
articles.descEn: Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.
articles.titleEn: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
summaryLinesEn: So he left SpaceX and co-founded Satlyt , a new company with headquarters in Sunnyvale, California, and Nairobi, to build software for satellites that he hopes will let many satellites share the work of large computing jobs in space.
“It can just be driven by the number of satellites going up.”

SpaceX has since gone all-in on orbital data centers, and Satlyt’s software is set to launch Thursday on a SpaceX rocket alongside the first prototype for Google’s space data center effort, Project Suncatcher.

The way Rama Afullo tells it, he saw orbital data centers coming.

The Kenyan American engineer previously worked in Google’s cloud computing business before a brief stint at SpaceX’s Starlink communications network in 2024. His experiences convinced him that there was untapped potential for computers in space.

articles.title: The “alien” economics of AI monetization
articles.descEn: Leaders at Monetize 2026 shared the biggest shifts reshaping AI monetization, from hybrid pricing and stronger spend controls to flexible packaging, outcome-focused finance, and pricing built for human and AI buyers.
articles.titleEn: The “alien” economics of AI monetization
summaryLinesEn: Without accessible pricing for this organization, LLMs resorted to scouring informal sources like Reddit and reported back prices ranging from $100–$2,400 per user, per month, a 24x difference.
Companies can combine subscriptions and usage-based billing, then adjust the mix as the underlying economics shift.
As inference costs fell—due in part to increasingly capable open-source models and the pressure they put on frontier-model prices—Replit introduced a rate-limited Free Mode.

sourceContent.headline: The “alien” economics of AI monetization
sourceContent.description: Leaders at Monetize 2026 shared the biggest shifts reshaping AI monetization, from hybrid pricing and stronger spend controls to flexible packaging, outcome-focused finance, and pricing built for human and AI buyers.
paragraphs: Without accessible pricing for this organization, LLMs resorted to scouring informal sources like Reddit and reported back prices ranging from $100–$2,400 per user, per month, a 24x difference.
Companies can combine subscriptions and usage-based billing, then adjust the mix as the underlying economics shift.
As inference costs fell—due in part to increasingly capable open-source models and the pressure they put on frontier-model prices—Replit introduced a rate-limited Free Mode.

Two-thirds of the companies on the Forbes AI 50 list now use some form of usage-based pricing, reflecting AI’s variable costs and unpredictable demand. At the second annual Monetize conference last month, Metronome CEO and Cofounder Scott Woody put it more bluntly: today’s leading companies operate in ways that would seem “alien” to traditional SaaS businesses. These companies are iterating much faster on pricing, prioritizing market share over ARR, and pursuing multiple go-to-market strategies at once.

More than 300 leaders from fast-moving companies like Replit , Fin , Snowflake , and Clay came together at Monetize to trade notes on pricing, cost management, and scaling AI products as customer expectations change. sourceContent.text:
Without accessible pricing for this organization, LLMs resorted to scouring informal sources like Reddit and reported back prices ranging from $100–$2,400 per user, per month, a 24x difference.

Companies can combine subscriptions and usage-based billing, then adjust the mix as the underlying economics shift.

As inference costs fell—due in part to increasingly capable open-source models and the pressure they put on frontier-model prices—Replit introduced a rate-limited Free Mode.

articles.title: Non-custodial wallets' growing prevalence calls for investor protection
articles.titleEn: Non-custodial wallets' growing prevalence calls for investor protection
summaryLinesEn: However, with NCWs likely to gain prevalence as their UIs continue to get userfriendlier, the current absence of investor protection for NCW users is a concern.
Trading cryptoassets using a non-custodial (aka self-custody) wallet is currently outside the purview of Japan’s crypto regulations.
Japan would be well advised to look more deeply into providing such protection instead of leaving NCW users to fend for themselves.

articles.title: Combating Digital Crime in the Age of Generative AI
articles.titleEn: Combating Digital Crime in the Age of Generative AI
summaryLinesEn: Online services now require multilayer defenses encompassing security precautions designed into the services from the outset, dynamic anomaly detection and cyber business continuity planning to ensure resilience against emerging threats.
Sophisticated forgeries are increasingly being used to bypass eKYC authentication processes, while phishing sites can now be created and deployed at unprecedented speed and scale.
As a result, organizations must strengthen defenses against the exploitation of vulnerabilities and loopholes in system specifications.

localization.title: 생성 AI 시대의 디지털 범죄 퇴치
summaryLines: 이제 온라인 서비스에는 새로운 위협에 대한 복원력을 보장하기 위해 처음부터 서비스에 설계된 보안 예방 조치, 동적 이상 탐지 및 사이버 비즈니스 연속성 계획을 포괄하는 다층 방어가 필요함
eKYC 인증 프로세스를 우회하기 위해 정교한 위조가 점점 더 많이 사용되고 있으며, 이제 피싱 사이트는 전례 없는 속도와 규모로 생성 및 배포될 수 있음
결과적으로 조직은 시스템 사양의 취약점과 허점 악용에 대한 방어를 강화해야 함

localization.title: 발효 개요 · 시장 잠재력 및 사업 기회 확대
summaryLines: 이러한 분야는 급속한 성장을 경험할 것으로 예상되므로 시장 잠재력을 평가하고 비즈니스 기회를 식별하는 방법을 이해하는 것이 전체 발효 산업을 평가하는 데 점점 더 중요해지고 있음
동시에, 장 건강에 대한 관심이 높아짐에 따라 프로바이오틱스에 대한 수요가 가속화되었으며, 살아있는 유익 미생물을 함유한 요구르트와 같은 유제품이 시장 성장을 계속 뒷받침할 것으로 예상됨
또한 발효 시장의 주요 추세를 조사하고, 중요한 시장 발전을 강조하고, 발효가 사회적 과제를 해결하는 데 어떻게 도움이 될 수 있는지 탐구하고, 발효로 인해 발생하는 비즈니스 기회와 향후 계획에 대한 권장 사항에 대해 논의함

articles.title: Intent governance in the agentic AI age
articles.titleEn: Intent governance in the agentic AI age
summaryLinesEn: The intent data generated through AI agent interactions will become a valuable strategic asset.
AI agents are set to go live in the financial sector but existing authentication, authorization and auditing functions are not designed for autonomous AI.
As a result, financial institutions may face risks arising from misalignment between a human user's intended objectives and an AI agent's actions.

articles.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
articles.descEn: In early results from our new life sciences research lab, Claude agents found an enzyme system whose function is still unknown.
articles.titleEn: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
summaryLinesEn: After 21 hours spent searching this data by roughly 950 agents using 210 million tokens, one of the agents spotted something remarkable: a repeating pattern of DNA sequences that occurs next to the gene for an odd-looking RT.

Our research prior to joining Anthropic has helped to better understand the evolution and regulation of CRISPR systems, discover new enzymes for next-generation cell and gene therapies , and build tools for accelerating the identification of anomalies in DNA, such as human pathogenic variants.
We do research that involves only the lower levels of the biosafety risk level (BSL-1 and BSL-2) and we do not handle pathogens that can infect humans.

localization.title: 클로드가 새로운 효소 시스템을 발견하
summaryLines: 약 950명의 에이전트가 2억 1천만 개의 토큰을 사용하여 이 데이터를 검색한 후 21시간 동안 에이전트 중 한 명이 주목할만한 사실을 발견함 · 이상하게 보이는 RT의 유전자 옆에서 발생하는 DNA 서열의 반복 패턴이었음
Anthropic에 합류하기 전 우리의 연구는 CRISPR 시스템의 진화와 규제를 더 잘 이해하고, 차세대 세포 및 유전자 치료를 위한 새로운 효소를 발견하고, 인간 병원성 변종과 같은 DNA의 변칙적 식별을 가속화하기 위한 도구를 구축하는 데 도움이 됨
우리는 낮은 수준의 생물안전 위험 수준(BSL-1 및 BSL-2)만을 포함하는 연구를 수행하며 인간을 감염시킬 수 있는 병원체는 취급하지 않음

Anthropic에 합류하기 전 우리의 연구는 CRISPR 시스템의 진화와 규제를 더 잘 이해하고, 차세대 세포 및 유전자 치료를 위한 새로운 효소를 발견하고, 인간 병원성 변종과 같은 DNA의 변칙적 식별을 가속화하기 위한 도구를 구축하는 데 도움이 됨
우리는 낮은 수준의 생물안전 위험 수준(BSL-1 및 BSL-2)만을 포함하는 연구를 수행하며 인간을 감염시킬 수 있는 병원체는 취급하지 않음

articles.title: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter
articles.descEn: Small AI models may be only months away from being able to self-replicate across cheap IoT devices like Android TV boxes, with no datacenter needed.
articles.titleEn: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter
summaryLinesEn: Small models, such as Qwen3.5-9B, are capable of setting up inference servers on hardware from Jetson Nanos to Mac PCs and RTX 4090s.
Larger models tend to have correspondingly better cyber capabilities, but will also need to breach (relatively) hardened datacenters to run themselves.
We run Gemma4-26B-A4B, distributed over 15 inexpensive off-brand Android TV boxes (~$55 each) that we bought and networked together, at 0.39 tokens per second.

summaryLines: Qwen3.5-9B와 같은 소형 모델은 Jetson Nanos에서 Mac PC 및 RTX 4090에 이르는 하드웨어에 추론 서버를 설정할 수 있음
더 큰 모델은 이에 상응하여 더 나은 사이버 기능을 갖는 경향이 있지만 자체적으로 실행하려면 (상대적으로) 강화된 데이터 센터를 침해해야 함

articles.title: From Earth to Orbit, France’s Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA
articles.descEn: French companies are putting NVIDIA infrastructure and open models to work across all industries, from satellites in orbit to cosmetics in corner stores.
articles.titleEn: From Earth to Orbit, France’s Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA
summaryLinesEn: In Côte-d’Or, ThinkDeep and Akila built a digital-twin agent — powered by NVIDIA Cosmos open world models, Nemotron and Omniverse libraries — managing nearly 5,800 kilometers of roads and buildings, cutting total operating costs by 10% and targeting 30% as deployment progresses.
Altair-1, the first satellite in a $1 billion, 50-satellite constellation with on-board autonomous capabilities, launched this month and has successfully reached orbit.
Fondation Inria , with NVIDIA’s support, is launching a working group on open source advanced modeling and tool adoption, with findings to come in the spring of next year.

summaryLines: 코트도르에서 ThinkDeep과 Akila는 NVIDIA Cosmos 오픈 월드 모델, Nemotron 및 Omniverse 라이브러리를 기반으로 하는 디지털 트윈 에이전트를 구축하여 거의 5,800km에 달하는 도로와 건물을 관리하고 총 운영 비용을 10% 절감했으며 배포가 진행됨에 따라 30%를 목표로 삼았음
탑재된 자율 기능을 갖춘 10억 달러 규모의 50개 위성 집합 중 첫 번째 위성인 Altair-1이 이번 달에 발사되어 성공적으로 궤도에 도달함
Fondation Inria는 NVIDIA의 지원을 받아 오픈 소스 고급 모델링 및 도구 채택에 관한 실무 그룹을 출범할 예정이며, 결과는 내년 봄에 나올 예정임

articles.title: How Arm is helping developers build local AI systems for the intelligent edge
articles.descEn: Developers are building more multimodal, agentic AI at the edge, where local processing can improve responsiveness, privacy, efficiency, and resilience across intelligent systems.
articles.titleEn: How Arm is helping developers build local AI systems for the intelligent edge
summaryLinesEn: Developers can discover pre-optimized models, evaluate performance and accuracy for specific Arm-based targets, and assess trade-offs such as model size, target platforms, quality, and expected performance.
We can already see this shift in what edge developers are building on Arm.

Developers need consistent paths across heterogeneous systems, with the flexibility to select models, frameworks, precision, and compute resources for each workload across cloud, edge, and physical devices.

articles.title: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark
articles.descEn: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt, NVIDIA PAIR and NVIDIA Broadcast 2.3 adding to the thousands of apps, games and models ready for RTX Spark launch on Friday, Oct. 16.
articles.titleEn: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark
summaryLinesEn: With up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute, RTX Spark delivers the full stack of NVIDIA RTX and CUDA technologies for creators, developers and gamers, while unlocking a new paradigm in personal computing via powerful local AI agents.
Local large language models (LLMs) surpassed the intelligence threshold to power agents, with models like Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next catching up to frontier cloud models released just a few months ago.

NVIDIA Switchyard, an open source model router library, enables agents to intelligently route queries between local and cloud LLMs, allowing the user to minimize cloud usage but still obtain similar results to just running on cloud.

sourceContent.headline: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark
sourceContent.description: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt, NVIDIA PAIR and NVIDIA Broadcast 2.3 adding to the thousands of apps, games and models ready for RTX Spark launch on Friday, Oct. 16.
paragraphs: With up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute, RTX Spark delivers the full stack of NVIDIA RTX and CUDA technologies for creators, developers and gamers, while unlocking a new paradigm in personal computing via powerful local AI agents.
Local large language models (LLMs) surpassed the intelligence threshold to power agents, with models like Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next catching up to frontier cloud models released just a few months ago.

NVIDIA Switchyard, an open source model router library, enables agents to intelligently route queries between local and cloud LLMs, allowing the user to minimize cloud usage but still obtain similar results to just running on cloud.

NVIDIA RTX Spark is a new beginning for the PC — a reinvention combining the capabilities of a gaming PC, a creative studio and a personal AI supercomputer into a single superchip. With up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute, RTX Spark delivers the full stack of NVIDIA RTX and CUDA technologies for creators, developers and gamers, while unlocking a new paradigm in personal computing via powerful local AI agents.

Last week, NVIDIA and Microsoft announced that RTX Spark laptops will be available on Friday, Oct. 16 . Ahead of the launch, NVIDIA and its ecosystem partners are rolling out new software features and performance optimizations to expand what’s possible with local AI on RTX Spark.
New and upcoming RTX Spark updates — among the thousands of apps, games and models available at launch — include:
sourceContent.text:

Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a sparsely-activated architecture that scales large language model (LLM) capacity while keeping per-token compute low. Because its operations account for a large share of total compute time, inefficiencies there directly raise request latency and cost. Therefore, optimizing MoE operations through kernel engineering offers the largest opportunity for performance gains.

Fused MoE is a key optimization technique for the MoE architecture. A fused MoE system merges token routing, data shuffling, and specialized network calculations into a single batched operation on the GPU. This replaces executing those routing and expert computations as separate, sequential loop operations. While this provides latency advantages, it also brings complexity in kernel implementations and debugging capability. High GPU utilization for this architecture requires hardware-specific optimizations.

In this post, we describe the different kernel optimizations we implemented for fused MoE models and show you how you can benefit from this work. We used a representative MoE model as our primary example.

articles.title: Scaling trust in confidential AI requires a common language
articles.descEn: Arm and Fujitsu explore how CoServe, IETF RATS and Veraison can help standardize attestation across increasingly heterogeneous confidential AI systems.
articles.titleEn: Scaling trust in confidential AI requires a common language
summaryLinesEn: And for the wider ecosystem, it provides something equally important: a common language through which different parts of an increasingly diverse computing supply chain can participate in trust.
These factors create a scaling problem the industry needs to address.

CoSERV is an adopted work item within the IETF RATS working group designed to provide a common conveyance mechanism through which verifiers can obtain endorsements and reference values from potentially complex supply-chain sources.

sourceContent.headline: Scaling trust in confidential AI requires a common language
sourceContent.description: Arm and Fujitsu explore how CoServe, IETF RATS and Veraison can help standardize attestation across increasingly heterogeneous confidential AI systems.
paragraphs: And for the wider ecosystem, it provides something equally important: a common language through which different parts of an increasingly diverse computing supply chain can participate in trust.
These factors create a scaling problem the industry needs to address.

CoSERV is an adopted work item within the IETF RATS working group designed to provide a common conveyance mechanism through which verifiers can obtain endorsements and reference values from potentially complex supply-chain sources.
Confidential computing changes an important assumption about how trust works in modern infrastructure.

Traditionally, attestation has largely been an internal concern for infrastructure providers. Within a data center, operators can use attestation to check the integrity of servers and determine whether services should be allowed to run or connect to other resources. These trust decisions are important, but they generally remain inside the boundaries of the infrastructure being managed.

AI systems increasingly bring together CPUs, GPUs and other accelerators, firmware, software and services from multiple suppliers. At the same time, more parties have a stake in whether those systems can be trusted. Model providers want assurance that valuable models will run only in appropriately protected environments. Users want confidence that their data remains protected while it is being processed. And infrastructure providers still need to verify the integrity of the underlying platform.

paragraphs: For production use, we recommend generating a short-term bearer token from your existing AWS credentials, so authentication stays tied to your IAM identity and no long-lived secret is stored: Reasoning tokens count as output tokens and draw down max_completion_tokens before the answer text is produced, so size the limit to leave room for both.

In this post, we build a tool-calling agent on Grok 4.7 and evaluate it on three tasks that require search rather than lookup.

SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 is now available on Amazon Bedrock, which offers a choice of foundation models (FMs) from multiple providers. According to SpaceXAI, Grok 4.7 is trained to work longer on more difficult tasks and knows when to check its own work. That matters most for agents, which carry a task through many steps and must verify what they find along the way.

An agent that works this way has to do more than look things up. It has to form a candidate answer, check it against what it has learned, and refine it until it fits. Grok 4.7 exposes a reasoning effort setting that controls how much deliberation happens before each response, and for agent workloads a practical question is which level to run.

In this post, we build a tool-calling agent on Grok 4.7 and evaluate it on three tasks that require search rather than lookup. The tasks are diagnosing a two-service outage from its alerts, scheduling maintenance under interacting constraints, and choosing an optimal set of migrations under a budget. Each task has exactly one correct answer, verified by brute force. We ran all three at every reasoning effort level, six times each, for 72 agent runs.

Your AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) identity needs bedrock:InvokeModel on both the inference profile and your account’s default project: arn:aws:bedrock:{region}::inference-profile/us.xai.grok-4.7 or the global. equivalent. arn:aws:bedrock:{region}:{account-id}:project/default .
In this post, we build a tool-calling agent on Grok 4.7 and evaluate it on three tasks that require search rather than lookup.

articles.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
articles.descEn: We’re giving developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers access to Gemini 4 Argon, our latest frontier model.
articles.titleEn: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
summaryLinesEn: Using Argon in Antigravity, our researchers made xTB up to 2.3x faster at predicting molecular structures and 1.8x faster at conformer search.

Making our open Gemma models nearly three times as fast: Using Argon, we achieved a 2.85x end-to-end inference speedup on an A100 via vLLM (accelerating throughput from ~37,900 to over 108,000 tokens per second on Gemma 4 E2B) with 100% token parity and zero quality drop in just a few days, a process that would usually take months.

Transforming critical business and professional workflows Accelerating real-world impact with researchers and domain experts Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available today for developers and enterprises via the API in AI Studio and Gemini platform , for Google AI Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity , and Google AI Ultra and Pro subscribers in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search .

개방형 Gemma 모델을 거의 3배 빠르게 만들기 · Argon을 사용하여 vLLM을 통해 A100에서 2.85배의 엔드투엔드 추론 속도 향상을 달성했습니다(Gemma 4 E2B에서 초당 토큰 처리량 ~37,900에서 108,000개 이상으로 가속화) · 단 며칠 만에 100% 토큰 패리티와 품질 저하가 전혀 없음 · 이 프로세스는 일반적으로 몇 달이 걸리는 프로세스임

중요한 비즈니스 및 전문 워크플로 혁신 연구원 및 도메인 전문가와 함께 실제 영향력 가속화 Gemini 4 Argon은 이제 AI Studio 및 Gemini 플랫폼의 API를 통해 개발자와 기업, Google Antigravity의 Google AI Ultra 구독자, Gemini 앱의 Google AI Ultra 및 Pro 구독자 및 검색의 AI 모드를 통해 전 세계적으로 사용할 수 있음

Security analysts need fast answers about their cloud infrastructure without deep familiarity with domain-specific query languages. Orca Security ’s tool covers over 900 cloud models (the resource types Sonar tracks, such as an Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instance or an Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket). Querying that data required precise model names, nested relationship navigation, and selection from 18 operators (comparison functions like equals or contains used to filter results).

To solve this, Orca Security partnered with AWS to build Discovery AI, a natural language query agent on Amazon Bedrock . Orca provides context-aware security for cloud, code, and AI, and Sonar is its domain-specific query system where users search, filter, and explore across the entire data graph.

In this post, we share the architecture and results of Discovery AI, which converts a natural language question into a Sonar query. As a result, Orca reduced query costs by 90 percent, input tokens by 93 percent, and latency by 75 percent compared to the initial baseline.

articles.title: LGU+, 요금·로밍이어 매장안내까지 AI 에이전트 이식
articles.descEn: LG유플러스가 통합 고객 플랫폼 내 요금납부·로밍안내에 이어 매장안내 인공지능(AI) 에이전트를 선보인다. 내년부터는 주요 통신 서비스 전반으로 확대, 단순히 답변하는 AI가 아닌 문제 해결에 초점을 맞춘 서비스 고도화를 추진한다. LG유플러스는 통합 고객 플랫폼 'U+one'의 AI검색을 고객 질문에 답하고 메뉴를 안내하는 기능에서 고객이 원하는 업무까지 처리하는 '액셔너블(Actionable) AI 에이전트'로 단계적으로 전환한다고 13일
articles.titleEn: LGU+, 요금·로밍이어 매장안내까지 AI 에이전트 이식
summaryLinesEn: 첫 단계로 지난 8월 '요금납부 에이전트'를 선보인 데 이어 9월 '로밍 에이전트'를 오픈했다.
LG유플러스는 통합 고객 플랫폼 'U+one'의 AI검색을 고객 질문에 답하고 메뉴를 안내하는 기능에서 고객이 원하는 업무까지 처리하는 '액셔너블(Actionable) AI 에이전트'로 단계적으로 전환한다고 13일 밝혔다.
LG유플러스는 온·오프라인 고객 접점의 연계를 강화하기 위해 올해 4분기 '매장안내 에이전트'도 선보일 예정이다.

articles.descEn: The chatbot startup is looking to sell its assets to Disney after years of legal challenges and safety concerns.

summaryLinesEn: In its bankruptcy filing , Character listed estimated liabilities between $50 million and $100 million.

articles.title: AI agent company Decagon held early M&A talks with ServiceNow, others
articles.descEn: Buzzy AI agent company Decagon is in early talks to be acquired by ServiceNow, and has hired an investment bank to evaluate M&A interest.
articles.titleEn: AI agent company Decagon held early M&A talks with ServiceNow, others
summaryLinesEn: The company, which was last valued at $4.5 billion earlier this year, has hired a bank to evaluate acquisition interest, according to people familiar with the matter.

The interest in Decagon represents a new shift in the AI boom: after years of huge venture rounds and soaring valuations, tech companies are increasingly looking to buy their way into promising AI markets.
Founded in July 2023 by Jesse Zhang and Ashwin Sreenivas, Decagon uses generative AI to automate customer support for enterprise customers, including Delta, Snapchat, and Ticketmaster.

The interest in Decagon represents a new shift in the AI boom: after years of huge venture rounds and soaring valuations, tech companies are increasingly looking to buy their way into promising AI markets.

Founded in July 2023 by Jesse Zhang and Ashwin Sreenivas, Decagon uses generative AI to automate customer support for enterprise customers, including Delta, Snapchat, and Ticketmaster.

Buzzy AI agent startup Decagon could be the latest company swept up in a growing wave of AI dealmaking.

Decagon has held early discussions with cloud software giant ServiceNow and additional companies, the people said.

SHENZHEN, 13 October 2026–Global smart device brand OPPO today announced a collaboration with Manus, a leading AI agent platform, to bring next-generation agentic AI experiences to smartphones. By integrating Manus' agentic capabilities to OPPO AI Mind Pilot, the collaboration will help users turn complex, multi-step tasks into ready-to-use results—advancing OPPO's vision for Personalized Proactive Intelligence, where AI understands users and proactively helps them get things done.

"Agentic AI marks an important shift from answering questions to helping users get things done." said Kai Tang, President of Software Engineering at OPPO. "Together with Manus, we are bringing more proactive and capable experiences to AI Mind Pilot, enabling AI to better understand users' intentions, take actions and complete tasks. Our goal is to make personal AI a natural part of everyday life and work."

"Smartphones are central to people's daily lives and support many of the tasks they handle every day, making them a natural platform for personal AI agents," said Tao Zhang, Co-Founder & CPO of Manus. "By bringing together Manus' agentic capabilities and OPPO's system-level integration, we can make advanced AI agents more accessible and help users complete multi-step tasks through simple, natural interactions."

summaryLines: 단순한 질문과 답변의 상호 작용을 넘어서도록 설계된 AI Mind Pilot은 사용자의 최종 목표를 이해하고, 이를 여러 단계로 나누고, 관련 정보를 식별하고, 적절한 도구를 선택하고, 장치에 저장된 파일 및 사진으로 직접 작업하는 것을 포함하여 최종 결과를 제공할 수 있음

articles.title: Alphabet President Ruth Porat on how Google is funding AI to win long term, and the biggest risks ahead | Fortune
articles.descEn: “You must invest for long-term growth,” Ruth Porat said at Fortune's Most Powerful Women Summit on Monday. “By the time you need it, it’s too late.”
articles.titleEn: Alphabet President Ruth Porat on how Google is funding AI to win long term, and the biggest risks ahead | Fortune
summaryLinesEn: Alphabet expects capital expenditures (capex) to “increase significantly” next year, Ruth Porat said Monday at Fortune ’s Most Powerful Women Summit in Santa Barbara, Calif., adding that the company remains “capacity constrained” as demand for compute grows.

Capital expenditures hit $44.9 billion in the second quarter, “with the vast majority of this spent in technical infrastructure to support our investments in AI,” Alphabet CFO Anat Ashkenazi said during the company’s Q2 earnings call.

Alphabet is spending roughly $200 billion this year to build out its AI capacity, and the company’s president and chief investment officer reiterated Google’s plan next year for the bill to be even more substantial.

articles.title: Honeyjar offers AI tools to improve PR and comms at every company
articles.descEn: Journalists, entrepreneurs, and even some public relations professionals will tell you that the PR process is broken. But could AI actually make things better?
articles.titleEn: Honeyjar offers AI tools to improve PR and comms at every company
summaryLinesEn: But Jamshidi told me in a follow-up email that Honeyjar’s vision goes beyond getting press coverage and beyond specific AI tools.

As Masek described the challenges involved in “helping with the why and when of comms and marketing for 110 portfolio companies” (the startups her firm had invested in), I flashed back to my own brief stint leading marketing at an early-stage VC firm , where founders were constantly asking for help getting into TechCrunch.

localization.title: Honeyjar는 모든 회사의 PR 및 커뮤니케이션을 개선하는 AI 도구를 제공함
summaryLines: 그러나 Jamshidi는 후속 이메일에서 Honeyjar의 비전이 언론 보도와 특정 AI 도구 그 이상이라고 말함
Masek이 "110개의 포트폴리오 회사(그녀의 회사가 투자한 스타트업)에 대한 커뮤니케이션 및 마케팅의 이유와 시기를 지원하는 것과 관련된 과제를 설명하면서 저는 초기 단계의 VC 회사에서 마케팅을 이끌었던 짧은 경력을 회상함 · 창업자들은 TechCrunch에 참여하는 데 끊임없이 도움을 요청함

Jagmeet Singh의 설립자는 숙련된 외국인 노동자를 위한 영주권 프로그램에서 Microsoft, Adobe 및 주요 IT 회사를 금지함 · Aisha Malik Elon Musk는 Starlink India 출시가 지연됨에 따라 Ambani의 영향력에 의문을 제기함 · Jagmeet Singh Cal AI의 19세 창업자는 자신의 새로운 AI 스타트업인 Julie Bort를 위해 방금 천만 달러를 모금함 · Google은 새로운 현지 최초의 Granola 경쟁자인 Ivan Mehta를 출시함

articles.title: Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models
articles.descEn: Meta says the models compete with the industry’s best and will soon power its Muse agent.
articles.titleEn: Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models
summaryLinesEn: Meta is making up for lost time in the AI race.
It’s unclear how they stack up against Google’s Gemini 4 Argon , whose capabilities are still coming into focus.

The company says its new models can rival leading models from OpenAI and Anthropic, including GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, and Claude Fable 5.1, pointing to results from internal testing on several industry benchmarks.

articles.title: Meta's new frontier model Muse Wonder Full breaks into the AI top tier
articles.descEn: Meta's new Muse Wonder models rank in the top three on six out of ten benchmarks, with the biggest gains in agentic tasks. But the cost per task has nearly tripled.
articles.titleEn: Meta's new frontier model Muse Wonder Full breaks into the AI top tier
summaryLinesEn: According to Artificial Analysis, Muse Wonder runs $4.52 per task on the Intelligence Index, nearly three times more than Muse Spark 1.3 ($1.60).
Muse Wonder Full places in the top three on six out of ten benchmarks overall, a strong result for Meta, which seems to have recovered after a weaker stretch with its open Llama models.
Both versions cost nearly three times as much per API call as their predecessor, Muse Spark 1.3.

articles.title: Muse Wonder Puts Meta Back at the AI Frontier
articles.descEn: Meta’s biggest model rivals the world’s best—and includes new features to keep agents from going off the rails.
articles.titleEn: Muse Wonder Puts Meta Back at the AI Frontier
summaryLinesEn: This can be a challenge when AI performs complex research or builds a large software project, for example, and can lead to expensive mistakes or compounded errors.
But the company fell behind after delivering several disappointing versions of the model, and as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google rapidly introduced more capable models.
Meta says it has put significant effort into training Muse Wonder to refuse to generate dangerous outputs, such as recipes for building bioweapons or help with hacking.

articles.title: How to use Google Gemini to automate tasks - Engadget
articles.descEn: Spark is Google's AI tool that can perform tasks on your behalf.
articles.titleEn: How to use Google Gemini to automate tasks - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The Gemini Spark website gives a few examples of what you can do with it, like turning your last 50 email responses into a style guide covering how you answer emails, or setting up a tracker for internships.
You'll also need "Keep activity" switched on, which the company says "lets you pick up chats where you left off."
Google emphasizes monitoring your tasks in case Gemini needs something from you, like taking over a task in the browser.

summaryLines: Applied Materials는 협업적 반도체 혁신을 가속화하기 위해 50억 달러 규모의 새로운 칩 연구 시설을 개설함 · Intel, Broadcom CEO, 금융 행사에서 AI 업계의 과제를 지적함 · Quantum 컴퓨터 제조업체 IonQ, 사이버 보안 스타트업 Elisity를 13억 달러에 인수 Dell과 Intel은 엔터프라이즈 AI 확장성 비용을 평가함 · Microsoft, 멀티 칩렛 출시 Maia 300 추론 가속기 상시 작동 에이전트가 확산됨에 따라 AI 거버넌스가 런타임으로 전환됨
Meta는 지난 4월 Muse Spark를 통해 도입한 사전 훈련 및 강화 학습 방법을 기반으로 기가와트 규모의 Prometheus 데이터 센터에서 두 모델을 훈련함

articles.titleEn: US legal AI giant Harvey to open Japan office in 2027, CEO says
summaryLinesEn: (Source photos by Nikkei and Harvey) PALO ALTO, California -- U.S. legal industry artificial intelligence heavyweight Harvey looks to enter Japan in early 2027, a move expected to accelerate AI use by law firms and their corporate clients while pressuring lawyers to use billable time more efficiently.

articles.title: Sakana AI's self-improving model gets better at solving and judging, but can't catch its own blind spots
articles.descEn: Sakana AI's MASS method lets one language model improve itself by solving tasks, judging results, and refining workflows, reaching a win rate of nearly 70 percent against the base model after two rounds. But when the model misses the same errors across all three roles, it can mistake them for progress and reinforce them during training.
articles.titleEn: Sakana AI's self-improving model gets better at solving and judging, but can't catch its own blind spots
summaryLinesEn: Ad On the test tasks, the win rate against the base model rises from 53.9 percent after one round to 69.9 percent after two.
Japanese research lab Sakana AI launched a dedicated research lab for recursive self-improvement in June, building on earlier work including the Darwin-Godel Machine and the AI Scientist .

Win rates against the base model rise to nearly 70 percent after two rounds, but the method carries a real risk: the internal evaluator sometimes accepts flawed steps or manipulated solutions as successes and bakes them into the next model.

articles.title: Microsoft’s new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs
articles.descEn: The new Maia 300 chip will start rolling out to production AI workloads in 2027.
articles.titleEn: Microsoft’s new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs
summaryLinesEn: “We expect Maia 300 to deliver 40 percent more tokens per megawatt compared to leading GPU-based systems,” says Scott Guthrie , executive vice president of Microsoft’s cloud group.
Maia 300 is also a key part of Microsoft’s own AI model work, and could help the company achieve its goal of catching up with Google DeepMind, OpenAI, and Anthropic.
“And in a full 96-accelerator configuration, it delivers up to 7x the rack-scale token throughput of Maia 200.”

“We expect Maia 300 to deliver 40 percent more tokens per megawatt compared to leading GPU-based systems,” says Scott Guthrie , executive vice president of Microsoft’s cloud group.

“And in a full 96-accelerator configuration, it delivers up to 7x the rack-scale token throughput of Maia 200.”

articles.title: WRITER connectors: Governed agent access across enterprise systems
articles.descEn: Secure, governed AI agent access to Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, HubSpot, Slack, Snowflake, and more enterprise systems.
articles.titleEn: WRITER connectors: Governed agent access across enterprise systems
summaryLinesEn: WRITER Agent retrieves campaign performance from HubSpot, analyzes engagement trends, synthesizes insights in a presentation with visualized charts and graphs, uses the latest product information sitting in docs on platforms like Confluence or SharePoint to write new campaign emails, then assigns follow-up tasks and notifies relevant teams in project management and communication tools like Asana and Microsoft Teams.

Here are three examples of real-world workflows that illustrate this shift: WRITER Agent draws performance and holdings data from Snowflake or Databricks, enriches it with public and private market signals from FactSet and PitchBook, and produces heatmaps and risk alerts saved back into SharePoint.
On the platform side, WRITER gives admins centralized control surfaces to manage connectors, define allowed operations, manage OAuth at the org or user level, and review usage through session logs.

summaryLines: WRITER 에이전트는 HubSpot에서 캠페인 성과를 검색하고, 참여 추세를 분석하고, 시각화된 차트 및 그래프로 프레젠테이션의 통찰력을 통합하고, Confluence 또는 SharePoint와 같은 플랫폼의 문서에 있는 최신 제품 정보를 사용하여 새 캠페인 이메일을 작성한 다음 후속 작업을 할당하고 Asana 및 Microsoft Teams와 같은 프로젝트 관리 및 커뮤니케이션 도구에서 관련 팀에 알림
다음은 이러한 변화를 보여주는 실제 워크플로의 세 가지 예임 · WRITER Agent는 Snowflake 또는 Databricks에서 성과 및 보유 데이터를 가져와 FactSet 및 PitchBook의 공개 및 비공개 시장 신호로 강화하고 히트맵과 위험 경고를 생성하여 SharePoint에 다시 저장함
플랫폼 측면에서 WRITER는 관리자에게 중앙 집중식 제어 표면을 제공하여 커넥터를 관리하고, 허용된 작업을 정의하고, 조직 또는 사용자 수준에서 OAuth를 관리하고, 세션 로그를 통해 사용량을 검토함

articles.descEn: Introducing WRITER Agent: enterprise AI built for scale with Playbooks for workflows, Routines for automation, and Connectors for system integration.
articles.titleEn: Introducing WRITER Agent: A new agent design pattern for enterprise scale
summaryLinesEn: From board materials and sales decks to research summaries and strategy presentations, WRITER Agent handles the heavy lifting – structuring the narrative, integrating your enterprise context, producing charts and visuals, and infusing your brand – so that teams can go from idea to presentation-ready in minutes.

But reaching that level from the current baseline will require an order-of-magnitude increase in AI usage, and that kind of adoption won’t happen without a fundamental shift in how enterprises use AI.

With personality profiles , WRITER Agent allows you to create and select voice profiles that carry through every type of output generated – from research briefs and competitive analyses to sales collateral, customer communications, and all forms of content – ensuring every output sounds like you , not a generic AI.

summaryLines: 보드 자료 및 판매 자료부터 연구 요약 및 전략 프리젠테이션에 이르기까지 WRITER Agent는 내러티브 구조화, 기업 컨텍스트 통합, 차트 및 시각 자료 생성, 브랜드 주입 등의 힘든 작업을 처리하므로 팀은 몇 분 만에 아이디어에서 프레젠테이션 준비를 완료할 수 있음
그러나 현재 기준에서 해당 수준에 도달하려면 AI 사용량이 대폭 증가해야 하며, 기업이 AI를 사용하는 방식을 근본적으로 바꾸지 않으면 이러한 채택이 이루어지지 않을 것임
성격 프로필을 사용하면 WRITER 에이전트를 사용하면 연구 요약 및 경쟁 분석부터 판매 보조 자료, 고객 커뮤니케이션 및 모든 형태의 콘텐츠에 이르기까지 생성된 모든 유형의 출력을 전달하는 음성 프로필을 생성하고 선택할 수 있으므로 모든 출력이 일반 AI가 아닌 귀하와 같은 소리를 내도록 보장함

articles.title: Deep dive into Azure Maia 300 architecture | Microsoft Azure Blog
articles.descEn: Learn how Maia 300 is helping us move toward making advanced AI capabilities more accessible, affordable, and useful.
articles.titleEn: Deep dive into Azure Maia 300 architecture | Microsoft Azure Blog
summaryLinesEn: Maia 300 brings 2.5 times the memory bandwidth, 33% more capacity, and approximately 2 times the HBM bandwidth per watt compared with Maia 200 Maia 300 makes the network a native extension of its software-defined dataflow architecture.
Second, new narrow-precision formats with hardware-accelerated data type conversion reduce the bytes moved for each token.

Building on the foundational energy efficiency of the Maia SoC architecture, the Maia 300 rack co-designs server layout and density, network topology and switching, power and cooling design, and advanced telemetry to deliver up to 2.5x more performance per watt compared to Maia 200. 96 accelerators within 167 kW Maia 300 integrates 96 accelerators across 24 four-accelerator trays within a 167-kW rack, doubling the accelerator density of Maia 200.

localization.title: Azure Maia 300 아키텍처 심층 분석 | 마이크로소프트 애저 블로그
summaryLines: Maia 300은 Maia 200에 비해 2.5배 더 많은 메모리 대역폭, 33% 더 많은 용량, 와트당 약 2배 더 많은 HBM 대역폭을 제공함 · Maia 300은 네트워크를 소프트웨어 정의 데이터 흐름 아키텍처의 기본 확장으로 만듬
둘째, 하드웨어 가속 데이터 유형 변환 기능을 갖춘 새로운 좁은 정밀도 형식은 각 토큰에 대해 이동되는 바이트 수를 줄임

Maia SoC 아키텍처의 기본 에너지 효율성을 기반으로 하는 Maia 300 랙은 서버 레이아웃 및 밀도, 네트워크 토폴로지 및 스위칭, 전원 및 냉각 설계, 고급 원격 측정을 공동 설계하여 Maia 200에 비해 와트당 최대 2.5배 더 많은 성능을 제공함 · 167kW 내 96개의 가속기 Maia 300은 167kW 랙으로 Maia 200의 가속기 밀도를 두 배로 늘렸음

articles.title: How we’re making Google Health and Fitbit Air smarter than ever
articles.descEn: Our most advanced wellness tools, sleek new accessories, and deeper app partnerships bring a more connected view of your health.
articles.titleEn: How we’re making Google Health and Fitbit Air smarter than ever
summaryLinesEn: From game days to daily life: The familiar faces teaming up with Google Health Google Fitbit Edge: Our all-new smartest fitness tracker ever We’re partnering with Flo Health to elevate women’s health Our new health and safety tools are live in the Google Health app.

We've also expanded our roster of fitness wearables: first with our screenless tracker, Fitbit Air 3 — introducing a playful, fan-favorite Pokémon ™ 4 Sleep Special Edition — and then with our most advanced wearable, Pixel Watch 5 , which brings proactive assistance and advanced health tracking to your wrist.

Set up blood pressure trends and insulin resistance trends 6 in the Google Health app, and if you meet the monthly wear requirements, you'll get a report at the beginning of each month to help you make lifestyle adjustments early.

articles.titleEn: Microsoft to expand Azure Maia system to multi-gigawatt deployments - The Official Microsoft Blog
summaryLinesEn: Click here to load media Maia 200: Driving the workloads that Microsoft runs at scale The Azure Maia system is designed around the real-world workloads Microsoft runs at scale and the models we expect to build in the years ahead.

articles.titleEn: OCP Global Summit: Amid Ecosystem Adoption, NVIDIA Opens Vera Rubin Architecture to Help Scale AI Factories Worldwide
summaryLinesEn: At the Open Compute Project (OCP) Global Summit, taking place in the San Jose McEnery Convention Center, NVIDIA announced new partnerships and contributions aimed at creating a common foundation for next-generation AI infrastructure.

The architecture supports rack deployments up to 250kW while simplifying serviceability, deployment and infrastructure reuse.

articles.descEn: For
articles.titleEn: How Flo Health built safer, more useful open models with Databricks AI Runtime | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Flo ran distributed fine-tuning on 32 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with Databricks AI Runtime, improving medical safety from 34% to approximately 61%, usefulness from 42% to 76%, and the combined score from 16% to 47%.
As Flo moved from using only traditional ML towards personalized insights powered by generative AI, the team saw the potential for a more flexible, personalized product.
Because Flo’s products deal with health and well-being, responses need to be medically safe and genuinely useful.

articles.title: Run multi-node inference workloads using Ray LLM Deep Learning Containers | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how to deploy one large language model across two GPU nodes on Amazon EKS using the multi-node Ray LLM Deep Learning Containers, with separate prefill and decode nodes behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The pre-built container ships the full inference stack, so you configure the deployment instead of assembling it.

summaryLinesEn: In this installment of our GitHub Copilot app for Beginners series, we’ll look at four ways to tailor how Copilot works with your project: Custom instructions communicate the conventions Copilot should follow.

Copilot can help you make changes across a project, but it works best when it knows those rules, too.

articles.title: Accessing OpenAI GPT models on Amazon Bedrock with global cross-Region inference in Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, and Taiwan | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how to run OpenAI GPT-6 Sol, Luna, and Astra on Amazon Bedrock through global cross-Region inference from Singapore, Jakarta, Thailand, Malaysia, and Taipei. This post covers the Converse and OpenAI-compatible APIs, IAM and SCP permissions, quota sizing, and monitoring inference from your source Region.
articles.titleEn: Accessing OpenAI GPT models on Amazon Bedrock with global cross-Region inference in Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, and Taiwan | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Global cross-Region inference routes requests across supported commercial AWS Regions where the model is deployed, giving you broad access to Amazon Bedrock capacity.
Teams in Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, and Taiwan need access to the newest OpenAI models beyond that capacity.

To call any of these models through a global cross-Region inference profile, your IAM policy needs four statements: Access to the inference profile and the project/default resource in your source Region.

articles.title: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
articles.descEn: Illicit distillation allows model developers to copy frontier AI capabilities without creating proportionally robust safeguards. Here, we describe how we’ve reduced the rate of distillation by more than 90%.
articles.titleEn: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
summaryLinesEn: Early evidence suggests that these methods have reduced the amount of data harvested by distillers by around 90 to 99 percent.
In response to the increasing sophistication and scale of these attacks, we’ve expanded and greatly strengthened our defenses against them.
We expect that distillation will remain a cat-and-mouse game, and that we’ll need to continue iterating on our defenses over time.

articles.title: Announcing FrontierCode on Artificial Analysis: can AI models write code maintainers would merge?
articles.descEn: Cognition's FrontierCode 1.1 tests whether AI models make code changes that maintainers of real open source repositories would merge. Leading models still fail more than 40% of the time.
articles.titleEn: Announcing FrontierCode on Artificial Analysis: can AI models write code maintainers would merge?
summaryLinesEn: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (max with fallback) uses ~50% more output tokens per task than Claude Opus 5.5 (max with fallback), but at half the per-token price it costs less, $8.26 against $10.15.

Four models sit on the Pareto frontier of score against cost: GPT-6 Luna (max) at 42% and $0.09 per task, MiMo-V2.6-Pro at 45% and $0.18, GPT-6.1 Sol (max) at 49% and $0.81, and Claude Opus 5.5 (max with fallback) at 52% and $10.15.
Cost per task spans more than 100x, from $0.09 for GPT-6 Luna (max) to $12.00 for Claude Fable 5.1 (max with fallback).

articles.title: Sovereign AI: Building national capability while preserving choice
articles.descEn: How Arm helps countries build sovereign AI capability while preserving choice, flexibility and long-term technology investment.
articles.titleEn: Sovereign AI: Building national capability while preserving choice
summaryLinesEn: According to the CNAS Sovereign AI Index , by mid-2026, governments across 67 countries were backing 184 sovereign AI projects spanning compute infrastructure, models and data.
Sovereign AI has moved rapidly from policy discussion into practical decisions about technology, infrastructure and skills.

Achieving that requires five core principles: Together, these can help countries build AI capacity on their own terms, strengthening local industries and skills while preserving the flexibility to adopt new technologies as AI evolves.

articles.title: Windows Is Phasing Out Old-Generation Snapdragon Laptops: Why This "Rushed" Transition Could Be a Game-Changer for Users
articles.descEn: The underlying truth of this matter is highly likely to be entirely contrary to its superficial appearance, revealing a hidden reality that sharply contradicts the initial observable impression and offering a counterintuitive perspective that challenges common assumptions about the situation.
articles.titleEn: Windows Is Phasing Out Old-Generation Snapdragon Laptops: Why This "Rushed" Transition Could Be a Game-Changer for Users
summaryLinesEn: Microsoft phased out a large number of old x86 platforms 16 years ago in 2024, but now the Snapdragon 850, which was born just over 8 years ago, is also about to be "banned".

Intel first introduced the SSE4.2 instruction set on the first-generation Core i series launched in 2008, the second-generation Core i series in 2011 brought the AVX instruction set, and in 2013, the fourth-generation Core i series introduced AVX2.

articles.title: From Siri to Muse: The 15-Year Evolutionary History of AI Assistants
articles.descEn: Explore the pinnacle of AI assistant evolution with "The Ultimate Fantasy of AI Assistants" – a groundbreaking vision that transcends conventional digital support to redefine intelligent interaction. This concept unveils a future where AI seamlessly adapts to human emotional nuances, anticipates personalized needs with unparalleled precision, and orchestrates cross-domain workflows autonomously, eliminating friction between technology and daily life. Dive into how this transformative AI fantasy integrates natural, context-aware communication, predictive problem-solving, and ethical, user-centric governance to create an intuitive, indispensable companion that elevates productivity, creativity, and quality of life to unprecedented heights. Discover the next frontier of artificial intelligence that turns the once-impossible dream of a truly symbiotic human-AI partnership into a tangible, game-changing reality.

articles.title: I'm a working parent who's built over 150 AI agents to help run my life. I get digital overload, but I'm getting more time back.
articles.descEn: Tristen O'Brien has always wanted to automate his life. He shared how he uses over 100 personal AI agents to do it.
articles.titleEn: I'm a working parent who's built over 150 AI agents to help run my life. I get digital overload, but I'm getting more time back.
summaryLinesEn: In total, I've built five research and education agents, four research and news agents, one agent that builds new products, 18 financial agents, 27 home and family agents, 26 inbox and communication agents, 42 agents for my YouTube channel, and another 27 agents for publicity and outreach.

I've been in the tech industry for over 20 years, and I'm working toward my doctorate in AI.

articles.title: Intel, Broadcom CEOs warn capital crunch could become AI's biggest bottleneck
articles.descEn: The CEOs of Intel and Broadcom warned that access to capital could emerge as a major constraint on the artificial intelligence boom.
articles.titleEn: Intel, Broadcom CEOs warn capital crunch could become AI's biggest bottleneck
summaryLinesEn: "There is more demand for compute infrastructure than we can supply," Hock Tan said, adding that the imbalance could persist through 2029 and potentially into 2030.

Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said financing could become a bigger obstacle to AI expansion than shortages of semiconductors, memory chips or electricity, as the industry races to build the infrastructure needed to power increasingly sophisticated models.
Higher bond yields could make it more expensive to fund data center construction and chip purchases, potentially putting pressure on the economics of projects that may take years to generate returns.

articles.title: Investigating unintended model actions in our evaluations and internal use
articles.descEn: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
articles.titleEn: Investigating unintended model actions in our evaluations and internal use
summaryLinesEn: In another evaluation, Claude Haiku 4.5 was instructed to complete a form up until the final submission stage, but to stop before actually submitting.
Some of the public evaluations we no longer run; others we have moved to their offline versions, or rebuilt them so that their tasks do not reach live websites.

Although the impact of these behaviors was minimal and we had already turned off live internet access for some high-risk and cybersecurity evaluations, we have now decided to expand that to include all our internal evaluations until we have confirmed that our security and monitoring measures (described in the remediation section of this post) reliably catch behaviors like these.

summaryLinesEn: A nose ring that lights up when I get a new like on a YouTube video.

articles.title: Your AI agent wants your money back — and that could mean trouble for these companies
articles.descEn: Personal AI agents are helping users lower bills and get refunds, exposing companies that rely on customers doing nothing.
articles.titleEn: Your AI agent wants your money back — and that could mean trouble for these companies
summaryLinesEn: After a little over an hour in Verizon’s live chat, the agent secured a lower monthly bill — $69.99, down from $94.99 — plus a $47.50 loyalty credit.
He said he recovered $73 across three flights in about five minutes each.
Widespread adoption of personal AI agents could pressure businesses that have long benefited from customers not shopping around, disputing a charge, or tackling a convoluted cancellation process.

sourceContent.headline: Your AI agent wants your money back — and that could mean trouble for these companies
sourceContent.description: Personal AI agents are helping users lower bills and get refunds, exposing companies that rely on customers doing nothing.
paragraphs: After a little over an hour in Verizon’s live chat, the agent secured a lower monthly bill — $69.99, down from $94.99 — plus a $47.50 loyalty credit.
He said he recovered $73 across three flights in about five minutes each.
Widespread adoption of personal AI agents could pressure businesses that have long benefited from customers not shopping around, disputing a charge, or tackling a convoluted cancellation process.

articles.title: GitHub - nano-muse/nanoMuse: nanoMuse: an open-source personal agent for every device you own. One agent with a name and a look of its own that does things, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and asks before anything you cannot undo. On Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows / macOS / Linux and in the browser; your phone's screen and your computer as its hands.

articles.titleEn: GitHub - nano-muse/nanoMuse: nanoMuse: an open-source personal agent for every device you own. One agent with a name and a look of its own that does things, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and asks before anything you cannot undo. On Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows / macOS / Linux and in the browser; your phone's screen and your computer as its hands.
summaryLinesEn: MobileGym , MemGUI-Bench , PhoneHarness , CopilotKit/OpenMuse , Open-AutoGLM , ClawGUI : the phone operator, the traces and the product ideas. nanoMuse is an independent community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms, Inc.; Muse is their trademark.

One agent with a name and a look of its own, in the style of Meta's Muse : it does things instead of answering questions, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and stops to ask before anything you could not undo. nano means the whole set, small enough to run and deploy yourself: the phone app, the desktop app, the web console and the relay that joins them are all in this repository, under GPL-3.0-or-later.
2026-10-09 🚀 Version 1.0.0 Keel is out, for the phone, the desktop and the browser; it installs over the version before and keeps your data, and its release notes list every change.

localization.title: GitHub - nano-muse/nanoMuse: nanoMuse: 귀하가 소유한 모든 장치를 위한 오픈 소스 개인 에이전트임 · 작업을 수행하고, 앱이 닫혀 있는 동안에도 계속 작업하고, 사용자를 기억하고, 실행 취소할 수 없는 작업이 발생하기 전에 물어보는 이름과 고유한 모양을 가진 하나의 에이전트임 · Android, iPhone, iPad, Windows/macOS/Linux 및 브라우저에서; 휴대 전화의 화면과 컴퓨터를 손으로 사용함
summaryLines: MobileGym , MemGUI-Bench , PhoneHarness , CopilotKit/OpenMuse , Open-AutoGLM , ClawGUI : 전화 교환원, 추적 및 제품 아이디어 · nanoMuse는 Meta Platforms, Inc.와 제휴하거나 승인하지 않은 독립적인 커뮤니티 프로젝트임 · Muse는 그들의 상표임

Meta의 Muse 스타일로 고유한 이름과 모양을 가진 하나의 에이전트 · 질문에 대답하는 대신 작업을 수행하고, 앱이 닫혀 있는 동안 계속 작업하고, 사용자를 기억하며, 실행 취소할 수 없는 작업이 발생하기 전에 중지하여 묻음 · nano는 스스로 실행하고 배포할 수 있을 만큼 작은 전체 세트를 의미함 · 전화 앱, 데스크톱 앱, 웹 콘솔 및 이를 연결하는 릴레이는 모두 GPL-3.0 이상에 따라 이 저장소에 있음
2026-10-09 🚀 버전 1.0.0 Keel이 모바일, 데스크톱 및 브라우저용으로 출시됨 · 이전 버전 위에 설치되어 데이터를 유지하며 릴리스 노트에는 모든 변경 사항이 나열됨

articles.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Has A $5 Billion Waymo Loan And A $50 Billion AI Bet
articles.descEn: Alphabet (NasdaqGS:GOOGL) subsidiaries Waymo and Isomorphic Labs are pursuing major new funding moves in autonomous driving and AI drug discovery. Waymo has lined up US$5b in debt financing to support an international expansion of its robotaxi operations outside the US. Isomorphic Labs is reported to be targeting a US$40b to US$50b valuation in its next capital raise focused on AI driven drug design. Waymo's US$5b financing and Isomorphic Labs' targeted US$40b to US$50b valuation merit...
articles.titleEn: Alphabet (GOOGL) Has A $5 Billion Waymo Loan And A $50 Billion AI Bet
summaryLinesEn: Waymo's US$5b financing and Isomorphic Labs' targeted US$40b to US$50b valuation merit weighing alongside the rest of our Alphabet work.
Waymo's US$5b term loan pushes more of that AI buildout onto subsidiary-level borrowing rather than Alphabet's own cash, which can help financial flexibility if free cash flow is already tight.
Waymo has lined up US$5b in debt financing to support an international expansion of its robotaxi operations outside the US.

localization.title: Alphabet(GOOGL)은 50억 달러의 Waymo 대출과 500억 달러의 AI 베팅을 보유하고 있음
summaryLines: Waymo의 50억 달러 자금 조달과 Isomorphic Labs의 목표 가치는 400억 달러에서 500억 달러로 나머지 Alphabet 작업과 함께 중요함
Waymo의 미화 50억 달러 정기 대출은 Alphabet의 자체 현금보다는 자회사 수준의 차입으로 AI 구축을 더 많이 추진하여 무료 현금 흐름이 이미 부족한 경우 재정적 유연성에 도움이 될 수 있음
Waymo는 미국 외 지역에서 로봇택시 사업의 국제적 확장을 지원하기 위해 미화 50억 달러의 부채 자금 조달을 준비함

articles.title: Few people pay for AI, but those who do spend big
articles.descEn: Andreessen Horowitz tracks actual US consumer spending for the first time in its latest Top 100 AI list. Nearly half of US consumers use AI, but only 4.5 percent pay for a subscription. The top one percent of payers spend about $900 a month, mostly on professional tools for development and automation.
articles.titleEn: Few people pay for AI, but those who do spend big
summaryLinesEn: The top one percent of payers spend about $900 a month on work and creative tools, while the typical user spends around $25.

The biggest shift is Claude's rise to a clear number three, a model that didn't even appear on the first web list in 2023 but has since passed Deepseek and Perplexity in traffic and pulled even with Gemini among US subscribers.
Nearly half of US consumers use AI, but only 4.5 percent pay for a subscription to ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude, according to Andreessen Horowitz.

localization.title: AI에 비용을 지불하는 사람은 거의 없지만 큰 비용을 지출하는 사람
summaryLines: 지불자의 상위 1%는 업무 및 창의적 도구에 매달 약 900달러를 지출하는 반면, 일반 사용자는 약 25달러를 지출함
가장 큰 변화는 Claude가 2023년 첫 번째 웹 목록에는 나타나지도 않았지만 이후 트래픽에서 Deepseek 및 Perplexity를 제치고 미국 구독자 사이에서 Gemini와 동등한 수준으로 끌어올린 모델인 확실한 3위로 상승한 것임
Andreessen Horowitz에 따르면 미국 소비자의 거의 절반이 AI를 사용하지만 ChatGPT, Gemini 또는 Claude 구독 비용을 지불하는 사람은 4.5%에 불과함

articles.descEn: ASML Holding (ENXTAM:ASML) is back in focus after a broad selloff in AI-exposed chip stocks pulled the shares lower, even as investors look ahead to its October 14 earnings report. The recent AI related pullback has taken some heat out of ASML Holding’s rally, with the stock down 1.78% on a 1 day share price return and 3.11% on a 7 day share price return, even though the 30 day share price return of 6.94% and year to date share price return of 62.38% still point to strong positive momentum...
articles.titleEn: ASML Holding (ENXTAM:ASML) Faces An AI Pullback, Is The Stock Too Expensive?
summaryLinesEn: The recent AI related pullback has taken some heat out of ASML Holding's rally, with the stock down 1.78% on a 1 day share price return and 3.11% on a 7 day share price return, even though the 30 day share price return of 6.94% and year to date share price return of 62.38% still point to strong positive momentum built over a longer stretch.

Recent volatility reflects shifting views on how export controls, large orders stretching into 2027 and 2028, and big-ticket moves such as the roughly US$1.3b Mistral investment might affect future risk and reward.

articles.title: We’re putting too much faith in AI’s ability to say no
articles.descEn: Ask a chatbot something dangerous and it will refuse the request. But this critical tool of AI safety is far from foolproof and could become an instrument of repression.
articles.titleEn: We’re putting too much faith in AI’s ability to say no
summaryLinesEn: And yet there may not be much to stop oppressive governments from blocking the technology’s capacity to generate legitimate speech.

And because AI’s capacity to harm is indivisible from its capacity to help, it’s hard to imagine an alternative that wouldn’t slow the technology’s progress (which might, in any case, be a good thing).
Our best guess, according to a recent Google-funded study, is that refusal behavior shows up in the activation space as a set of “high-dimensional polyhedral cones.”

localization.title: 우리는 거절할 수 있는 AI의 능력을 너무 많이 믿고 있음
summaryLines: 그러나 억압적인 정부가 합법적인 발언을 생성하는 기술의 역량을 차단하는 것을 막을 수 있는 방법은 그리 많지 않을 수 있음
그리고 AI의 해를 끼칠 수 있는 능력은 도움을 줄 수 있는 능력과 분리될 수 없기 때문에 기술의 발전을 늦추지 않는(어쨌든 좋은 일이 될 수 있는) 대안을 상상하기는 어렵음

articles.titleEn: Indonesia Digital Banking Trends 2026: Traditional vs Neobanks
summaryLinesEn: Growth Trends Across Indonesia’s Traditional Banking Apps BRImo remains the largest app by downloads, with growth maturing alongside BCA mobile Livin’ by Mandiri and wondr by BNI post the strongest download growth, with Livin’ by Mandiri holding the #2 position overall BRImo maintains a strong position in monthly active users. wondr by BNI shows strong active user growth, with myBCA also recording notable gains.

BCA continues migrating users to myBCA, alongside rising engagement across its apps Acquisition Is Shifting From Organic Reach Toward Paid Channels Organic downloads remain a meaningful channel for apps with strong brand recognition , even as the broader market leans more on paid acquisition.
Paid display activity is increasing broadly across the market, with wondr by BNI and Bank Mandiri also stepping up investment in paid search.

localization.title: 2026년 인도네시아 디지털 뱅킹 트렌드 · 기존 vs 네오뱅크
summaryLines: 인도네시아의 전통 뱅킹 앱 전반에 걸친 성장 추세 BRImo는 BCA 모바일 Livin' by Mandiri 및 wonderr by BNI와 함께 다운로드 기준 최대 앱으로 남아 있으며 가장 강력한 다운로드 성장을 기록했으며 Livin' by Mandiri는 전체 BRImo에서 월간 활성 사용자 수에서 강력한 위치를 유지하고 있음 · BNI의 wonderr는 강력한 활성 사용자 성장을 보여주며 myBCA도 주목할만한 이득을 기록하고 있음
BCA는 계속해서 사용자를 myBCA로 마이그레이션하고 앱 전반에 걸쳐 참여가 증가하고 있음 · 획득이 유기적 도달 범위에서 유료 채널로 전환되고 있음 · 더 넓은 시장이 유료 획득에 더 의존하고 있음에도 불구하고 유기적 다운로드는 강력한 브랜드 인지도를 지닌 앱에 대한 의미 있는 채널로 남아 있음
BNI와 Bank Mandiri의 wonderr도 유료 검색에 대한 투자를 강화하면서 유료 디스플레이 활동이 시장 전반에 걸쳐 광범위하게 증가하고 있음

articles.title: An opt-in vulnerability-finding service for open-source software
articles.descEn: We’re launching OSS Scanner, an opt-in vulnerability scanner for the open-source ecosystem informed by our experience using Claude to find vulnerabilities during Project Glasswing. Projects that join will receive thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost.
articles.titleEn: An opt-in vulnerability-finding service for open-source software
summaryLinesEn: We’re launching OSS Scanner , an opt-in vulnerability scanner for the open-source ecosystem informed by our experience using Claude to find vulnerabilities during Project Glasswing .

Each report contains a self-contained reproducer, explanation of the vulnerability (including a bisection to determine when the bug was introduced, where possible), and candidate patch (when available) for how the bug can be fixed.

Inspired by the positive impact on the open source ecosystem of Google's OSS-Fuzz , a project that scans open-source software for vulnerabilities with fuzzers, we are launching OSS Scanner to find vulnerabilities in open-source code with our strongest language models.

localization.title: 오픈 소스 소프트웨어에 대한 선택적인 취약점 찾기 서비스
summaryLines: 우리는 Project Glasswing 동안 취약점을 찾기 위해 Claude를 사용한 경험을 바탕으로 오픈 소스 생태계를 위한 옵트인 취약점 스캐너인 OSS Scanner를 출시할 예정임
각 보고서에는 자체 포함된 재현 프로그램, 취약점에 대한 설명(가능한 경우 버그가 도입된 시기를 결정하는 이등분 포함), 버그 수정 방법에 대한 후보 패치(사용 가능한 경우)가 포함되어 있음
Fuzzer를 사용하여 오픈 소스 소프트웨어의 취약점을 검색하는 프로젝트인 Google OSS-Fuzz가 오픈 소스 생태계에 미치는 긍정적인 영향에 영감을 받아, 우리는 가장 강력한 언어 모델을 사용하여 오픈 소스 코드의 취약점을 찾기 위해 OSS Scanner를 출시함

articles.title: Solving defense supply chain visibility through governed data sharing | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Governed data sharing gives the DoW cost and supply chain visibility across 200,000+ suppliers, with no vendor lock-in.
articles.titleEn: Solving defense supply chain visibility through governed data sharing | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Governed data sharing lets every tier of the supply chain publish validated evidence from existing records without exposing source systems.

More than a dozen executive orders and directives since 2020, culminating in the August 2026 Supplier Cost and Pricing Transparency memorandum , now mandate actual cost data, critical supply chain mapping at every tier, and continuous performance visibility across a base of more than 200,000 suppliers.
The DoW needs cost and supply chain visibility across 200,000+ suppliers, but manual data calls and fragmented spreadsheets hinder insight.

localization.title: 통제된 데이터 공유를 통해 국방 공급망 가시성 해결 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
summaryLines: 관리되는 데이터 공유를 통해 공급망의 모든 계층은 소스 시스템을 노출하지 않고도 기존 기록에서 검증된 증거를 게시할 수 있음
2020년 이후 12개 이상의 행정 명령 및 지침이 2026년 8월 공급업체 비용 및 가격 투명성 각서로 정점을 이루었으며 이제 실제 비용 데이터, 모든 계층의 중요한 공급망 매핑, 200,000개 이상의 공급업체 기반에 대한 지속적인 성과 가시성을 요구함
DoW에는 200,000개 이상의 공급업체에 대한 비용 및 공급망 가시성이 필요하지만 수동 데이터 호출과 단편화된 스프레드시트로 인해 통찰력이 방해됨

articles.descEn: A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Impactful scheduling for GPU clusters
summaryLinesEn: The workload is scheduled according to the fair-share algorithm, weighted by a ratio of actual occupancy to allocated time in the lookback window.
As a result, we shifted the debate about how much GPU time each research project deserves from a case-by-case operational task to a transparent administrative budgeting process.

Overcommitting Tragedy of the commons Budgets not schedules Fair-share The scheduling contract Simulations Results Challenges The future Building a cluster scheduler to prioritize high-impact research while maintaining full occupancy On the AI Infrastructure team at Ai2, we’re responsible for providing the institute’s GPU compute capacity, specifically targeting large, distributed training workloads.

localization.title: GPU 클러스터에 대한 영향력 있는 스케줄링
summaryLines: 워크로드는 룩백 윈도우에서 할당된 시간에 대한 실제 점유 비율을 기준으로 가중치가 적용되는 공정 공유 알고리즘에 따라 예약됨
그 결과, 우리는 각 연구 프로젝트에 얼마만큼의 GPU 시간이 필요한지에 대한 논의를 사례별 운영 작업에서 투명한 행정 예산 책정 프로세스로 전환함
공유지의 비극 예산이 일정하지 않음 공정한 공유 일정 계약 시뮬레이션 결과 과제 미래 전체 점유를 유지하면서 영향력이 큰 연구의 우선 순위를 지정하기 위한 클러스터 스케줄러 구축 Ai2의 AI 인프라 팀에서는 특히 대규모 분산 교육 워크로드를 대상으로 연구소의 GPU 컴퓨팅 용량을 제공하는 일을 담당하고 있음

articles.title: How Postman runs Agent Mode for 40 million developers on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Building an AI agent that works in a demo is a different problem from running one for 40 million developers. Postman and AWS share the architectural patterns behind Agent Mode: controlling tool sprawl, exposing schema-based reads, and treating context as the real bottleneck, plus how it runs on Amazon Bedrock at scale.
articles.titleEn: How Postman runs Agent Mode for 40 million developers on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Building an AI agent for a demo and operating one for 40 million developers are different engineering problems.

With Amazon Bedrock, Postman can scale this production workload without operating its own model-serving infrastructure while retaining flexibility in model selection and control over throughput, geographic processing, and cost.
Postman has evolved over 11 years, and developers and users learned to locate information through the interface by expanding sidebars, checking tabs, and opening requests.

localization.title: Postman이 Amazon Bedrock에서 4천만 명의 개발자를 위해 에이전트 모드를 실행하는 방법 | 아마존 웹 서비스
summaryLines: 데모용 AI 에이전트를 구축하는 것과 4천만 명의 개발자를 위해 이를 운영하는 것은 서로 다른 엔지니어링 문제임
Amazon Bedrock을 사용하면 Postman은 모델 선택의 유연성을 유지하고 처리량, 지리적 처리 및 비용에 대한 제어를 유지하면서 자체 모델 제공 인프라를 운영하지 않고도 이러한 프로덕션 워크로드를 확장할 수 있음
Postman은 11년에 걸쳐 발전해 왔으며 개발자와 사용자는 사이드바 확장, 탭 확인, 요청 열기 등의 인터페이스를 통해 정보를 찾는 방법을 배웠음
