articles.title: From post-training to production: How TinyFish runs its web-native model on Databricks AI Runtime | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Tiny
articles.titleEn: From post-training to production: How TinyFish runs its web-native model on Databricks AI Runtime | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: In TinyFish's internal go/no-go benchmark, its web-native model achieved a 77.6% task-success rate across 2,178 web-agent tasks, measuring whether the full agent successfully completed the requested work.

As the company expanded its model work, the team also had to build the infrastructure around it: GPU compute for post-training, evaluation that could measure the behavior of the full agent, production serving, and the data needed to understand how the system was performing.
AI Runtime provides managed GPU infrastructure for training and fine-tuning, while MLflow supports evaluation and Databricks Model Serving provides the production serving layer.

localization.title: 사후 교육부터 프로덕션까지 · TinyFish가 Databricks AI Runtime에서 웹 기반 모델을 실행하는 방법 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
summaryLines: TinyFish의 내부 go/no-go 벤치마크에서 웹 네이티브 모델은 2,178개의 웹 에이전트 작업에서 77.6%의 작업 성공률을 달성하여 전체 에이전트가 요청된 작업을 성공적으로 완료했는지 여부를 측정함
회사가 모델 작업을 확장함에 따라 팀은 훈련 후를 위한 GPU 컴퓨팅, 전체 에이전트의 동작을 측정할 수 있는 평가, 프로덕션 서비스, 시스템 성능을 이해하는 데 필요한 데이터 등 주변 인프라도 구축해야 함
AI Runtime은 학습 및 미세 조정을 위한 관리형 GPU 인프라를 제공하고, MLflow는 평가를 지원하고 Databricks Model Serving은 프로덕션 서비스 계층을 제공함

articles.title: Why Don’t Some People Use Chatbots?
articles.descEn: About half of U.S. adults never use chatbots, and most non-users cite disinterest, privacy or accuracy concerns.
articles.titleEn: Why Don’t Some People Use Chatbots?
summaryLinesEn: As chatbots are spreading into the daily lives of many, some opt out by choice while others aren’t sure how to keep up.
It’s important to understand how people use AI in their lives and how they feel these tools will impact themselves and society.
Roughly seven-in-ten adults who don’t use chatbots say they’re unlikely to use the technology in the next 12 months.

summaryLines: 챗봇이 많은 사람들의 일상생활로 확산되면서 일부는 선택적으로 챗봇을 선택하지 않고 다른 일부는 어떻게 따라잡아야 할지 확신하지 못함

챗봇을 사용하지 않는 성인 10명 중 약 7명은 향후 12개월 동안 이 기술을 사용하지 않을 것이라고 말함

articles.descEn: Claude Corps is a national fellowship for early-career people passionate about extending the benefits of AI to communities across America.

summaryLinesEn: Over the next 12 months, at least 400 nonprofits will host Claude Corps Fellows.
A nonpartisan think-and-do tank focused on accelerating economic growth in the American heartland.

Fellows will receive a full-time salary of $85,000 and benefits, support from a CodePath mentor, office hours from Anthropic for their technical questions, an expansive Claude token budget, and professional guidance from their manager at the host organization.

articles.title: How California built its Behavioral Health Public County Profile on Databricks | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Learn how California used Databricks to launch the Behavioral Health Public County Profile, bringing data transparency and accountability to 40 million residents.
articles.titleEn: How California built its Behavioral Health Public County Profile on Databricks | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: The California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) built the Behavioral Health Public County Profile on the Databricks platform, a first-of-its-kind public dashboard that brings behavioral health data from all 58 counties into one place for nearly 40 million Californians.

Built to support the Behavioral Health Services Act (BHSA) following Proposition 1, the dashboard resolves data fragmentation across all 58 counties, enabling transparent tracking of local funding, service delivery, and homelessness initiatives.

On October 1, 2026, Governor Gavin Newsom announced the launch of the County Profile, calling it a tool that empowers people to see how their counties plan, fund, and deliver behavioral health services and to hold government accountable for results.

localization.title: 캘리포니아가 Databricks에서 행동 건강 공공 카운티 프로필을 구축한 방법 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
summaryLines: 캘리포니아 보건 서비스부(DHCS)는 거의 4천만 명의 캘리포니아 주민들을 위해 58개 카운티 전체의 행동 건강 데이터를 한 곳으로 가져오는 최초의 공개 대시보드인 Databricks 플랫폼에 행동 건강 공공 카운티 프로필을 구축함
발의안 1에 따라 행동 건강 서비스법(BHSA)을 지원하기 위해 구축된 대시보드는 58개 카운티 전체의 데이터 단편화를 해결하여 지역 자금 조달, 서비스 제공 및 노숙자 이니셔티브를 투명하게 추적할 수 있음
2026년 10월 1일, Gavin Newsom 주지사는 카운티 프로필의 출시를 발표하여 사람들이 카운티에서 행동 건강 서비스를 계획, 자금 조달 및 제공하는 방법을 확인하고 정부가 결과에 대해 책임을 지도록 하는 도구라고 말함

articles.title: Sharing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol
articles.descEn: Today we’re publishing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol, known as Poppy, and announcing additional design partners.
articles.titleEn: Sharing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol
summaryLinesEn: Replies can stream as they’re written, and companies can hold a request open until there’s news to share.
Businesses have no standard way to help guide the agent, which limits what the customer, their personal agent and the brand can do directly together.

So today we’re publishing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol , known as Poppy, and announcing an additional 35 design partners: Adyen, Atomic, Bank of America, BBVA, Chime, Cigna, Cloudflare, Comcast, DIRECTV, ElevenLabs, FOX, Gap Inc., GEICO, Hertz, Insurify, Klaviyo, Liberty Mutual, Mastercard, Nordstrom, Notion, Okta, OneSignal, OpenAI, PayPal, Plaid, SiriusXM, Synchrony, Target, United Airlines, Venmo, Visa, Wells Fargo, Zapier, Zendesk, and 1Password.

articles.title: On-device AI Is ready to challenge cloud dominance
articles.descEn: UNESCO recently advocated a shift away from resource-intensive AI models in favour of more compact ones. The UNESCO report calls for governments and industry to invest in sustainable AI research and development. as a way to reduce energy consumption by up to 90%. While much of the AI industry is still obsessed with building more […]
articles.titleEn: On-device AI Is ready to challenge cloud dominance
summaryLinesEn: VisionPsy-Nano 460M-Flash is engineered for fast, real-world deployment on everyday smartphones (e.g., cutting time-to-first-response by up to 23x on a Pixel 9) while retaining around 99% of full model quality.

In the last couple of years, even the largest cloud providers have moved into compact VLMs, with Google evolving its lightweight open-weight lineup from PaliGemma in 2024 through the Gemma 3 and Gemma 4 families.

Driven by growing demand for localised user privacy, environmental concerns à la ‘tokenmaxxing’ , and efficiency required by some use cases, breakthroughs in smaller purpose-built AI models have shown developers that capable AI does not always require large cloud setups.

articles.title: I Let AI Plan My Days and Nights. It Doesn’t Understand Happiness - CNET
articles.descEn: This was supposed to make me happier. I felt more isolated instead.
articles.titleEn: I Let AI Plan My Days and Nights. It Doesn’t Understand Happiness - CNET
summaryLinesEn: By 9 a.m., all three had put me to work crafting a “real,” “substantial,” “vibrant” breakfast and tackling either creative projects or writing and researching for my gig here at CNET.

Doing laundry, washing dishes, weeding the yard, exercising multiple times a day and maybe squeezing in a few hours for book learning, all while never truly engaging socially or prioritizing fun, sounds more like a light punishment than a schedule built for glee.
This might be because reading the news, checking up on social media and seeing the latest updates, or lack thereof, on the new Fable game were unlikely to make me happy.

summaryLines: 오전 9시가 되자 세 사람 모두 저를 "진짜", "실질적", "활기찬" 아침 식사를 준비하고 창의적인 프로젝트를 다루거나 이곳 CNET에서의 내 공연을 위해 글을 쓰고 연구하는 일을 하게 됨
빨래를 하고, 설거지를 하고, 마당에서 잡초를 뽑고, 하루에 여러 번 운동을 하고, 어쩌면 책을 배우기 위해 몇 시간씩 짜내면서, 진정으로 사회적으로 참여하거나 재미를 우선시하지 않는 것은 기쁨을 위해 짜여진 일정보다 가벼운 처벌처럼 들림
새로운 Fable 게임에 대한 뉴스를 읽고, 소셜 미디어를 확인하고, 최신 업데이트나 정보가 부족한 것을 보는 것이 나를 행복하게 만들지 못했기 때문일 수도 있음

articles.descEn: Eligible recipients in the class-action settlement can now sign up for payouts over Apple's AI lawsuit.
articles.titleEn: The Time Is Now to File Your Claim for Apple's $250M AI iPhone Settlement - CNET
summaryLinesEn: Now you can turn that initial dismay into a payment in Apple’s $250 million legal settlement by signing up at a live website .
Then an Aug. 13 order moved up the final approval date by seven months.

If you bought one of the following devices between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025, you could be eligible to receive a settlement payment: The iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max are included because they have the processor and memory to run Apple Intelligence features.

articles.titleEn: Microsoft’s new Nvidia PCs are cool for extreme power users - but I’ll wait for AI PC 3.0 - ZDNET
summaryLinesEn: Has Microsoft given up on its Copilot+ PC for the mass market?
Microsoft and Nvidia launched a new PC platform this week.

To earn that label, a Windows 11 PC had to have at least 16 GB of memory (double the minimum for a regular Windows 11 PC) and it needed a neural processing unit (NPU) capable of processing a minimum of 40 trillion operations per second — 40+ TOPS.

articles.title: China's Manus raises over $500M in first funding round since split with Meta
articles.descEn: Boyu Capital and IDG Capital led the funding round, and existing shareholders Tencent, HSG (formerly known as Sequoia China), ZhenFund, and others also participated.
articles.titleEn: China's Manus raises over $500M in first funding round since split with Meta
summaryLinesEn: Chinese AI lab Manus’ parent company, Butterfly Effect, said on Thursday in a WeChat post that it has raised more than $500 million, the company’s first funding round since Meta was forced to call off its $2 billion acquisition of the startup.
The company recently launched Manus 2.0 , which it says brings a new architecture with new products and capabilities built around a new harness.
The startup was said to be pulling in annual recurring revenue of over $100 million at the time.

summaryLines: 중국 AI 연구소 마누스(Manus)의 모회사인 버터플라이 이펙트(Butterfly Effect)는 목요일 위챗 게시물을 통해 메타가 20억 달러 규모의 스타트업 인수를 취소한 이후 첫 번째 자금 조달 라운드에서 5억 달러 이상을 모금했다고 밝힘

articles.title: Mission AI ROI strategy framework for space using Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: This post introduces the Governed Intelligence Framework (GI Framework), giving you a defensible path from AI spending to quantifiable value without compromising governance rigor. Built on Amazon Bedrock by Amazon Web Services (AWS) as the implementation solution, the framework rests on a single argument: ROI, governance, and token optimization form a reinforcing system. None of them deliver results in isolation.
articles.titleEn: Mission AI ROI strategy framework for space using Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: McKinsey’s State of AI 2026 survey (n=1,719) found that only 6 percent of enterprises qualify as AI high performers with 5 percent or more of earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) attributable to AI, even as 88 percent reported using AI in at least one function in 2025 .
It serves as the denominator of the MAIR equation introduced earlier.
For aerospace and defense programs, where cost overruns of 20–50 percent are common, a higher minimum (for example, 1.5) is appropriate to provide a margin of safety.

localization.title: Amazon Bedrock을 사용한 우주용 Mission AI ROI 전략 프레임워크 | 아마존 웹 서비스
summaryLines: McKinsey의 2026 AI 현황 조사(n=1,719)에 따르면 2025년에 88%가 2025년에 하나 이상의 기능에서 AI를 사용했다고 보고했음에도 불구하고 AI로 인한 이자 및 세금 전 이익(EBIT)이 5% 이상인 AI 고성과 기업으로 자격을 갖춘 기업은 6%에 불과한 것으로 나타남
이는 앞서 소개한 MAIR 방정식의 분모 역할을 함
20~50%의 비용 초과가 일반적인 항공우주 및 방위 프로그램의 경우 안전 여유를 제공하려면 더 높은 최소값(예 · 1.5)이 적절함

articles.title: Nvidia's big bet on physical AI aims for safer robotaxis, humanoid robots
articles.descEn: Full-stack safety solution for physical AI is being used by robotics companies.
articles.titleEn: Nvidia's big bet on physical AI aims for safer robotaxis, humanoid robots
summaryLinesEn: Huang began highlighting physical AI as Nvidia’s second-most important growth category in 2025.

The expanded safety offering for robotics comes as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang described the physical AI business as already driving nearly $10 billion in annual revenue for the company during an appearance on the All-In Podcast in March 2026.
Nvidia’s Halos system launched in 2025 with hardware and software tools to help developers implement guardrails in self-driving cars and other autonomous vehicles.

메뉴 모든 네트워크 및 플랫폼 제품 및 계획 책임 있는 사업 공공 안전 금융 및 투자자 알림 보도 자료 미디어 연락처 B-롤 및 이미지 Verizon 사실 시트 RSS 피드 비상 리소스 케이블 사실 방해 요소, 승객, 과속 및 언제 차량을 요청해야 하는지에 대한 5가지 대화를 통해 십대 자녀가 보다 안전한 운전 습관을 기를 수 있도록 도와주세요
십대들은 친구의 모바일을 보면 안 되고, 친구가 부추기니까 속도를 높이면 안 되고, 교통 중에 음악을 바꿔서는 안 된다는 것을 알 수도 있음

articles.title: The model that didn't exist, so you made it yourself
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: The model that didn't exist, so you made it yourself
summaryLinesEn: The compute for the whole project, including having the 9B model label 8,797 example requests, came to USD 16.
By my 6th project it was closer to 2,000, because each project taught me something I wanted in the next one.
Logolabs' Agate Preview 002 is a 260M-parameter text-to-image model, small enough for a browser, but it needs 50 steps with guidance, which is 100 network passes per image.

articles.title: Google Cloud introduces the Gemini agent.
articles.descEn: Google Cloud’s new Gemini agent automates workflows by connecting to your business systems. See how it streamlines enterprise tasks in one prompt.
articles.titleEn: Google Cloud introduces the Gemini agent.
summaryLinesEn: It chooses the best model for the job, has built-in cost controls, and most importantly, has the security, administration, and governance required by enterprise customers.
Today at Gemini at Work 2026, Google Cloud announced the Gemini agent, a universal agent for work.
Gemini has all of an organization’s business context and can be used for everything from knowledge work to answering questions, and content creation to coding, all from a single prompt box.

articles.title: Rally Up: ‘Gears of War: E-Day’ Launches on GeForce NOW
articles.descEn: Gears of War: E-Day leads the charge on GeForce NOW this week. Plus, discover 10 new games streaming from the cloud this week.
articles.titleEn: Rally Up: ‘Gears of War: E-Day’ Launches on GeForce NOW
summaryLinesEn: Set 14 years before the original Gears of War , the prequel follows Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago as they confront the terrifying arrival of the Locust Horde on Emergence Day.
Better yet, the cost of the day pass can be applied toward a first monthly membership — making it easy to try GeForce RTX-powered cloud gaming with the latest releases, then level up for more.
There’s more in store this GFN Thursday, with the cloud serving up 10 games, including seven new releases.

summaryLinesEn: Built by clinicians and machine learning scientists working side by side, it's trained to weigh what matters the way a clinician would: the allergy that rules out a drug, the family history that moves a screening up, the guideline exception this patient meets.

In our conversation, she shared how Abridge Assistant has transformed her practice before, during, and after visits, and where she sees Abridge having the greatest impact.

articles.descEn: A reference architecture for securely sharing one Amazon SageMaker HyperPod EKS cluster across multiple teams, using AWS IAM Identity Center for authentication, per-team SageMaker Domains and Kubernetes namespaces for isolation, HyperPod Task Governance for fairness, and namespace-level cost allocation for chargeback.
articles.titleEn: Share GPU clusters across teams with isolation and fairness using Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: By the end of this post, you will have a clear blueprint for multiple teams to efficiently share a single HyperPod EKS cluster.

articles.title: Pay-per-inference for AI agents: How BlockRun and Incarna use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments gives AI agents a managed way to pay for services on demand, with spending limits enforced by the infrastructure. See how Incarna's agents pay BlockRun for model inference one request at a time over x402, cutting the work of adding x402 payment support from months to days.
articles.titleEn: Pay-per-inference for AI agents: How BlockRun and Incarna use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Across the beta, agents have processed over 1,000 payments ranging from $0.001 to $0.05 per call, each settling individually on-chain.
And with AgentCore payments and x402 providing the spending controls agents need, that intelligence can be put to work safely in the real world.”

AgentCore runs the agent, BlockRun serves metered inference, and AgentCore payments connects to the customer’s wallet, enforces the spending limit, and signs each payment on behalf of the agent’s Incarna identity.

articles.title: With Americans in a Sour Mood, Democratic Voters Are More Engaged in Midterms
articles.descEn: The 2026 midterm election comes amid deep public dissatisfaction with the state of the nation and near-record low approval ratings for Trump.
articles.titleEn: With Americans in a Sour Mood, Democratic Voters Are More Engaged in Midterms
summaryLinesEn: For example: 78% of voters who back their House district’s Democratic candidate say it “really matters” which party wins control of Congress – 9 points higher than the share of Republican backers who say this.

The difference is even more pronounced among voters who are disaffected with the party they backed in 2024 – who make up a quarter of each 2024 coalition: 49% of Trump voters who have an unfavorable view of the GOP today support Republican candidates for the House this year.

Much of this decline in his approval ratings over the course of his term is among Trump’s own 2024 voters – 67% of validated Trump 2024 voters approve of his job performance today while 31% disapprove.

articles.title: Trump’s Approval Rating Drops as Fewer Americans Are Confident in His Handling of the Economy, Other Issues
articles.descEn: This rating is near the lowest reached in his first term. And 31% of those who voted for him in 2024 now disapprove of his performance.
articles.titleEn: Trump’s Approval Rating Drops as Fewer Americans Are Confident in His Handling of the Economy, Other Issues
summaryLinesEn: Among Trump’s own 2024 voters, his approval rating is down particularly among Hispanic voters and younger voters: 57% of Trump’s 2024 Hispanic backers now approve of his performance in office, compared with 69% of White 2024 Trump voters. 49% of 2024 Trump voters ages 19 to 34 and 58% of those 35 to 49 approve, compared with 76% of 2024 Trump voters ages 50 and older.

For example, 35% of Americans now say they are very or somewhat confident in Trump to make good decisions about economic policy – down 7 percentage points since April and 10 percentage points since April 2025.

The decline in Trump’s approval ratings is particularly pronounced among those who voted for him in 2024, and among those who did not vote: 67% of Trump’s 2024 voters now approve of his performance, down from 75% in July, 83% at the beginning of this year and 95% early in his second term.

summaryLines: 트럼프의 2024년 유권자 중 그의 지지율은 특히 히스패닉 유권자와 젊은 유권자 사이에서 낮았음 · 트럼프의 2024년 히스패닉 지지자의 57%가 현재 그의 공직 수행을 지지하는 반면, 2024년 백인 트럼프 유권자의 69%는 이에 동의함 · 2024년 19~34세 트럼프 유권자 중 49%, 35~49세 유권자 중 58%가 찬성한 반면, 2024년 50세 이상 트럼프 유권자 중 76%가 찬성함
예를 들어, 현재 미국인의 35%는 트럼프가 경제 정책에 대해 올바른 결정을 내릴 것이라고 매우 또는 어느 정도 확신한다고 답함 · 이는 4월 이후 7% 포인트, 2025년 4월 이후 10% 포인트 감소한 수치임
트럼프의 지지율 하락은 2024년에 그에게 투표한 사람들과 투표하지 않은 사람들 사이에서 특히 두드러짐 · 트럼프의 2024년 유권자 중 67%가 그의 성과를 지지함 · 이는 7월의 75%, 올해 초 83%, 두 번째 임기 초 95%에서 감소한 수치임

articles.title: Midterm Vote Preferences by Race and Ethnicity, Age and Other Demographics
articles.descEn: With several weeks until Election Day, registered voters favor Democratic House candidates over Republicans by an 8-point margin.
articles.titleEn: Midterm Vote Preferences by Race and Ethnicity, Age and Other Demographics
summaryLinesEn: For example, 46% of those eligible voted in the 2022 midterm elections .

With several weeks to go until Election Day, Americans who are registered to vote favor Democrats over Republicans in the national race for the House of Representatives by an 8 percentage point margin (44% to 36%).
Voters ages 50 and older are more divided: Voters ages 18 to 29 prefer Democrats over Republicans by a two-to-one margin: 51% to 23%.

articles.title: Economy Ranks as Top Issue in Midterms for All Voters – But Partisans Differ Over the Importance of Other Issues
articles.descEn: Clear majorities of Republican and Democratic voters also say the future of democracy is very important to their vote.
articles.titleEn: Economy Ranks as Top Issue in Midterms for All Voters – But Partisans Differ Over the Importance of Other Issues
summaryLinesEn: The reverse is true among Democratic voters: The economy’s importance has risen 23 percentage points since 2022 (88% today vs. 65% then).
As Americans express growing concerns about economic conditions and the cost of necessities , 84% of registered voters say the economy is very important to their midterm vote.
Republican and Democratic voters differ considerably over the importance of many other issues asked about on the survey.

articles.title: Cost Concerns Dominate as Public’s Economic Ratings Turn More Negative
articles.descEn: The costs of many household essentials are a top economic concern for most Americans – much as they were four years ago on the eve of the last midterm election.
articles.titleEn: Cost Concerns Dominate as Public’s Economic Ratings Turn More Negative
summaryLinesEn: Americans’ economic ratings have ticked more negative over the last few months: Today, 21% describe economic conditions as excellent or good, while 37% say they are only fair and 42% say they are poor.

The new Pew Research Center survey of 5,062 U.S. adults, conducted from Sept. 28 to Oct. 4, 2026, also finds wide majorities saying they are very concerned about the cost of: While concerns about the job market are not as widespread, they have also risen in recent months: 48% now say they are very concerned about people who want to work being unable to find jobs, up from 44% in July and substantially higher than the 29% who said this in October 2022.

Most Americans see Donald Trump’s economic policies as hurting the economy: Republicans are divided over the impact of Trump’s policies – a shift over the last year : 39% say Trump’s policies have made economic conditions better – down from 47% last fall and 57% in January. 35% say his policies have made things worse – up from 18% at the start of the year. 25% say his policies have not had much of an effect – the same share as in January.

Most Americans see Donald Trump’s economic policies as hurting the economy: Republicans are divided over the impact of Trump’s policies – a shift over the last year : 39% say Trump’s policies have made economic conditions better – down from 47% last fall and 57% in January. 35% say his policies have made things worse – up from 18% at the start of the year. 25% say his policies have not had much of an effect – the same share as in January.

articles.title: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission
articles.descEn: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
articles.titleEn: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission
summaryLinesEn: Building on our commitment to American scientific discovery Anthropic is committing $150 million over three years to the Genesis Mission, a federal initiative to accelerate scientific and technological discovery through AI.
Earlier this week, we merged Project Glasswing into our expanded Cyber Verification Program , which gives many more defenders access to our most capable models.
As part of Project Glasswing , partners uncovered many vulnerabilities, but we haven’t yet achieved a sufficient reduction in cyber risk.

articles.title: Iran Conflict Remains Deeply Unpopular as Many Americans Expect It To Go On for Months
articles.descEn: Around two-thirds (65%) now disapprove of the way President Donald Trump is handling the U.S. military action in Iran, while a third (33%) approve.
articles.titleEn: Iran Conflict Remains Deeply Unpopular as Many Americans Expect It To Go On for Months
summaryLinesEn: Meanwhile, most Americans expect the conflict to continue for at least another six months, according to the new survey, conducted Sept.
Much of this shift has come among Democrats: 85% say they are extremely or very concerned about this, up from 79% in March.

But the partisan gap has narrowed somewhat, as Republican support for Trump’s handling of the conflict – as well as the initial decision to use military force – have declined over the last several months.

articles.title: Biomedical Imaging's Real Bottleneck Is the Data, Not the Model | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: In medical imaging and across R&D, the bottleneck is the data, not the model. A data-first case for governing, querying, and linking imaging before chasing AI.
articles.titleEn: Biomedical Imaging's Real Bottleneck Is the Data, Not the Model | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: A well-known BMJ review (Nagendran et al., 2020) of deep-learning-versus-clinician imaging studies found that of 81 studies, only a handful were prospective or tested in a real clinical setting, and code and data were unavailable in 93% and 95% of them.
Curating multi-site training data that represents the real world, then proving it to regulators through the 510(k) and PMA pathways, is both the moat and the cost.
That reproducibility debt traces straight back to how hard imaging data is to share and re-run.

summaryLinesEn: Explore the projects below to see frontier AI models such as GPT-6 Astra at work, and check back for new examples from NVIDIA teams and developers across the ecosystem.

Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs.

articles.titleEn: Introducing Funke: Native HL7v2 Parsing on Databricks | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Funke is open source and ships with a runnable demo, so you can stand up an end-to-end HL7 ingestion pipeline and explore parsed clinical data in minutes.

Decades after it was introduced, it remains the most widely deployed integration standard in the industry, and the vast majority of care organizations still depend on it for the routine flow of operational data.

Or they hand the messages to a third-party engine that flattens the hierarchy into wide tables, which means paying another vendor, moving data out of the platform, and losing direct access to the granular structure underneath.

localization.title: Funke 소개 · Databricks의 기본 HL7v2 구문 분석 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
summaryLines: Funke는 오픈 소스이며 실행 가능한 데모와 함께 제공되므로 엔드투엔드 HL7 수집 파이프라인을 구축하고 몇 분 안에 구문 분석된 임상 데이터를 탐색할 수 있음
도입된 지 수십 년이 지난 지금도 업계에서 가장 널리 배포된 통합 표준으로 남아 있으며 대다수의 의료 기관이 여전히 운영 데이터의 일상적인 흐름을 위해 이에 의존하고 있음
또는 계층 구조를 넓은 테이블로 평면화하는 타사 엔진에 메시지를 전달함 · 이는 다른 공급업체에 비용을 지불하고 데이터를 플랫폼 외부로 이동하며 그 아래의 세분화된 구조에 대한 직접 액세스를 잃게 된다는 것을 의미함

articles.title: Study in The Lancet suggests AI could improve patient-physician relationships.
articles.descEn: A peer-reviewed study in The Lancet evaluates Google's AMIE medical AI in a real-world primary care clinic.
articles.titleEn: Study in The Lancet suggests AI could improve patient-physician relationships.
summaryLinesEn: And clinicians reported that the AI summaries helped them prepare for visits in 75% of cases and influenced their approach to care in more than half.

While larger clinical trials are needed to assess patient-facing AI at scale, the findings suggest the potential for AI to enhance the patient-physician relationship and ease the strain on healthcare workers.
A study led by researchers at Google and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC) and published in The Lancet today, offers an encouraging first look.

articles.title: Announcing Workday Data Connect federation in Unity Catalog | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Workday Data Connect federation is now in Beta on Databricks. Query Workday HR and finance data in place. Govern access through Unity Catalog, and join HR and finance data with the rest of your enterprise data.
articles.titleEn: Announcing Workday Data Connect federation in Unity Catalog | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Unlock workforce and financial insights with Genie: Use the new Workday Data Connect connector (Beta) to query current people and financial data in place, combine it with customer, market, and operational data already in Databricks, and enable Genie-powered natural-language exploration, real-time financial planning, workforce analytics, and AI on trusted, governed data.

We're excited to announce the publicly available Beta of the Workday Data Connect federation connector for Unity Catalog, built for data platform and analytics teams that need Workday HR and finance data alongside the rest of their enterprise data in Databricks.
The release builds on our partnership announced at Workday Rising 2025 , where Databricks was named a Workday Data Cloud launch partner.

articles.title: AI startup Manus raises $500 million in first funding round since Meta breakup
articles.descEn: The deal is handing the AI agent developer fresh capital after Beijing forced Meta to unwind its roughly $2 billion acquisition.
articles.titleEn: AI startup Manus raises $500 million in first funding round since Meta breakup
summaryLinesEn: Manus has raised more than $500 million in its first funding round since U.S.-based Meta Platforms was forced to reverse its acquisition.
The company launched in early 2025 in China, then moved its staff to Singapore after winning backing from U.S. venture firm Benchmark.
Bloomberg reported last month that Manus was set to double its valuation in this financing round to $4 billion, what would make it the country's most valuable AI agent maker.

articles.title: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
articles.descEn: OpenAI has told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed.
articles.titleEn: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed, lower than the the $68 billion figure widely reported late last month.
A person familiar with the matter said the $68 billion figure included gross revenue from OpenAI's partners, which helps investors make a more direct comparison with Anthropic.
Nvidia shares fell 3%, Oracle shares fell nearly 6% and CoreWeave shares slipped nearly 8% on Thursday.

Nvidia shares fell 3%, Oracle shares fell nearly 6% and CoreWeave shares slipped nearly 8% on Thursday.

articles.title: Introducing AWS Physical AI Toolchain | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: End-to-End solution for Training and Deploying Physical AI Policies on AWS at Scale Physical AI is artificial intelligence that operates in the real world through robots, autonomous vehicles, and smart factories. According to the Capgemini Research Institute, 79% of organizations are already engaging with Physical AI, and 60% of executives believe that physical AI will […]
articles.titleEn: Introducing AWS Physical AI Toolchain | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: A single Physical AI workflow spans high-bandwidth GPU clusters for foundation model training, elastic mid-tier GPU capacity for physics simulation, and edge GPUs for real-time inference on the robot.
The toolchain does not impose a fixed sequence, rather it provides infrastructure for every transition in the flywheel.

According to the Capgemini Research Institute , 79% of organizations are already engaging with Physical AI, and 60% of executives believe that physical AI will enable robotics adoption in areas that were once impossible or impractical.

articles.title: Does Arista Networks (ANET) Have An Edge In AI Rack Scale Ethernet?
articles.descEn: Arista Networks (NYSE:ANET) announced a new open Ethernet rack-scale portfolio for AI infrastructure, targeting high-density data center deployments. The portfolio is designed for scale-up and scale-out AI networking, with advanced resiliency features and liquid-cooled rack architectures. Arista is collaborating with major hardware and cloud partners on these rack-scale Ethernet solutions, using open standards-based designs. The launch of Arista's liquid-cooled, open Ethernet rack-scale AI...
articles.titleEn: Does Arista Networks (ANET) Have An Edge In AI Rack Scale Ethernet?
summaryLinesEn: The clearest checkpoint is how much of Arista's at least US$3.5b to US$3.6b guided AI fabrics revenue for 2026 actually comes from these rack-scale Ethernet platforms and related ESUN based offerings by 2028.
It also raises the stakes on a key risk in that story, since larger AI focused supply commitments and customer concentration could cut into margins if demand slows or AI data center policy tightens.
The new Ethernet rack-scale designs line up directly with the high-bandwidth AI fabrics Arista already targets, including liquid-cooled racks supporting up to 144 accelerators.

summaryLinesEn: Prompts and image views are poor carriers for such constraints, requiring the need for an explicit control interface.

Each latent region can therefore receive the part of the constraint that matters for its spatial location.

articles.titleEn: GSMA Reports: India’s Next Digital Chapter Must Turn Scale into Economic Growth and Trust
summaryLinesEn: The opportunity now is to turn that scale into innovation, enterprise growth and trusted digital services,” said Vivek Badrinath, Director General of the GSMA , during his keynote speech at IMC.

articles.title: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO
articles.descEn: A Blog post by NVIDIA on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO
summaryLinesEn: Starting from Nemotron 3, our teams used supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and feedback-driven inference to create systems that reached gold-medal level at both IMO 2026 and IOI 2026 .
That finding guided the competition-specific Ultra-CC system used for IOI 2026, which scored 535.4 out of 600.
With GenCorrect, our iterative generate-evaluate-refine strategy, it reached 468 points and crossed the gold threshold of 438.3.
articles.summary:
Starting from Nemotron 3, our teams used supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and feedback-driven inference to create systems that reached gold-medal level at both IMO 2026 and IOI 2026 .
That finding guided the competition-specific Ultra-CC system used for IOI 2026, which scored 535.4 out of 600.
With GenCorrect, our iterative generate-evaluate-refine strategy, it reached 468 points and crossed the gold threshold of 438.3.

summaryLines: Nemotron 3부터 우리 팀은 감독된 미세 조정(SFT), 강화 학습(RL) 및 피드백 기반 추론을 사용하여 IMO 2026 및 IOI 2026에서 모두 금메달 수준에 도달한 시스템을 만들었음

반복적인 생성-평가-정제 전략인 GenCordirect를 사용하면 468포인트에 도달하고 438.3의 골드 임계값을 넘었음

articles.descEn: A Blog post by Technology Innovation Institute on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Introducing Falcon ASR
summaryLinesEn: In our evaluation, Falcon-ASR achieved an average word error rate of 20.92% across six Arabic test sets, compared with the best published result of 23.17% in the leaderboard snapshot we used.
In our evaluation on the seven public English test sets used by the Hugging Face Open ASR Leaderboard, it achieved a mean WER of 5.74%.
In our internal Emirati evaluation, Falcon-ASR achieved 22.73% WER and 10.19% CER: Falcon-ASR has the lowest WER and CER among the systems compared here.

articles.title: What Do Health and Wellness Influencers Post About?
articles.descEn: Just over half of health and wellness content on social media focuses on healthy living, while about a third discusses medical topics. And 38% of posts have a product or service promotion.
articles.titleEn: What Do Health and Wellness Influencers Post About?
summaryLinesEn: This includes topics like: Fitness and exercise (25% of posts mention this): In our 2025 survey , more Americans said they often get fitness information from health and wellness influencers than any other topic.

This includes topics like: Treatments or interventions that require a prescription or the assistance of a medical professional (14%) Personal life experiences with a condition, a treatment or with the broader healthcare system (11%) There is also a great deal of overlap between these topics.

… and promote products or services in more than one-third of posts % of posts that promote a product, service or subscription To examine this question, Pew Research Center collected and analyzed more than half a million social media posts from more than 6,000 health and wellness influencers from February to April 2026.

localization.title: 건강 및 웰빙 영향력 있는 사람들은 무엇에 대해 게시합니까
summaryLines: 여기에는 다음과 같은 주제가 포함됨 · 피트니스 및 운동(게시물 중 25%가 이를 언급함): 2025년 설문 조사에서 더 많은 미국인이 다른 어떤 주제보다 건강 및 웰빙 영향력 있는 사람들로부터 피트니스 정보를 얻는 경우가 많다고 말함
여기에는 다음과 같은 주제가 포함됨 · 처방이나 의료 전문가의 도움이 필요한 치료 또는 중재(14%) 특정 질환, 치료 또는 더 넓은 의료 시스템에 대한 개인적인 삶의 경험(11%) 또한 이러한 주제 간에는 상당한 중복이 있음
… 그리고 게시물의 3분의 1 이상에서 제품이나 서비스를 홍보함 · 제품, 서비스 또는 구독을 홍보하는 게시물의 % 이 질문을 조사하기 위해 Pew Research Center는 2026년 2월부터 4월까지 6,000명 이상의 건강 및 웰니스 영향력자로부터 50만 개가 넘는 소셜 미디어 게시물을 수집하고 분석함

articles.title: We're making it easier to identify AI-generated content globally.
articles.descEn: We’re launching a standalone platform to help you easily identify whether online content was created using Google AI or tools from our industry partners.
articles.titleEn: We're making it easier to identify AI-generated content globally.
summaryLinesEn: To date, we've watermarked over 180 billion images and videos, along with 240,000 years of audio content.
Last year, we introduced an early version of the SynthID Detector to help media professionals verify AI-generated content.
As AI tools become better and easier to use, having clear context about the content you encounter online helps you make informed decisions about what to trust.

articles.title: AI transformation across the infrastructure lifecycle
articles.descEn: Learn how we're connecting insights across silicon, systems, supply chain, and fleet operations to evolve the infrastructure behind AI.
articles.titleEn: AI transformation across the infrastructure lifecycle
summaryLinesEn: At Microsoft, Azure Hardware Systems and Infrastructure works across that lifecycle, from systems architecture and design through supply chain, deployment, and fleet operations across Azure’s more than 80 regions and 500 datacenter campuses.
For rack managers, prediction provides up to three days of advance warning, enabling proactive recovery that cuts out-of-service repairs by 40%.

Every month, demand-planning teams forecast Azure’s infrastructure needs years into the future, accounting for changing customer demand, regional needs, installed capacity, and decommissioning activity.

summaryLinesEn: A year ago, an MIT study showed that 90% of AI projects never saw the light of day and yet now token-maxxing is top of mind for CFOs.

articles.title: Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Liquid AI on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge
summaryLinesEn: Multimodal: d1-3B supports text and images, while d1-omni-600M supports text and images or text and audio Fast: d1-3B answers a question in 16 ms on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor, 26 ms on a Jetson AGX Orin, and 50ms on a Jetson Orin Nano These open d1 decision models are built on our Liquid Foundation Models (LFMs).

Reach for d1 decision models when you need fast, structured decisions, including multimodal inputs. d1-3B delivers the highest decision quality at its size, while d1-omni-600M fits where footprint matters.

Unlike our generative models, decision models don’t produce tokens but answer in a single forward pass. d1-3B and d1-omni-600M are trained from two very different backbones: d1-3B is trained from LFM2.5-VL-3B , our latest VLM, which is decoder-only.

localization.title: 에지에 대한 다중 모드 개방형 d1 결정 모델
summaryLines: 멀티모달 · d1-3B는 텍스트와 이미지를 지원하고, d1-omni-600M은 텍스트와 이미지 또는 텍스트와 오디오를 지원함 · 빠름 · d1-3B는 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor에서 16ms, Jetson AGX Orin에서 26ms, Jetson Orin Nano에서 50ms 내에 질문에 답변함 · 이러한 개방형 d1 결정 모델은 LFM(액체 기초 모델)을 기반으로 구축됨
다중 모드 입력을 포함하여 빠르고 구조화된 결정이 필요한 경우 d1 결정 모델을 활용하세요 · d1-3B는 해당 규모에서 최고의 의사 결정 품질을 제공하는 반면, d1-omni-600M은 설치 공간이 중요한 곳에 적합함
생성 모델과 달리 의사결정 모델은 토큰을 생성하지 않고 단일 전달 패스로 응답함 · d1-3B 및 d1-omni-600M은 매우 다른 두 개의 백본에서 훈련됨 · d1-3B는 디코더 전용인 최신 VLM인 LFM2.5-VL-3B에서 훈련됨

articles.title: Secret protection must scale with software
articles.descEn: The tools that let developers create more software should also take on more of the work of protecting it.
articles.titleEn: Secret protection must scale with software
summaryLinesEn: Between Q2 2024 and Q2 2026, screened pushes grew 2.84 times while pushes carrying credentials grew 2.59 times .
If developers and agents move faster, we have a responsibility to ensure protection keeps up with the accelerated rate of code creation.
We’re accelerating the creation of software while exposed credentials can remain usable for weeks or months, because human remediation can’t scale at the same pace as development.

articles.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 on AWS | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS. According to Anthropic, it is the fastest, most efficient model in the Claude 5.5 family, built for subagents and high-volume, cost-sensitive work, and costs around 75% less than Claude Haiku 4.5 for most tasks. This post covers its improvements and how to get started.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 on AWS | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: It also costs around 75 percent less than Claude Haiku 4.5 for most tasks.
According to Anthropic, Claude Haiku 5.5 is the fastest and most efficient model in the Claude 5.5 family, built for subagents and high-volume, cost-sensitive work.
Haiku 5.5 can be used as a strong computer use subagent for repetitive browser and desktop tasks, at a cost that holds up at scale.

articles.descEn: Introducing fleming-1, Sierra’s own model for detecting when the caller on a phone call is another agent.
articles.titleEn: Caller ID in the age of agents
summaryLinesEn: Caller ID never told you whether to pick up. fleming-1 works the same way: it’s for companies to decide how they want to handle these calls.
In 1988, BellSouth launched Caller ID in Memphis, Tennessee.
Caller ID ended up on every phone because people found it useful.

articles.descEn: 中国通信機器大手の中興通訊（ZTE）のAIエージェントフォン「NaviX Ultra」は、中国ネット大手の字節跳動（バイトダンス）のAIアシスタント「豆包（ドウバオ）」を搭載。音声指示1つで複数のアプリをまたぐ複雑なタスクを実行できる。

localization.title: Meta의 Muse, 모바일 데뷔 한 달 만에 iPad 출시
summaryLines: 시장 정보 회사인 센서 타워(Sensor Tower)의 추정에 따르면 Muse는 9월 8일 iOS와 Android에서 출시된 이후 660만 건의 설치를 돌파함
이 기술은 아직 새로운 기술이기 때문에 웹사이트가 에이전트를 봇으로 착각하고 액세스를 차단함으로써 이러한 경험에 여전히 문제가 발생할 수 있음

Jagmeet Singh의 설립자는 숙련된 외국인 노동자를 위한 영주권 프로그램에서 Microsoft, Adobe 및 주요 IT 회사를 금지함 · Aisha Malik Elon Musk는 Starlink India 출시가 지연됨에 따라 Ambani의 영향력에 의문을 제기함 · Jagmeet Singh Cal AI의 19세 창업자는 자신의 새로운 AI 스타트업인 Julie Bort를 위해 방금 천만 달러를 모금함 · Google은 새로운 현지 최초의 Granola 경쟁자인 Ivan Mehta를 출시함

articles.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
articles.descEn: Claude Haiku 5.5 is our fastest, most capable small model. Built for high-volume work like summarization, subagents, and browser use.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
summaryLinesEn: 2 Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced 90% lower than Claude Haiku 4.5 for requests up to 100,000 tokens, and 50% lower for requests over 100,000 tokens.
While a bigger model builds the deck, a Haiku 5.5 subagent goes into the 10-K and pulls the segment revenue line the deck needs.
Cache reads now cost 50% less: $0.10 per million tokens rather than $0.20.

articles.title: Apple may have to officially support Apple Intelligence removal on Macs to protect sales
articles.descEn: You only have to read some of the comments right here to see that there’s a vocal minority of people...
articles.titleEn: Apple may have to officially support Apple Intelligence removal on Macs to protect sales
summaryLinesEn: That led indie developer Om Lahore to create a project called RemoveMacAI.

We warned yesterday that this could be a risky thing to do, but it’s now being suggested that Apple may have to officially support an AI removal feature in order to protect hardware sales … There’s been growing pushback against generative AI in general, with opponents citing reasons ranging from fearing for the survival of the human species down to simply not wanting unwanted AI features to take up storage space on their devices.
The latest Apple Intelligence models can require up to 14GB of storage, so there’s a significant hit to 256GB machines if you don’t want the features.

The latest Apple Intelligence models can require up to 14GB of storage, so there’s a significant hit to 256GB machines if you don’t want the features.
localization.title: Apple은 판매 보호를 위해 Mac에서 Apple Intelligence 제거를 공식적으로 지원해야 할 수도 있음
summaryLines: 이로 인해 인디 개발자 Om Lahore는 RemoveMacAI라는 프로젝트를 만들게 됨

우리는 어제 이것이 위험한 일이 될 수 있다고 경고했지만, 이제는 Apple이 하드웨어 판매를 보호하기 위해 AI 제거 기능을 공식적으로 지원해야 할 수도 있다는 제안이 나오고 있음 · 일반적으로 생성 AI에 대한 반발이 커지고 있으며 반대자들은 인류의 생존을 두려워하는 것부터 단순히 원치 않는 AI 기능이 장치의 저장 공간을 차지하는 것을 원하지 않는 것까지 다양한 이유를 언급하고 있음
최신 Apple Intelligence 모델에는 최대 14GB의 저장 공간이 필요할 수 있으므로 해당 기능을 원하지 않으면 256GB 시스템이 큰 타격을 입을 수 있음

summaryLines: 가장 낙관적인 분석가 중 일부는 이미 2029년까지 약 261억 달러의 매출과 약 111억 달러의 수익을 예상하고 있으며, 수출 제한 및 고객 집중에 관한 최근 뉴스가 진화하는 위험을 해석하는 방법에 따라 이러한 예측을 높이거나 낮출 수 있음에도 불구하고 AI 기반 프로세스 제어 강도가 KLA가 이전 기대를 뛰어넘을 수 있는 이유라고 보고 있음
최근 KLA Corporation은 분석가들이 칩 부족을 완화하고 AI 중심 반도체 제조를 지원하는 데 필수적인 프로세스 제어 역할을 강조하는 동시에 미국 수출 제한 및 주기적인 웨이퍼 장비 지출로 인한 지속적인 위험을 지적하면서 다시 주목을 받았음
KLA 연구를 위한 좋은 출발점은 투자 결정에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 2가지 주요 보상과 1가지 중요한 경고 신호를 강조하는 분석임

articles.title: Why Telecom Operators Are Building Their AI Strategy on Open Models
articles.descEn: Telecom operators are increasingly building their AI strategies on open models — and the reasons go beyond mere cost.
articles.titleEn: Why Telecom Operators Are Building Their AI Strategy on Open Models
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA’s latest State of AI in Telecommunications report reflects this shift, with 89% of respondents reporting that open source models and software are important to their company’s AI strategy.
Telecom operators are increasingly building their AI strategies on open models — and the reasons go beyond mere cost.

To help operators customize the Nemotron 3 LTM and other open models with their own operational data, NVIDIA released the full recipe that walks through the end-to-end fine-tuning pipeline for adapting open models to operator-specific networks, customers and procedures using NVIDIA NeMo open libraries.

summaryLines: NVIDIA의 최신 통신 분야 AI 현황 보고서는 이러한 변화를 반영하며, 응답자의 89%는 오픈 소스 모델과 소프트웨어가 회사의 AI 전략에 중요하다고 보고함
통신 사업자는 점점 더 개방형 모델을 기반으로 AI 전략을 구축하고 있으며 그 이유는 단순한 비용 이상의 것임
운영자가 자체 운영 데이터로 Nemotron 3 LTM 및 기타 개방형 모델을 사용자 정의할 수 있도록 NVIDIA는 NVIDIA NeMo 개방형 라이브러리를 사용하여 개방형 모델을 운영자별 네트워크, 고객 및 절차에 맞게 조정하기 위한 엔드투엔드 미세 조정 파이프라인을 안내하는 전체 레시피를 공개함

articles.title: Introducing Personal Agent Protocol
articles.descEn: We’re excited to announce Personal Agent Protocol — an open standard Meta and Sierra are developing along with industry partners at Genesys, Instinct, Rocket, Shopify, Stripe, and Walmart that defines how personal agents interact with businesses.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Personal Agent Protocol
summaryLinesEn: Personal Agent Protocol gives them that foundation — so the company and the personal agent can get the job done for the customer they share.
When a task requires access to a customer’s account, they can sign in on the company’s page or use credentials they have already set up with their personal agent.

Everyone wants security, but they have different needs, too: Consumers want speed, dependability, and trust — for the job to be done right the first time, by a personal agent they can count on to act in their best interests.

articles.title: Ask a Scientist: How are researchers using AI to help pregnant women access ultrasounds?
articles.descEn: Google researchers used AI and blind sweep ultrasounds to accurately detect fetal age. See how this technology expands prenatal care access.
articles.titleEn: Ask a Scientist: How are researchers using AI to help pregnant women access ultrasounds?
summaryLinesEn: With this approach, they were able to detect important prenatal information, like gestational age and fetal presentation, as accurately as a trained sonographer, giving women in under-resourced areas better information about what to expect ahead of one of the most significant events of their lives.

In a recent study, healthcare workers were trained to perform simpler ultrasounds and used AI to interpret the results, enabling Google researchers to help more people get the prenatal ultrasounds they need.
Nichole: The goal of our research is to show how expanded access to life-saving ultrasound care could impact communities, and we’re getting there one step at a time.

summaryLines: 이 접근 방식을 통해 그들은 훈련된 초음파 검사자만큼 정확하게 임신 연령 및 태아의 모습과 같은 중요한 산전 정보를 감지할 수 있었고, 자원이 부족한 지역의 여성에게 인생에서 가장 중요한 사건 중 하나를 앞두고 무엇을 기대할 수 있는지에 대한 더 나은 정보를 제공할 수 있었음
최근 연구에서 의료 종사자들은 더 간단한 초음파 검사를 수행하도록 교육을 받았으며 AI를 사용하여 결과를 해석함으로써 Google 연구원들은 더 많은 사람들이 필요한 산전 초음파 검사를 받을 수 있도록 도울 수 있었음
Nichole: 우리 연구의 목표는 생명을 구하는 초음파 치료에 대한 접근성이 지역 사회에 어떻게 영향을 미칠 수 있는지 보여주는 것이며 한 번에 한 단계씩 목표에 도달하고 있음

articles.titleEn: Microsoft named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Industrial AIoT Platforms | Microsoft Azure Blog
summaryLinesEn: Industrial organizations are contending with skilled labor shortages, supply chain volatility, increasing customization demands, and growing operational complexity.
It is a transition from connected operations to learning operations, where every cycle of understanding, reasoning, action, measurement, and learning improves the next outcome.

articles.title: Silicon Valley's AI wunderkind launches Underdog, the most private Instinct/Muse competitor yet
articles.descEn: Sigil Wen, backed by a Silicon Valley who's who, has built an on-device AI assistant that promises to be free, fully private, and capable for everyday tasks.
articles.titleEn: Silicon Valley's AI wunderkind launches Underdog, the most private Instinct/Muse competitor yet
summaryLinesEn: Its founder wants to bring it back Jagmeet Singh US bars Microsoft, Adobe, and major IT firms from green card program for skilled foreign workers Aisha Malik Elon Musk questions Ambani’s influence as Starlink India launch stalls Jagmeet Singh Cal AI’s 19-year-old founder just raised $10M for his new AI startup Julie Bort Google releases a new local-first Granola competitor Ivan Mehta

Now a Thiel Fellow — the program from investor Peter Thiel that invites young founders to pursue projects instead of college — Wen on Monday launched an invite-only beta of Underdog, one of the most private AI assistants Silicon Valley has yet to offer.
He says that means it can handle the everyday tasks that people want an AI assistant to do, like shopping research or answering math homework questions.

Hua Hong Grace Semiconductor Limited Overview Semiconductors / Technology

Hua Hong Grace Semiconductor Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor products in China, North America, Asia, and Europe. The company offers embedded non-volatile memory; standalone non-volatile memory, including NOR flash and EEPROM; power discrete devices; analog and power management platform; and specialty logic RF processes and image sensors. It also provides design services which covers design methodologies and design flow support, standard and customized internet protocol development, ASIC design, and one-stop services; multi-project wafer services; mask marking services; and backend, testing development, mass production, product engineering, and backside processing services. In addition, the company engages in real estate development; and trading activities. Its products are used in consumer electronics, industrial control, automotive electronics, Internet of Things, and communications and computers applications. Hua Hong Grace Semiconductor Limited was formerly known as Hua Hong Semiconductor Limited and changed its name to Hua Hong Grace Semiconductor Limited in May 2026. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

articles.title: Kuaishou’s Kling AI targets Hong Kong IPO, may raise at least $1 bln - Bloomberg
articles.descEn: Investing.com-- Kuaishou Technology's (HK:1024) Kling AI video platform has selected banks for a Hong Kong initial public offering that could raise at least $1 billion, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
articles.titleEn: Kuaishou’s Kling AI targets Hong Kong IPO, may raise at least $1 bln - Bloomberg
summaryLinesEn: Investing.com-- Kuaishou Technology's (HK:1024) Kling AI video platform has selected banks for a Hong Kong initial public offering that could raise at least $1 billion, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.

Kling, launched in 2024, raised $2.8 billion in July from investors including Alibaba Group, Tencent Holdings and Baidu, valuing the company at about $15 billion before the funding, according to Bloomberg.
Hong Kong-listed Kuaishou shares rose 3% to HK$30.38 by 03:57 GMT on Tuesday.

summaryLines: Investing.com-- Kuaishou Technology(HK:1024)의 Kling AI 비디오 플랫폼이 최소 10억 달러를 조달할 수 있는 홍콩 기업공개(IPO)를 위해 은행을 선정했다고 Bloomberg News가 이 문제에 정통한 소식통을 인용하여 화요일 보도함

홍콩 상장 Kuaishou 주가는 화요일 03:57 GMT까지 3% 상승한 HK$30.38을 기록함

articles.title: Mistral unveils new AI model it says rivals best open systems from China
articles.descEn: Western developers are racing to compete with Chinese companies in open weight and open source AI.
articles.titleEn: Mistral unveils new AI model it says rivals best open systems from China
summaryLinesEn: Long considered Europe's only answer to OpenAI and Anthropic, Mistral raised a 3 billion euros ($3.4 billion) Series D in September at a 21 billion euro valuation.
Nvidia-backed American startup Reflection AI unveiled its first open model on Monday, which it claimed matched the capability of GLM 5.2, which was surpassed by GLM 5.3 in August.
The company added that ML4 was the strongest open-weight model developed outside China by a "substantial margin."

The company added that ML4 was the strongest open-weight model developed outside China by a "substantial margin."

summaryLines: 오랫동안 OpenAI와 Anthropic에 대한 유럽의 유일한 해답으로 여겨졌던 Mistral은 지난 9월에 210억 유로의 평가액으로 30억 유로(34억 달러)의 시리즈 D를 유치함
Nvidia가 지원하는 미국 스타트업 Reflection AI는 월요일 첫 번째 공개 모델을 공개했는데, 이는 8월 GLM 5.3을 능가한 GLM 5.2의 기능과 일치한다고 주장함
회사는 ML4가 중국 이외 지역에서 개발된 가장 강력한 개방형 중량 모델이라고 덧붙였음

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Lila Ibrahim, world's top AI 'readiness' officer, on preparing for what's to come
articles.descEn: Google DeepMind Chief AI Readiness Officer Lila Ibrahim may be the only person with that title, and as intelligence risks rise, she takes it very seriously.
articles.titleEn: Google DeepMind's Lila Ibrahim, world's top AI 'readiness' officer, on preparing for what's to come
summaryLinesEn: Ibrahim breaks down her daily AI use case method into three questions that she asks all team members: That third question is the human talent element, and she said it is critical.
Lila Ibrahim has been with DeepMind since 2018 and recently shifted from the role of chief operating officer to her new "AI readiness" C-suite title.

"Teachers always have to be in the lead with the students to say how do we explore the boundaries for what makes sense with with AI," she said, but she added that students need to "grow up more literate in what the technology is and isn't, and also what are responsible use cases for it."

localization.title: Google DeepMind의 Lila Ibrahim, 세계 최고의 AI '준비' 책임자, 앞으로 다가올 일에 대한 준비
summaryLines: Ibrahim은 일상적인 AI 사용 사례 방법을 모든 팀원에게 묻는 세 가지 질문으로 분류함 · 세 번째 질문은 인적 재능 요소이며 그녀는 그것이 중요하다고 말함
Lila Ibrahim은 2018년부터 DeepMind에 근무했으며 최근 최고 운영 책임자(COO) 역할에서 새로운 "AI 준비" 최고 경영진 직위로 자리를 옮겼음
그녀는 "교사는 항상 학생들과 함께 AI를 사용하여 의미 있는 경계를 어떻게 탐색할 수 있는지에 대해 이야기해야 함" · 라고 그녀는 말함 · 그러나 학생들은 "기술이 무엇인지 아닌지, 그리고 기술의 책임 있는 사용 사례가 무엇인지에 대해 더 많은 지식을 갖고 성장해야 합니다"라고 덧붙였음

summaryLinesEn: Alongside a redesigned system for orchestrating multistep agent work, the update gives administrators new controls for capping token spending.

summaryLines: 다단계 에이전트 작업을 조정하기 위해 재설계된 시스템과 함께 업데이트는 관리자에게 토큰 지출 한도에 대한 새로운 제어 기능을 제공함

localization.title: GSMA, 새 이사회 구성원 선출
summaryLines: 이사회와 협력하여 우리의 우선순위는 투자와 혁신을 가속화하고, 디지털 안전과 신뢰를 강화하며, 연결성과 AI의 이점이 모든 곳의 사람과 기업에 도달하도록 보장하는 것입니다”라고 GSMA 회장 Gopal Vittal이 말함
"우리는 새로운 이사회 구성원과 재선된 이사회 구성원을 환영하게 되어 기쁘게 생각하며, 퇴임하는 구성원들의 탁월한 서비스와 지원에 감사드림"
GSMA는 2027년 1월부터 2028년 12월까지 봉사할 26명의 이사회를 지명함 · 2026년 10월 5일, 런던 · GSMA는 2027년 1월 1일부터 2028년 12월 31일까지 2년 임기의 GSMA 이사회의 새로운 구성원을 선출함

articles.title: From Scan to Treatment Plan, AI Helps Close Breast Cancer’s Deadliest Gaps
articles.descEn: NVIDIA Inception companies are applying AI to each stage of the breast cancer care journey — imaging, risk assessment and treatment decisions.
articles.titleEn: From Scan to Treatment Plan, AI Helps Close Breast Cancer’s Deadliest Gaps
summaryLinesEn: The company’s FDA-cleared ATUSA platform — a wearable, automated 3D quantitative ultrasound system — captures a standardized breast volume in approximately two minutes per breast, compared with up to 45 minutes for a conventional handheld ultrasound.
The companies below are addressing both ends of that gap, and everything in between, accelerated by NVIDIA AI infrastructure.
It has also built a tool to estimate the risk of breast cancer recurrence based on 3D volumetric data from a patient’s breast MRI, tumor pathology and clinical data.

articles.title: Arm and NVIDIA: Building the trusted compute foundation for the agentic AI era
articles.descEn: Arm and NVIDIA are advancing secure agentic AI, with Arm compute powering agent workloads and independent infrastructure security across the trust boundary.
articles.titleEn: Arm and NVIDIA: Building the trusted compute foundation for the agentic AI era
summaryLinesEn: Arm technology is deployed across every major hyperscaler, and Arm-based rack-scale servers have now overtaken x86 as the dominant platform for accelerated computing, according to IDC .

📱 Built on Arm, the flagship 12 Pro features the @MediaTek Dimensity 8400 with Arm Cortex-A725 CPUs and Mali-G720 graphics, delivering performance and power efficiency for everyday experiences. 10 years of micro:bit!
Agentic infrastructure also needs independent compute that can observe, isolate and govern policies outside the environment where the agent itself is running.

articles.title: ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review
articles.descEn: ReviewBench is a benchmark for code review agents built on representative GitHub pull requests, multi-source ground truth, and calibrated evaluation.
articles.titleEn: ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review
summaryLinesEn: We analyzed 103.9 million GitHub pull requests to characterize the real-world distribution of code review workloads.

A good code review benchmark should reflect the diversity of real pull requests, capture a broad set of review findings, and support meaningful breakdowns by severity, category, and precision-recall preferences.

Just as important, with the help of ReviewBench, our offline evaluation of Copilot code review (CCR) has become more effective at anticipating the direction of production experiments, giving us greater confidence that measured improvements reflect meaningful gains for users.

Just as important, with the help of ReviewBench, our offline evaluation of Copilot code review (CCR) has become more effective at anticipating the direction of production experiments, giving us greater confidence that measured improvements reflect meaningful gains for users.

articles.title: Norway floats temporary but total ban on AI glasses as it investigates 'socially beneficial uses' | Fortune
articles.descEn: Officials want a temporary ban as smart glasses make it easier to photograph, film and record people without their knowledge.
articles.titleEn: Norway floats temporary but total ban on AI glasses as it investigates 'socially beneficial uses' | Fortune
summaryLinesEn: The government was quick to note that it was not proposing a total ban on AI glasses or other “wearable technology,” adding that such devices should still be allowed in some places and for private use.
The government also said it was considering exceptions to the ban for vulnerable groups, so that “socially beneficial uses” of smart glasses could be permitted in some circumstances.
Norway’s government wants to get a handle on both the promise and peril of AI glasses, and is proposing that parliament enact a temporary ban on them in some places.

Lam Research Corporation LRCX sees a major opportunity in NAND as AI workloads increase demand for high-capacity and fast-access storage. The company expects its served available market (SAM) per wafer in NAND to double from 128-layer technology to 500-plus-layer devices. This potential expansion could create a significant growth opportunity for Lam Research as memory makers move toward more complex architectures.

AI is an important factor behind this shift. Larger AI models and longer context windows require more persistent storage, increasing the need for high-density NAND. During its fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 earnings call, Lam Research revealed that customers are already increasing bit supply while converting existing equipment to 200-plus-layer NAND production. As layer counts rise, manufacturing becomes more difficult, requiring more advanced etch and deposition processes.

articles.title: A 'weird' IPO pull, a tainted reputation and the stalled breakout moment for AI wearables
articles.descEn: Apple, Google and Meta are pushing new AI devices and assistants amid growing privacy concerns around wearables.
articles.titleEn: A 'weird' IPO pull, a tainted reputation and the stalled breakout moment for AI wearables
summaryLinesEn: "If you force someone to spend $700 on a device that overheats, has a user interface that doesn't work in sunlight, battery life that is poor, unless what it does is magical, that's not going to work," said Greengart.
Meta is navigating pushback to its smart spectacles, which have been dubbed "pervert glasses" on social media because of their discreet cameras that can be used for harassment and other misbehavior.
"We're going to have to revisit this 10 years from now."

articles.title: FDR’s lesson for AI regulation | Fortune
articles.descEn: Like the financial industry of the 1930s, the AI industry is currently largely unregulated, heightening fears that it could do widespread harm.
articles.titleEn: FDR’s lesson for AI regulation | Fortune
summaryLinesEn: Bernie Sanders’ June proposal to give the public a 50% ownership stake in the largest AI companies.
Instead, he worked with Congress to create a novel mechanism for market participants to police themselves—without stifling the competition that best serves consumers and economic progress.
The SEC approves decisions from self-regulatory organizations, but the bureaucracy maintains a critical distance that allows competition to flourish.

articles.title: How to disable or restrict your iPhone's Apple Intelligence features - Engadget
articles.descEn: You have a lot of control over AI on your iPhone.
articles.titleEn: How to disable or restrict your iPhone's Apple Intelligence features - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: While there's no longer a single switch to shut down Apple Intelligence system-wide, you can still turn off many AI features in iOS 27 .
To do that, open Settings > Notifications > Prioritize Notifications , and turn the feature off. iOS supports Smart Reply, which can draft AI-powered email responses in your writing style.
These instructions are for Apple Intelligence-capable iPhones (iPhone 15 Pro or newer or iPhone 16 or newer) running iOS 27.

articles.descEn: Artificial intelligence, once a cool feature living exclusively inside your favorite app, is upgrading. Now, the shift is toward using AI as the foundation and not simply an added feature. AI is now becoming part of operating systems and amping up how we use and interact with devices. The vision: instead of requiring people to […]
articles.titleEn: How DroiClaw is building an AI-native operating system for the agentic era
summaryLinesEn: The first smartphones shipping with DroiClaw, which currently include devices from Coolpad and Philips, are priced at approximately RMB 1,099 (around US$160).
Now, the shift is toward using AI as the foundation and not simply an added feature.
DroiClaw uses a hybrid architecture that combines on-device AI with cloud-based large language models to support different usage scenarios.

For years, Qualcomm Incorporated (NASDAQ: QCOM ) has maintained its position in the mobile chip market. Its investment thesis has largely depended on smartphone demand. However, the company believes the next growth phase lies in agentic AI. It is of the view that increasingly capable AI agents will operate directly on consumer devices. At Snapdragon Summit, the company unveiled the new Snapdragon platforms designed for on-device agentic AI.

The company does not stop here. QCOM is no longer positioning itself as just a smartphone-chip company. It is expanding across AI-powered devices, automotive systems, data centers, and physical AI applications. The debate for investors is whether Qualcomm's position in on-device AI can create a durable competitive advantage and unlock a new growth cycle.

articles.titleEn: AutoSynthData: Generating Training Data for Enterprise Agents
summaryLinesEn: Workers generate independent tasks in parallel, picking up a new target when they finish.
Its instructions should be clear and avoid arbitrary constraints introduced solely to manufacture difficulty.

System specification Agent-facing task Verifier Overview From model failures to a curriculum Generating and scaling tasks Target Multiply Implementation details High-quality synthetic data needs more than generation Sample-level verification and repair Batch-level review Moving the training frontier EnterpriseOps Gym experiments Hybrid Hybrid results ITSM Closing the loop Enterprises need agents that work well in their own environments.

summaryLines: 작업자는 독립적인 작업을 병렬로 생성하고 완료되면 새 목표를 선택함
지침은 명확해야 하며 제조상의 어려움에만 도입되는 임의의 제약을 피해야 함

시스템 사양 에이전트 대면 작업 검증 도구 개요 모델 실패에서 커리큘럼까지 작업 생성 및 확장 대상 곱하기 구현 세부 정보 고품질 합성 데이터에는 생성 이상의 요구 사항 샘플 수준 검증 및 복구 배치 수준 검토 교육 경계 이동 EnterpriseOps Gym 실험 하이브리드 하이브리드 결과 ITSM 루프 닫기 기업에는 자체 환경에서 잘 작동하는 에이전트가 필요함

articles.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB Gives Developers More Ways to Build and Scale Local AI
articles.descEn: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB runs local AI agents on-device with the full NVIDIA AI stack — and clusters for greater performance as workloads grow.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB Gives Developers More Ways to Build and Scale Local AI
summaryLinesEn: DGX Spark 64GB is available from Acer , ASUS , Dell, Gigabyte , HP and MSI on Friday, Oct. 23, starting at $4,999.
DGX Spark combines NVIDIA Grace Blackwell compute, unified memory, NVIDIA ConnectX-7 networking and an NVIDIA CUDA -accelerated AI software stack in one system.

With up to 100-billion-parameter models running entirely on device, developers and enthusiasts can start with a single system for models that fit within its memory, or connect multiple DGX Spark systems with NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant for workloads that need more memory and compute.

articles.title: UNDP and GSMA partner to scale African-led AI innovation
articles.descEn: New York, 2 October 2026 – The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the GSMA have announced a strategic partnership to strengthen Africa’s artificial intelligence ecosystem and accelerate the deployment of African-led AI solutions, including African language AI. The partnership brings together the GSMA’s mobile industry expertise and networks with UNDP’s development programmes and innovation platforms […]
articles.titleEn: UNDP and GSMA partner to scale African-led AI innovation
summaryLinesEn: The collaboration aligns with the GSMA’s wider work on African-language AI through ATLAS Umoja AI , launched with government and industry partners in July 2026.

By bringing together the GSMA’s industry networks and UNDP’s innovation platforms, this partnership will help African innovators move from promising pilots towards sustainable services that support inclusive digital and economic growth.”
The partnership brings together the GSMA’s mobile industry expertise and networks with UNDP’s development programmes and innovation platforms to support African-led AI innovation.

articles.title: GIGABYTE AI TOP ATOM 64GB Unified Memory Version Expands Possibilities for Desktop AI Development
articles.descEn: GIGABYTE today announced the launch of a new 64GB unified memory version of GIGABYTE AI TOP ATOM, expanding its existing 128GB offering. Available starting October 23, the new configuration retains the hardware design of AI TOP ATOM, based on the NVIDIA DGX Spark platform, giving developers, researchers, and enterprise teams greater flexibility to select the configuration that best fits their AI workloads and memory requirements, while enabling dedicated on-premises AI development environments.
articles.titleEn: GIGABYTE AI TOP ATOM 64GB Unified Memory Version Expands Possibilities for Desktop AI Development
summaryLinesEn: The new 64GB unified memory version, together with the existing high-capacity 128GB version, creates a more comprehensive AI TOP ATOM product lineup.

Developers can explore open models, test AI assistants, or leverage their own documents to build knowledge-based question-and-answer applications, allowing them to continuously refine and validate solutions based on project requirements and accelerate the transition from ideas to real-world applications.

With the addition of the 64GB unified memory version, AI TOP ATOM is now available in both 128GB and 64GB configurations, addressing the needs of users across different stages of AI development and application scales.

articles.title: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI around music
articles.descEn: Sean Parker, who once taught the music industry what asking for forgiveness looks like, is now back with the labels' blessing and money.
articles.titleEn: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI around music
summaryLinesEn: Two years ago, he joined an $80 million rescue of Stability AI, the image-generator startup that nearly collapsed after overspending and internal turmoil led to founder Emad Mostaque’s ouster.
Provides movers and shakers with the info they need to start their day.
Toward that end, in late August, the company announced $76 million in funding from, among others, Sony, Warner, and Universal, which also licensed their catalogs for training as part of the deal.

articles.title: AI music maker Suno now generates spoken words
articles.descEn: Suno is branching out from the world of AI music, launching a new feature that generates spoken voices based on scripts or prompted descriptions.
articles.titleEn: AI music maker Suno now generates spoken words
summaryLinesEn: Suno is branching out from the world of AI music, launching a new feature that generates spoken voices based on scripts or prompted descriptions.
“Today, we’re expanding what’s possible in Suno with Speech: the first audio model that generates voice and music together as one cohesive track.”
Speech is now available in public beta across Suno’s web and mobile platforms, and allows you to simultaneously generate voiceovers and background music to accompany them.

articles.title: Why I tried to kill token billing (and why we kept it)
articles.descEn: Token billing is useful infrastructure, but usually a bad customer-facing pricing model. Your invoice should define the value your product delivers, not break down what it cost you to create it.
articles.titleEn: Why I tried to kill token billing (and why we kept it)
summaryLinesEn: For model providers, token usage is the product.
They make model-routing decisions upstream, then send the resulting token usage to Metronome—either broken out by customer or attributed to a single aggregate customer for cost tracking.
In its simplest form, passthrough pricing charges customers for the model tokens their usage consumes, plus a markup on the underlying cost.

summaryLinesEn: After nearly 18 years at LinkedIn and Microsoft, Ryan Roslansky has decided to leave Microsoft and embark on his next chapter.

summaryLinesEn: Speech opens up another canvas for that same kind of creativity.

Today, we’re expanding what's possible in Suno with Speech : the first audio model that generates voice and music together as one cohesive track.

articles.title: How NVIDIA GPUs Help Accelerate OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast
articles.descEn: Running on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs and accelerated by continuous inference optimizations through OpenAI’s models, GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast delivers faster model responses across code generation, tool use and interactive applications.
articles.titleEn: How NVIDIA GPUs Help Accelerate OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast
summaryLinesEn: “NVIDIA’s deep investment in tooling and documentation has enabled us to make our models exceptionally good at programming Blackwell and Rubin GPUs,” said Philippe Tillet, inference lead at OpenAI.

Accelerated by inference optimizations through OpenAI’s models that tap into the capabilities of the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, Ultrafast offers up to 8x faster token generation than the Astra Standard mode.
OpenAI is using its own models to help refine the inference software running on NVIDIA GPUs, taking advantage of the platform’s programmability to test and implement improvements.

localization.title: NVIDIA GPU가 OpenAI의 GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast를 가속화하는 데 어떻게 도움이 됩니까
summaryLines: OpenAI의 추론 책임자인 Philippe Tillet은 "NVIDIA는 도구 및 문서화에 대한 깊은 투자를 통해 Blackwell 및 Rubin GPU 프로그래밍에 탁월한 모델을 만들 수 있었음" · 라고 말함
NVIDIA Blackwell 아키텍처의 기능을 활용하는 OpenAI 모델을 통한 추론 최적화로 가속화된 Ultrafast는 Astra Standard 모드보다 최대 8배 빠른 토큰 생성을 제공함
OpenAI는 자체 모델을 사용하여 NVIDIA GPU에서 실행되는 추론 소프트웨어를 개선하고 플랫폼의 프로그래밍 기능을 활용하여 개선 사항을 테스트하고 구현함

articles.title: SpaceX launches Google AI chips into orbit in push toward space-based data centers
articles.descEn: Google's tensor processing units were launched into orbit on Planet Labs satellites.
articles.titleEn: SpaceX launches Google AI chips into orbit in push toward space-based data centers
summaryLinesEn: The Transporter-18 mission marks the first in-orbit test for Alphabet's Project Suncatcher, ​a "moonshot" initiative to develop reliable AI computing infrastructure in space.
Alphabet launched its homegrown AI chips into orbit on Thursday in a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, a step towards making data centers in space a reality.
Industry experts say space-based data centers represent a far-out mission, if they can even become feasible, in part because rocket launches remain capacity-constrained and expensive.

articles.title: Did Bell–Cisco Sovereign AI Pact Just Recast Cisco Systems' (CSCO) Regulated-Market Strategy?
articles.descEn: In late September 2026, Bell Canada and Cisco announced a memorandum of understanding to build a sovereign AI infrastructure platform in Canada, combining Bell’s domestic data centres and networks with Cisco’s AI, security, observability, and Sovereign Critical Infrastructure technologies for customers with strict data residency and control needs. This move highlights how Cisco is trying to embed its AI-focused networking, security, and infrastructure stack into regulated markets where...
articles.titleEn: Did Bell–Cisco Sovereign AI Pact Just Recast Cisco Systems' (CSCO) Regulated-Market Strategy?
summaryLinesEn: Some of the most optimistic analysts saw Cisco reaching about US$90.6b in revenue and US$23.0b in earnings by 2029, so this Bell Canada AI deal could either reinforce that AI cycle story or expose how dependent those bullish forecasts are on hyperscalers and sovereign projects actually sustaining their current pace.
But against those AI tailwinds, investors should also be aware that any slowdown in hyperscaler AI buildouts or shift to rival vendors could...

The Bell Canada sovereign AI MOU reinforces the AI and regulated‑sector demand story, but it does not materially change the near term gross margin headwind or the risk that investors reassess Cisco's growth and earnings multiple.

localization.title: Bell-Cisco Sovereign AI Pact가 Cisco Systems(CSCO)의 규제 시장 전략을 다시 만들었습니까
summaryLines: 가장 낙관적인 분석가 중 일부는 Cisco가 2029년까지 약 미화 906억 달러의 매출과 미화 230억 달러의 수익을 달성할 것으로 예상함 · 따라서 이번 Bell Canada AI 거래는 AI 사이클 스토리를 강화하거나 이러한 낙관적인 예측이 실제로 현재 속도를 유지하는 하이퍼스케일러 및 주권 프로젝트에 얼마나 의존하는지를 드러낼 수 있음
그러나 이러한 AI 순풍에 맞서 투자자들은 하이퍼스케일러 AI 구축이 둔화되거나 경쟁 업체로 전환할 경우
Bell Canada 주권 AI MOU는 AI 및 규제 부문 수요 스토리를 강화하지만 단기 총 마진 역풍이나 투자자가 Cisco의 성장 및 수익 배수를 재평가하는 위험을 실질적으로 바꾸지는 않음

articles.title: Instagram is adding an AI ‘assistant’ to tell you how to post
articles.descEn: Instagram will tell creators what’s working and what’s not — along with AI-generated suggestions on how to change their content.
articles.titleEn: Instagram is adding an AI ‘assistant’ to tell you how to post
summaryLinesEn: Tools like CrowdTangle, which researchers and journalists used to monitor the most popular content on Meta platforms , have been shut down or restricted .

The shift also raises interesting new questions about the relationship between tech companies and the creators that fill the platforms with things to look at: How does this dynamic change when platforms are straightforwardly giving creators instructions on how to post?
If that sounds familiar, it’s because YouTube also just announced updates to its sprawling AI-powered dashboard that tells creators how to maximize engagement.

summaryLines: 연구원과 저널리스트가 메타 플랫폼에서 가장 인기 있는 콘텐츠를 모니터링하는 데 사용했던 CrowdTangle과 같은 도구는 종료되거나 제한됨

익숙하게 들린다면 YouTube가 제작자에게 참여를 극대화하는 방법을 알려주는 광범위한 AI 기반 대시보드에 대한 업데이트도 방금 발표했기 때문임
