articles.title: SynthID Bio: Watermarking methods for synthetic biology
articles.descEn: SynthID Bio is a family of watermarking methods developed specifically for synthetic biology to strengthen biosecurity and scientific integrity.
articles.titleEn: SynthID Bio: Watermarking methods for synthetic biology
summaryLinesEn: SynthID Bio preserves AlphaFold 3 prediction accuracy while offering near-perfect detectability, maintaining key structural feature distributions, and holding up against digital noise or minor coordinate changes.

Yet these tools also present new challenges: novel AI designs can bypass traditional DNA synthesis screening, while mislabeled synthetic 3D structures risk polluting public databases and misleading downstream research.
Today, we’re introducing SynthID Bio to bring watermarking technology to synthetic biology.

articles.title: D4RT: Unified, Fast 4D Scene Reconstruction & Tracking
articles.descEn: Meet D4RT, a unified AI model for 4D scene reconstruction and tracking.
articles.titleEn: D4RT: Unified, Fast 4D Scene Reconstruction & Tracking
summaryLinesEn: Previous state-of-the-art methods could take up to ten minutes for the same task — an improvement of 120x.

Today, we are introducing D4RT (Dynamic 4D Reconstruction and Tracking) , a new AI model that unifies dynamic scene reconstruction into a single, efficient framework, bringing us closer to the next frontier of artificial intelligence: total perception of our dynamic reality.

D4RT’s simplified architecture and novel query mechanism place it at the forefront of 4D reconstruction while being up to 300x more efficient than previous methods — fast enough for real-time applications in robotics, augmented reality, and more.

Today, we are introducing D4RT (Dynamic 4D Reconstruction and Tracking) , a new AI model that unifies dynamic scene reconstruction into a single, efficient framework, bringing us closer to the next frontier of artificial intelligence: total perception of our dynamic reality.

D4RT’s simplified architecture and novel query mechanism place it at the forefront of 4D reconstruction while being up to 300x more efficient than previous methods — fast enough for real-time applications in robotics, augmented reality, and more.

articles.title: Open TTS Leaderboard: Scalable Evaluation for Multilingual Text-to-Speech and Voice Cloning
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: Open TTS Leaderboard: Scalable Evaluation for Multilingual Text-to-Speech and Voice Cloning
summaryLinesEn: The goal of the Open TTS Leaderboard is not only to keep up with the incredible pace of TTS model releases, but to be shaped by the community; we want to hear your feedback so the evaluations stay relevant and insightful.
By toggling “Voice cloning”, the models that support this functionality (on the selected languages) can be compared.

This may partly explain why open-source models are underrepresented on arena-style leaderboards: as of Sep 30, 2026, only 16 of the 92 models on Artificial Analysis are open-weights, with a similar skew on Voice Arena .

summaryLines: Open TTS 리더보드의 목표는 TTS 모델 출시의 놀라운 속도를 따라잡을 뿐만 아니라 커뮤니티에 의해 형성되는 것임 · 우리는 평가가 관련성과 통찰력을 유지하도록 귀하의 피드백을 듣고 싶음

articles.title: OUSD is now the default stablecoin on Stripe
articles.descEn: Open USD (OUSD), a stablecoin built for global money movement, is now available across Stripe. Businesses can use OUSD to manage funds, make payments, and offer new financial services.
articles.titleEn: OUSD is now the default stablecoin on Stripe
summaryLinesEn: While most businesses don’t earn rewards on stablecoin activity, businesses that join Open Standard as a partner can earn rewards based on OUSD activity—including their OUSD balances on Stripe—creating greater value as their usage increases.
As we roll out additional support for OUSD, we will continue to make it available by default across Stripe products.
Read the docs or contact sales to start using OUSD on Stripe.

articles.title: CIO Executive Council Resources
articles.titleEn: CIO Executive Council Resources
summaryLinesEn: This IDC Survey Spotlight, prepared by Gina Smith , PhD, Senior Research Director, IT Skills for Digital Business, examines data from IDC’s 2026 Future Enterprise Resiliency and Spending Survey to explore how organizations are grappling with IT skills validation across four key regions: North America, Asia Pacific, Western Europe, and the Middle East and North Africa.
As AI becomes integral to enterprise operations, CIOs are shifting focus from rapid deployment to engineering sustainable AI economics.

The survey highlights that leadership perspectives on modernization priorities, business drivers, obstacles, IT budget allocation, decision criteria, data architecture maturity, data quality, and the data-related initiatives organizations are prioritizing to enable AI use cases over the next 12–18 months.

summaryLines: 디지털 비즈니스를 위한 IT 기술 수석 연구 이사인 Gina Smith 박사가 준비한 이 IDC 설문 조사 스포트라이트는 IDC의 2026년 미래 기업 탄력성 및 지출 설문 조사의 데이터를 검토하여 조직이 북미, 아시아 태평양, 서유럽, 중동 및 북아프리카의 4개 주요 지역에서 IT 기술 검증과 어떻게 씨름하고 있는지 살펴봄
AI가 기업 운영에 필수가 되면서 CIO는 신속한 배포에서 지속 가능한 AI 경제성 엔지니어링으로 초점을 전환하고 있음
설문조사에서는 조직이 향후 12~18개월 동안 AI 사용 사례를 활성화하기 위해 우선순위를 정하는 현대화 우선 순위, 비즈니스 동인, 장애물, IT 예산 할당, 결정 기준, 데이터 아키텍처 성숙도, 데이터 품질 및 데이터 관련 이니셔티브에 대한 리더십 관점을 강조함

summaryLinesEn: Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading.

Charles Schwab (SCHW) said Wednesday it launched its new generative AI-powered assistant Charley, with a phased rollout starting in October to eligible US retail clients on schwab.com and Schwab Mobile.

ASE Technology Holding ASX is expanding its advanced packaging capabilities as AI drives demand for larger chips, higher bandwidth and more complex semiconductor designs. Rising AI demand is creating hardware requirements in terms of size, complexity and integration, making packaging an important part of the AI infrastructure buildout. ASE Technology believes that hardware infrastructure has become a key bottleneck, while packaging is moving up in the system architecture value chain.

CoWoS is one of the main technologies supporting this opportunity. The company is working to increase its CoWoS scale and efficiency as demand from AI infrastructure remains strong. ASE Technology is also expanding its full process business, which management said is on track to generate about TWD 300 million in revenues in 2026. The company expects substantial growth in this business in 2027 and sees it becoming margin accretive as it scales.

articles.descEn: The lawsuit appears to be the first publicly reported case seeking to hold an AI developer liable for an incident caused by rogue systems.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI is sued over rogue AI Hugging Face cyberattack
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia announced it had agreed to pay roughly $13 billion to buy Hugging Face earlier this month.
CEO Clément Delangue previously said in July he asked OpenAI to commit $100 million in compute "to help the Hugging Face community build powerful cyber defenses with the best open and closed models."
OpenAI had tried to invest $100 million into the startup after the cyberattack, though talks fell apart in the early stages, sources told CNBC.

articles.title: Introducing ai_decide: make fast decisions on your governed data | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: To
articles.titleEn: Introducing ai_decide: make fast decisions on your governed data | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Use ai_decide when you need fast, low-cost decisions over governed data: routing prompts to the right model, tagging customer reviews with metadata, or evaluating agent quality—at batch scale in SQL or in real-time over REST.
Because ai_decide is optimized for fast decisions, it yields lower latency and cost than an LLM on similar tasks. ai_decide is now available on Databricks in Beta.
Today, we’re launching a new Databricks AI Function ai_decide that makes fast decisions over your governed data.

articles.title: Meta’s Muse AI threatens Apple’s mobile commerce dominance
articles.descEn: Investing.com -- Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) shares fell 1.6% today as Wall Street digests a stark warning from Bank of America: the rapid rise of third-party AI agents threatens to fundamentally rewrite the economics of mobile commerce, striking at the core of Apple’s ecosystem.
articles.titleEn: Meta’s Muse AI threatens Apple’s mobile commerce dominance
summaryLinesEn: Investing.com -- Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) shares fell 1.6% today as Wall Street digests a stark warning from Bank of America: the rapid rise of third-party AI agents threatens to fundamentally rewrite the economics of mobile commerce, striking at the core of Apple's ecosystem.
Launched on September 8, 2026, Muse cleared 2.5 million downloads in its first two weeks, quickly surging to the top of the US iOS free-app chart.
But the competitive pressure on Apple is compounding rapidly, with OpenAI widely expected to announce its own consumer agent later today.

articles.title: China has three new criteria for humanoid robot IPOs. Few, if any, meet them
articles.descEn: China's securities regulator is raising the bar for public listings of humanoid robot startups with three specific criteria, according to three sources.
articles.titleEn: China has three new criteria for humanoid robot IPOs. Few, if any, meet them
summaryLinesEn: AI giants' IPOs, chipmaker AMD said Monday it is acquiring World Labs for $8.2 billion in a stock deal.

The Chinese regulator wants local "embodied AI" startups seeking to go public to meet three specific criteria, according to the sources, who requested anonymity due to the sensitivity of the situation.

Reflecting a rapid surge in interest, investment in the sector hit 47.09 billion yuan ($6.95 billion) in the second quarter, more than double that of the first quarter — and up over six times versus the same period last year, according to industry data provider Xiniu.

articles.title: The AI agents are spiraling out of control
articles.descEn: As OpenAI discloses multiple incidents of its technology going rogue and the UN warns of uncontrollable agents, Meta is putting an AI agent in the hands of millions
articles.titleEn: The AI agents are spiraling out of control
summaryLinesEn: That is not to say that every expert has thrown up their hands.
The agents have broken our control, the body said, and even reining them in now will not guarantee our collective ability to corral them later.

In an assessment of the Hugging Face hack and its fallout, the panel said: “Halting this incident is no assurance that humans can reliably keep AI agents under control today, particularly as they become more capable, harder to monitor and better at finding loopholes or hiding their activity.”

articles.title: Agentic AI early adopters have failed, pivoted, and learned these 3 lessons | Fortune
articles.descEn: Adobe, Freeport-McMoRan, Kyndryl, and Salesforce are learning that making AI agents pay off requires fewer, more targeted deployments; rigorous outcome-based measurement; and business teams willing to redesign workflows from scratch.
articles.titleEn: Agentic AI early adopters have failed, pivoted, and learned these 3 lessons | Fortune
summaryLinesEn: According to White, the new agentic process increased the proportion of cases being resolved and routed to the right group the first time from 12% to 34%, saving the firm over $350,000 in a year.

After six months using agentic AI to process approximately $500 million in invoices for just one line of product, the company has realized significant cost savings and is planning to scale to other product lines, according to Odinet.

Salesforce—which sells the same agentic AI systems it’s using internally as its products—similarly pivoted from hundreds of agents to a few the company strongly believed could deliver specific benefits, according to SVP Andy White, who oversees adoption of Salesforce products for internal operations.

articles.title: Why It’s Time to Load Up on Applied Materials Stock
articles.descEn: Applied Materials is well positioned to deliver solid growth. Improving margins and long-term customer commitments strengthen its growth outlook.
articles.titleEn: Why It’s Time to Load Up on Applied Materials Stock
summaryLinesEn: Applied Materials (AMAT) stock has climbed more than 96% year-to-date (YTD), supported by robust artificial intelligence (AI)-related demand for advanced semiconductors and the equipment required to manufacture them.
Although Applied Materials' stock has gained substantially, its recent pullback has eased valuation concerns.
Overall, Applied Materials' growth outlook remains solid, driven by structural expansion of the semiconductor industry and the accelerating investment in AI infrastructure.

articles.title: How can I help to protect my kids from inappropriate internet content using parental controls?
articles.descEn: Learn how parental controls can help manage the content your kids can access, support internet safety for kids and limit exposure to inappropriate internet content.
articles.titleEn: How can I help to protect my kids from inappropriate internet content using parental controls?
summaryLinesEn: Knowing how to set up parental controls is only the first step — as kids get older, the apps they use, the people they communicate with and the content that’s appropriate for them will change.

If they move from the TV to a tablet or game console, Fios Router controls can help keep the same content filters, schedules and daily internet limits in place across the devices assigned to their profile.

Adding blocks and filters can help you reduce access to inappropriate websites, apps and other content, but parents should combine them with age-appropriate settings and ongoing conversations about what kids may encounter online.

localization.title: 자녀 보호 기능을 사용하여 부적절한 인터넷 콘텐츠로부터 자녀를 보호하려면 어떻게 해야 합니까
summaryLines: 자녀 보호 기능을 설정하는 방법을 아는 것은 첫 번째 단계일 뿐임 · 자녀가 성장함에 따라 사용하는 앱, 소통하는 사람, 자녀에게 적합한 콘텐츠가 변경됨

articles.title: Helping personal agents shop more intelligently and reliably with Link
articles.descEn: As agents take on more purchases, agent builders have increasingly asked us to help agents navigate checkout and earn consumer trust. Today, we’re sharing three major improvements to support this broader set of needs.
articles.titleEn: Helping personal agents shop more intelligently and reliably with Link
summaryLinesEn: The most popular personal AI agents—such as Muse, Meta’s new personal agent; Grok Bot; and Instinct—now use Link’s wallet for agents to power consumer spending.

Link can now help agents complete more purchases with incremental authorization and guidance on how to overcome checkout obstacles; analyze consumer spending to make better product recommendations; and provide purchase protection if an agent makes a mistake.
Consumers are embracing this new way to shop: over the past month, agentic purchases made with Link increased 38x.

summaryLinesEn: FabCon and SQLCon 2026 in Barcelona: Building the data foundation for Microsoft Copilot and agents Enabling Frontier Transformation with Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Fabric Building an AI-ready data foundation with Microsoft Fabric One of the defining strengths of the Fabric and SQL communities is how openly people share what they are building and learning.
Microsoft Fabric now supports more than 40,000 customers worldwide, and for decades Microsoft SQL Server has provided the backbone of enterprise workloads including more than 90% of the Fortune 500.

articles.descEn: Every organization has knowledge that is uniquely its own: the way its business operates, the data it has built over time, the expertise of its people and the context behind thousands of everyday decisions. As powerful AI models become more widely available, that unique business intelligence matters more than ever. The difference will come from...
articles.titleEn: New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows - The Official Microsoft Blog
summaryLinesEn: IQ Sharing in Microsoft Fabric: Share unique business context without giving up control Business knowledge does not stop at the boundary of a team or business unit.

That means when someone asks Copilot for the latest sales forecast or another critical business metric, the answer can be grounded in the same semantic model that powers the organization’s reports, helping avoid confusion about which number is correct.
So, instead of spending the meeting uncovering and debating whose number was right, the team was able to get straight to what the numbers mean and focus on what we do next.

summaryLines: Microsoft Fabric의 IQ 공유 · 제어권을 포기하지 않고 고유한 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 공유함 · 비즈니스 지식은 팀이나 비즈니스 단위의 경계에서 끝나지 않음

articles.title: Super Bowl Advertising Insights | Sensor Tower
articles.descEn: Find out how major brands focused their advertising budget ahead of the Super Bowl, and explore the ways in which fluctuating viewership impacted campaigns.
articles.titleEn: Super Bowl Advertising Insights | Sensor Tower
summaryLinesEn: Despite this, Sensor Tower data suggests that this year’s broadcast stirred increased consumer interest: during the mid-game period of 5pm - 9pm EST, average US mobile app active users on live TV streaming providers were 31% higher than during the previous year’s game.
Super Bowl LIX was the most-viewed in history — but between a lopsided game and a record-breaking halftime show, how did audience engagement shift throughout the night?

Further showcasing the impact of the Super Bowl’s outcome for advertisers in 2025, Sensor Tower data shows that average US mobile app daily active users (DAUs) on streaming services at 10pm EST declined roughly 31% compared to the prior hour, contrasted with a 14% increase during the same period the year before.

localization.title: 슈퍼볼 광고 통찰력 | 센서타워
summaryLines: 그럼에도 불구하고, Sensor Tower 데이터에 따르면 올해 방송은 소비자의 관심을 높였음 · 게임 중반 시간인 오후 5시부터 오후 9시(동부 표준시 기준) 동안 라이브 TV 스트리밍 제공업체의 평균 미국 모바일 앱 활성 사용자는 전년도 게임보다 31% 더 높았음
Super Bowl LIX는 역사상 가장 많은 조회수를 기록함 · 하지만 일방적인 경기와 기록적인 하프타임 쇼 사이에 밤새 청중 참여도가 어떻게 바뀌었나요
2025년 슈퍼볼 결과가 광고주에게 미치는 영향을 더욱 잘 보여 주는 Sensor Tower 데이터에 따르면 미국 동부 표준시 기준 오후 10시에 스트리밍 서비스를 사용하는 평균 미국 모바일 앱 일일 활성 사용자(DAU)는 전년도 같은 기간 동안 14% 증가한 반면, 전 시간에 비해 약 31% 감소한 것으로 나타남

articles.title: Three Must-learn Tips for Using EQ
articles.descEn: EQ will be one of the first tools to master when you come to Suno Studio. Get started here!
articles.titleEn: Three Must-learn Tips for Using EQ
summaryLinesEn: You first instinct might be to turn up the high-mids and treble for a bit more presence.
Suno Studio has had EQ per track since it launched in 2025.

Digital audio has a theoretical maximum (0dBFS) meaning everything you add, including gain from your various EQ bands, will need to find a space in your master bus: the combination of all your tracks and effects.

articles.title: Travel’s AI dilemma at Skift Global Forum
articles.descEn: At the annual travel conference, Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky called AI “an existential risk” to his company and “literally the best thing to ever happen” to it in the same discussion. That sums up many travel leaders’ push-and-pull relationship with AI.
articles.titleEn: Travel’s AI dilemma at Skift Global Forum
summaryLinesEn: Meanwhile, Radar, Stripe’s AI-powered fraud prevention tool, blocked the overwhelming majority of those attempts—the share of attempted fraud that reached the payment stage fell by more than two-thirds from 2023 to 2025.
It assesses risk signals such as dispute likelihood, card testing, stolen-card risk, and issuer-decline patterns.

Executives from Expedia Group, Priceline, IHG Hotels & Resorts, Amadeus, and other companies discussed how to harness the benefits of AI—more personalized discovery, faster customer service, new sources of revenue—without giving up control of the booking or their brand.
articles.summary:
Meanwhile, Radar, Stripe’s AI-powered fraud prevention tool, blocked the overwhelming majority of those attempts—the share of attempted fraud that reached the payment stage fell by more than two-thirds from 2023 to 2025.

articles.title: Get transparency and predictability with the Azure Virtual Machine lifecycle
articles.descEn: Learn how the Azure Virtual Machine lifecycle is built to give you access to the most advanced cloud and AI infrastructure.
articles.titleEn: Get transparency and predictability with the Azure Virtual Machine lifecycle
summaryLinesEn: To give you access to the most advanced cloud and AI infrastructure, deployed on the most sophisticated silicon and hardware, the Azure Virtual Machine lifecycle is built around three customer outcomes: Transparency to easily understand the lifecycle status of Azure technologies, Microsoft’s level of ongoing investment, and the recommended path forward as new innovations become available.

As Azure continues to advance, our commitment is to make change predictable, transparent, and supported through clear lifecycle guidance, early visibility, and practical help to modernize with confidence.
Predictability to plan against defined lifecycle stages, understand what to expect at each stage, and advance notice as technologies progress through their lifecycle.

summaryLines: 가장 정교한 실리콘 및 하드웨어에 배포된 최첨단 클라우드 및 AI 인프라에 대한 액세스를 제공하기 위해 Azure Virtual Machine 수명 주기는 세 가지 고객 결과, 즉 Azure 기술의 수명 주기 상태를 쉽게 이해할 수 있는 투명성, Microsoft의 지속적인 투자 수준, 새로운 혁신이 가능해짐에 따라 권장되는 경로를 중심으로 구축됨
Azure가 지속적으로 발전함에 따라 우리는 명확한 수명 주기 지침, 조기 가시성, 자신감을 가지고 현대화할 수 있는 실질적인 지원을 통해 변경 사항을 예측 가능하고 투명하게 만들고 지원하도록 노력하고 있음
정의된 라이프사이클 단계에 대한 계획을 예측하고, 각 단계에서 예상되는 사항을 이해하며, 라이프사이클 전반에 걸쳐 기술이 발전함에 따라 사전 통지를 제공함

articles.title: Ghostwriter: When AI goes from tool to teammate
articles.descEn: Ghostwriter now works alongside your team in Slack and Teams — always on, proactive, and asynchronous. It's moved past doing what you asked to noticing what you missed and proposing what you haven't tried.
articles.titleEn: Ghostwriter: When AI goes from tool to teammate
summaryLinesEn: But Ghostwriter isn’t DMing you on Slack when it thinks your AI agent’s sales promotion’s lost its effectiveness.
With Sierra’s Ghostwriter , our customers have transitioned from code to clicks to prompts , dramatically speeding up how they build and deploy agents.
It reviews recent calls, identifies three specific changes, shows the conversations behind each one, estimates how many customers each change could help, and recommends which two to tackle first.

articles.title: Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot - The Official Microsoft Blog
articles.descEn: We’re reimagining Microsoft Copilot to enable work as it evolves and to help expand what every individual and every organization can accomplish in the flow of human ambition. Today we’re introducing the new Copilot to connect the tools people rely on with the next generation of capabilities they’ll need to build, customize and scale AI...
articles.titleEn: Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot - The Official Microsoft Blog
summaryLinesEn: From Home you can ask Copilot to draft a launch brief, model a budget, build a deck, or pick up a file your team is already working on, and it creates or updates a real, editable document, workbook or presentation — live for your whole team, not just you.
This same foundation enables apps built in Cowork, Code and Copilot Studio, and we’re opening it up to third-party and pro-code developers, too.
We’re also excited to share new FinOps for AI capabilities to help you manage spend and get the most value from Copilot and agents.

articles.descEn: In this blog post, I explain how to use the new fuzzing taskflow based on the GitHub Security Lab Taskflow Agent AI framework.
articles.titleEn: AI-powered fuzzing with the GitHub Security Lab Taskflow Agent
summaryLinesEn: That is what led me to build the Fuzzing Taskflow, an autonomous fuzzing pipeline for C/C++ projects.

Even projects that have been enrolled in OSS-Fuzz for years can still hide critical bugs, and the reason is almost always the same: someone needs to keep an eye on coverage, write new harnesses for the code that nobody is reaching, and triage the crashes that come out the other end.
In this blog post, I explain how to use the new fuzzing taskflow based on the GitHub Security Lab Taskflow Agent AI framework.

summaryLinesEn: That kept the lights on, but it treated resilience as a project with an end date rather than a property you maintain.
For years, resilience was something you set up once: configure disaster recovery, write a runbook, run the occasional failover test.
Our own incident triage system uses language models to answer which service is responsible for an incident—work that used to mean waking people up to argue over logs.

articles.title: Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app
articles.descEn: How we rebuilt the diff surface in the GitHub Copilot app to open a million-line pull request with hundreds of inline review comments.
articles.titleEn: Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app
summaryLinesEn: For this illusion to hold, something has to supply the geometry.
Stacked pull requests are a great way to split work into smaller changes, which makes reviews easier and helps teams ship with less risk.

Our diff surface is built around it: An imperative, recycled code-row renderer (no React component per row) An imperative scroll API with exact “scroll to row N “ None of it scales badly, because no per-frame work grows with the total row count.

summaryLinesEn: In a 2024 study published in the peer-reviewed research journal Body Image , researchers analyzed more than 1 million videos served on a popular social media platform to 91 users over a month.
Looksmaxxing gets a lot of attention because it focuses on appearance, but maxxing can also show up around grades, fitness or productivity.
Here’s how to talk about maxxing without shutting kids down.

articles.title: Agent Memory with Engram: A Practical Guide | Weaviate
articles.descEn: Learn how to use Engram effectively, from writing topic descriptions that control extraction to choosing bounded topics and scopes, selecting a retrieval mode, and placing memories in your prompt without hurting prompt-cache efficiency.
articles.titleEn: Agent Memory with Engram: A Practical Guide | Weaviate
summaryLinesEn: Engram's setup has one of those screens too, and it takes a couple of minutes to get through: name a project → pick a template → click past topics that are already filled in for you → generate an API key.
Engram is our fully managed memory and context service purpose-built to help agents remember, learn, and improve over time.

But somewhere between "it works" and "it works the way I meant it to", four decisions turn out to be yours rather than Engram's: How many memories, and whose (bounded topics and scope) In this post we walk through all four, with real outputs from a project mostly running the stock personalization template.

articles.title: What Does a Compressor Actually Do?
articles.descEn: We talk compression and dynamics in the first in a series where we explain the tools behind great-sounding music.
articles.titleEn: What Does a Compressor Actually Do?
summaryLinesEn: A recording of a drum kit will be very dynamic, with loud snare and kick peaks, plus subtle ghost notes and room reverb making up the totality of the sound.
So to understand the compressor, it’s helpful to first look at what we mean by dynamics in the context of audio.
Well, compressed audio is perceived as sounding louder, because the makeup gain is “turning up the quiet” even if the peaks remain the same.

articles.title: Your agent, laid bare
articles.descEn: For decades, enterprise software was a black box — hard for companies to understand, implement, adapt, and integrate, or even replace. With Sierra, nothing is hidden. It’s easy to build an agent, understand the actions it takes, integrate it with existing systems, and make changes directly.
articles.titleEn: Your agent, laid bare
summaryLinesEn: Code: Your agent lives in a Git repository you can access, giving you a history of what changed and the ability to export the code if you need it.
Simulations and Experiments let you test changes and understand their impact before rolling them out broadly.
Once your agent is live, Sierra provides a complete record of what it does and why.

articles.title: Fintech Rankings
articles.descEn: IDC examines consumer markets by devices, applications, networks, and services to provide complete solutions for succeeding in these expanding markets.
articles.titleEn: Fintech Rankings
summaryLinesEn: IDC FinTech Top 100: Solution providers that derive more than one-third of their revenue from the financial services and FinTech industries AND across no more than two additional key non FSI industry verticals.
Firms such as market data providers or credit bureaus that derive revenues from excluded categories, but also have revenue tied to software, hardware, or services, are considered in these rankings.

For these data providers, the revenue attributed to data is used to qualify the provider to the appropriate IDC FinTech category, yet only the qualifying portion of revenue is included in the process.

articles.title: GSMA and PDAA Unveil Roadmap to Close Africa's Mobile Internet Usage Gap and Connect One Billion People by 2030
articles.descEn: New framework prioritises faster migration to 4G and 5G, coordinated energy and connectivity investment and more sustainable ways to connect rural communities 21 September, New York: The GSMA and the Partnership for Digital Access in Africa (PDAA) today launched a new roadmap to accelerate meaningful digital participation across Africa and support the ambition of connecting […]
articles.titleEn: GSMA and PDAA Unveil Roadmap to Close Africa's Mobile Internet Usage Gap and Connect One Billion People by 2030
summaryLinesEn: The roadmap builds on the GSMA’s State of Mobile Internet Connectivity Report 2026 , published earlier this month, which found that 3.1 billion people globally live within mobile broadband coverage but do not use mobile internet.

It identifies three priorities for accelerating meaningful digital participation: Accelerating migration from 2G and 3G to smartphone-based participation , converting more than 600 million legacy mobile connections into meaningful internet use on 4G and 5G networks.

New framework prioritises faster migration to 4G and 5G, coordinated energy and connectivity investment and more sustainable ways to connect rural communities 21 September, New York: The GSMA and the Partnership for Digital Access in Africa (PDAA) today launched a new roadmap to accelerate meaningful digital participation across Africa and support the ambition of connecting one billion people to the internet by 2030.

localization.title: GSMA와 PDAA, 2030년까지 아프리카의 모바일 인터넷 사용 격차를 줄이고 10억 명을 연결하기 위한 로드맵 공개
summaryLines: 이 로드맵은 이번 달 초에 발표된 GSMA의 모바일 인터넷 연결 상태 보고서 2026을 바탕으로 작성됨 · 보고서에 따르면 전 세계적으로 31억 명의 사람들이 모바일 광대역 범위 내에 거주하지만 모바일 인터넷을 사용하지 않는 것으로 나타남
이는 의미 있는 디지털 참여를 가속화하기 위한 세 가지 우선순위를 식별함 · 2G 및 3G에서 스마트폰 기반 참여로의 전환을 가속화하고, 6억 개 이상의 레거시 모바일 연결을 4G 및 5G 네트워크에서 의미 있는 인터넷 사용으로 전환함

새로운 프레임워크는 4G 및 5G로의 빠른 마이그레이션, 조정된 에너지 및 연결성 투자, 농촌 지역 사회를 연결하는 보다 지속 가능한 방법을 우선시함 · 9월 21일 뉴욕 · GSMA와 아프리카 디지털 액세스를 위한 파트너십(PDAA)은 오늘 아프리카 전역에서 의미 있는 디지털 참여를 가속화하고 2030년까지 10억 명의 사람들을 인터넷에 연결하려는 야망을 지원하기 위한 새로운 로드맵을 출시함

articles.title: Digital Reforms Could Connect Over 1 Million More People to Mobile Internet in Rwanda, GSMA Finds
articles.descEn: Affordable smartphones, targeted digital skills programmes and services relevant to everyday life are key to extending digital inclusion among lower-income and rural communities 17 September 2026, Kigali: More than 1 million additional people in Rwanda could be using mobile internet by 2031 through reforms that make smartphones more affordable and digital services more accessible and […]
articles.titleEn: Digital Reforms Could Connect Over 1 Million More People to Mobile Internet in Rwanda, GSMA Finds
summaryLinesEn: Affordable smartphones, targeted digital skills programmes and services relevant to everyday life are key to extending digital inclusion among lower-income and rural communities 17 September 2026, Kigali: More than 1 million additional people in Rwanda could be using mobile internet by 2031 through reforms that make smartphones more affordable and digital services more accessible and relevant to everyday life, according to a new GSMA report released today.

The analysis also finds that increased digital adoption and wider economic activity could more than offset the costs of targeted tax reductions and affordability measures, delivering an estimated net annual fiscal benefit of RWF 218 billion by 2031.

GSMA’s analysis estimates that implementing the recommended reforms could connect approximately 1.07 million additional unique mobile internet subscribers by 2031 – 22.1% more than projected without the reforms.

localization.title: GSMA는 디지털 개혁을 통해 르완다에서 100만 명 이상의 사람들을 모바일 인터넷에 연결할 수 있다고 밝힘
summaryLines: 저렴한 스마트폰, 일상 생활과 관련된 대상 디지털 기술 프로그램 및 서비스는 저소득층 및 농촌 지역 사회의 디지털 포용을 확대하는 데 핵심임 · 2026년 9월 17일, 키갈리 · 오늘 발표된 새로운 GSMA 보고서에 따르면 스마트폰을 보다 저렴하게 만들고 디지털 서비스에 대한 접근성과 관련성을 높이는 개혁을 통해 2031년까지 르완다에서 100만 명 이상의 추가 인구가 모바일 인터넷을 사용할 수 있을 것이라고 함
또한 분석에 따르면 디지털 채택 증가와 경제 활동 확대로 목표 세금 감면 및 경제성 조치 비용을 상쇄하고 2031년까지 연간 순 재정 이익이 2,180억 달러에 이를 것으로 예상됨
GSMA의 분석에 따르면 권장 개혁을 시행하면 2031년까지 약 107만 명의 고유 모바일 인터넷 가입자를 추가로 연결할 수 있을 것으로 추정됨 · 이는 개혁 없이 예상한 것보다 22.1% 더 많은 수치임

articles.title: What we’ve learned from Microsoft's own AI transformation - The Official Microsoft Blog
articles.descEn: AI is reshaping work faster than any organization has fully mastered. Across industries, the conversation has shifted from what AI can do to how companies can use AI to create business value and expand what people are able to achieve. At Microsoft, we believe the organizations that succeed will be what we call Frontier Firms:...
articles.titleEn: What we’ve learned from Microsoft's own AI transformation - The Official Microsoft Blog
summaryLinesEn: We learned that access and usage do not equal transformation: a tool licensed to over 200,000 people does not change how the work gets done.
But when leaders focused on a clear business outcome and what mattered most to the person doing the job, rather than AI adoption itself, conversations shifted from using AI to creating value.
But the ultimate measure is whether AI improves customer and employee experiences, drives growth and innovation, reduces risk and expands what the organization can accomplish.

articles.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: Molecular predictions for 9 Billion human DNA variants
articles.descEn: Explore AlphaGenome Atlas, a catalogue predicting the molecular effects and AVI scores for 9 billion single-nucleotide variants across the human genome.
articles.titleEn: AlphaGenome Atlas: Molecular predictions for 9 Billion human DNA variants
summaryLinesEn: Today, we are introducing AlphaGenome Atlas: a platform ( detailed in our paper ) containing predictions for the effects of 9 billion single-nucleotide variants — every single-letter change possible — in the human genome.

When we expanded the AlphaFold Database in 2022, we grew the 3D structure information available from around 190K experimental structures to more than 200M structure predictions — covering nearly all catalogued proteins known to science.
By focusing on the 1% of non-coding variants which Atlas predicts to be most impactful, he identified 19 genetic regions, which could help direct the next stage of targeted research into this trait.

localization.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: 90억 개의 인간 DNA 변종에 대한 분자적 예측
summaryLines: 오늘 우리는 인간 게놈에서 90억 개의 단일 뉴클레오티드 변형(가능한 모든 단일 문자 변경)의 효과에 대한 예측을 포함하는 플랫폼(논문에 자세히 설명되어 있음)인 AlphaGenome Atlas를 소개함
2022년에 AlphaFold 데이터베이스를 확장하면서 우리는 약 190,000개의 실험 구조에서 200,000개 이상의 구조 예측까지 이용 가능한 3D 구조 정보를 확장하여 과학에 알려진 거의 모든 분류된 단백질을 포괄함
Atlas가 가장 큰 영향을 미칠 것으로 예측하는 1%의 비암호화 변이에 초점을 맞춤으로써 그는 이 특성에 대한 다음 단계의 표적 연구를 유도하는 데 도움이 될 수 있는 19개의 유전 영역을 식별함

articles.title: What Stripe data shows about fraud at AI startups
articles.descEn: Here’s a closer look at what our data shows about attempted fraud and multi-account abuse rates at AI companies and how Stripe Radar, our AI-powered fraud prevention product, can help businesses stay ahead of changing fraud patterns.
articles.titleEn: What Stripe data shows about fraud at AI startups
summaryLinesEn: By Q1 2026, AI startups’ attempted fraud rate on Stripe had decreased to 2.6x the rate of startups overall.
As transaction fraud tactics become less likely to succeed, fraudulent actors shift their efforts to other forms of fraud, such as multi-account or free trial abuse.

Radar draws on signals across billions of transactions on the Stripe network to help identify fraudulent payments before a transaction is processed—including cards that have been used fraudulently at other businesses, even when they’re new to yours.

articles.title: GSMA warns of emerging global AI divide as three billion people remain offline and smartphone component costs soar
articles.descEn: State of Mobile Internet Connectivity report calls for urgent action to boost access to affordable smartphones and ensure AI reaches everyone. 15 September 2026, New York: The GSMA today warned that the world risks creating a new global divide between AI “haves” and “have-nots” unless urgent action is taken to address the digital divide and […]
articles.titleEn: GSMA warns of emerging global AI divide as three billion people remain offline and smartphone component costs soar
summaryLinesEn: Launching its State of Mobile Internet Connectivity (SOMIC) Report 2026 , the GSMA, which represents the mobile ecosystem worldwide, warns that while artificial intelligence is transforming economies and societies, its benefits will remain out of reach for more than 3.4 billion people who still do not use mobile internet – despite more than 90% of them already living within mobile broadband coverage.

By the end of 2025 an entry-level internet-enabled handset cost the poorest 20% of people in LMICs the equivalent of 44% of their average monthly income , rising to 76% in Sub-Saharan Africa with these costs expected to dramatically rise due to increases in memory costs.

Around 160 million people came online in 2025, down from 190 million the previous year, while 3.1 billion people continue to live within the footprint of mobile broadband networks but do not use mobile internet – the “usage gap”.

localization.title: GSMA는 30억 명이 오프라인 상태를 유지하고 스마트폰 부품 가격이 치솟으면서 전 세계적으로 AI 격차가 나타날 것이라고 경고함
summaryLines: 전 세계 모바일 생태계를 대표하는 GSMA는 2026년 모바일 인터넷 연결 상태 보고서(SOMIC)를 발표하면서 인공 지능이 경제와 사회를 변화시키고 있지만, 그 중 90% 이상이 이미 모바일 광대역 서비스 범위 내에 살고 있음에도 불구하고 여전히 모바일 인터넷을 사용하지 않는 34억 명 이상의 사람들이 그 혜택을 누리지 못할 것이라고 경고함
2025년 말까지 보급형 인터넷 지원 모바일 비용은 중소 저소득층 빈곤층 20%의 평균 월 소득의 44%에 해당하며 사하라 이남 아프리카에서는 76%까지 증가하며 메모리 비용 증가로 인해 이러한 비용이 급격히 증가할 것으로 예상됨
2025년에는 약 1억 6천만 명이 온라인에 접속했는데, 이는 전년도의 1억 9천만 명보다 감소한 반면, 31억 명의 사람들은 계속해서 모바일 광대역 네트워크 범위 내에서 생활하지만 모바일 인터넷을 사용하지 않는데, 이는 '사용 격차'임

articles.title: Pre-Bill Review for CDI and Coding Teams at Partner Health Systems
articles.descEn: Abridge extends its clinician intelligence platform to CDI and coding teams with pre-bill review of inpatient claims.
articles.titleEn: Pre-Bill Review for CDI and Coding Teams at Partner Health Systems
summaryLinesEn: No separate system to stand up: pre-bill review runs on the same platform and clinical record already in place at the point of care.
Supports assessment of present-on-admission (POA) status, which affects hospital-acquired condition (HAC) reporting and publicly reported quality scores.
When a clinician and a CDI specialist are working from the same record, the claim ends up matching what actually happened." —Dr.

articles.title: Apple’s new child safety features now available
articles.descEn: Apple’s new suite of tools that help parents create safer digital experiences for their kids is now available across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and more.
articles.titleEn: Apple’s new child safety features now available
summaryLinesEn: A redesigned Screen Time that gives parents an at-a-glance view of usage and one-tap controls to adjust access in the moment.
Expanded Communication Safety protections that now block gore and violent content, in addition to nudity, in shared images and videos, including in live FaceTime calls.

For parents and families looking for more information about how to help create safer, more enriching digital experiences for their kids, Apple has launched a dedicated website , which includes details on the latest tools and how to get started using them.

summaryLinesEn: Users can also expand their shots with the Extend tool to give their subjects more breathing room, and the popular Clean Up tool is more powerful than ever, allowing users to remove distractions from their photos with even better quality and more realistic infill.

Siri AI is rolling out in beta in English in iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27, and requires an Apple Intelligence-enabled device set to a supported language.

articles.title: GSMA calls for greater renewable energy access to enable mobile industry’s net zero transition in Asia Pacific
articles.descEn: Despite stronger climate commitments by mobile operators across Asia Pacific, emissions in emerging Asian markets have risen by more than 20% since 2019 due to growth in connectivity demand and limited access to renewable energy 10th September 2026, Kuala Lumpur: Mobile operators across Asia Pacific are making progress towards net zero, but greater access to […]
articles.titleEn: GSMA calls for greater renewable energy access to enable mobile industry’s net zero transition in Asia Pacific
summaryLinesEn: Mobile operators across Asia Pacific purchased or generated 7 TWh of renewable electricity in 2024, equivalent to around 15% of their total electricity consumption – up from just 1% in 2019.

For governments, the report recommends enabling renewable energy procurement and aggregation mechanisms for distributed telecom loads, streamlining clean energy and grid permitting, reforming electricity market designs, and accelerating coal phase-outs.

In Southeast Asia, for example, including Malaysia, operator emissions increased by around 20%, driven by growing connectivity demand and network expansion in markets where access to renewables remains a challenge.

localization.title: GSMA, 아시아 태평양 지역 모바일 산업의 순 제로 전환을 가능하게 하기 위해 재생 가능 에너지 접근성 확대 촉구
summaryLines: 아시아 태평양 지역의 모바일 사업자는 2024년에 7TWh의 재생 가능 전력을 구매하거나 생산함 · 이는 전체 전력 소비량의 약 15%에 해당하며, 이는 2019년의 1%에서 증가한 수치임
정부의 경우, 보고서는 분산된 통신 부하에 대한 재생 에너지 조달 및 집합 메커니즘 활성화, 청정 에너지 및 그리드 허가 간소화, 전력 시장 설계 개혁, 석탄 단계적 폐지 가속화를 권장함
예를 들어 말레이시아를 포함한 동남아시아에서는 재생 가능 에너지에 대한 접근이 여전히 어려운 시장의 연결성 수요 증가와 네트워크 확장으로 인해 사업자 배출량이 약 20% 증가함

articles.title: HFresh: Memory-Efficient Vector Search | Weaviate
articles.descEn: HFresh is Weaviate's disk-based vector index for memory-efficient vector search, combining low heap usage with incremental background maintenance.
articles.titleEn: HFresh: Memory-Efficient Vector Search | Weaviate
summaryLinesEn: HFresh uses: RQ1 for postings , reducing stored vector data by up to 32x compared to 32-bit floats The first stage of HFresh search uses an HNSW index over centroids.
It builds on ideas introduced by the SPFresh research paper, adapting the design to use battle-tested components already present in Weaviate.

Because the centroid layer is only used to identify promising regions of the vector space, HFresh can compress those vectors aggressively enough to reduce memory usage while maintaining the accuracy needed for strong recall.

localization.title: HFresh: 메모리 효율적인 벡터 검색 | 위비에이트
summaryLines: HFresh는 게시에 RQ1을 사용하여 저장된 벡터 데이터를 32비트 부동 소수점에 비해 최대 32배까지 줄임 · HFresh 검색의 첫 번째 단계에서는 중심에 대해 HNSW 인덱스를 사용함
이는 SPFresh 연구 논문에서 소개된 아이디어를 바탕으로 Weaviate에 이미 존재하는 전투 테스트를 거친 구성 요소를 사용하도록 디자인을 조정함
중심 레이어는 벡터 공간의 유망한 영역을 식별하는 데에만 사용되므로 HFresh는 강력한 재현에 필요한 정확성을 유지하면서 메모리 사용량을 줄일 수 있을 만큼 이러한 벡터를 적극적으로 압축할 수 있음

articles.title: Nearly Half of Reported Scam Incidents Go Unresolved Across Southeast Asia, Undermining Digital Trust, New GSMA Findings Reveal
articles.descEn: Two new GSMA reports launched at today’s M360 ASEAN Digital Trust Summit highlight digital trust as a critical enabler of ASEAN’s digital ambitions and call for coordinated action to strengthen confidence in digital interactions 9 September 2026, Kuala Lumpur: As the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) accelerates its digital economy, AI and digital government […]
articles.titleEn: Nearly Half of Reported Scam Incidents Go Unresolved Across Southeast Asia, Undermining Digital Trust, New GSMA Findings Reveal
summaryLinesEn: The report also found that nearly one in ten (8%) consumers surveyed reported being scammed in the previous 12 months.

Two new GSMA reports launched today at the Digital Trust Summit at M360 ASEAN warn that online scams, fraud and digital deception are increasingly challenging that trust and could undermine progress towards broader digital ambitions.

As countries across the region advance digital economy strategies, AI adoption, digital government programmes and cross-border digital integration, the report highlights that confidence in digital infrastructure, services and institutions increasingly determines whether digitalisation translates into adoption, innovation, investment and socioeconomic impact.

articles.title: A New Partnership with Believe and TuneCore
articles.descEn: Working with our industry partners to support a healthy music ecosystem
articles.titleEn: A New Partnership with Believe and TuneCore
summaryLinesEn: Through many candid conversations, we found that we share important values: giving artists meaningful choices and creating more paths to distribution and economic opportunity.

We recently introduced audio watermarking and fingerprinting to help identify Suno songs off-platform and combat fraud and abuse, along with new download limits designed to prevent mass distribution to streaming services.
Today, we’re announcing a global strategic partnership with global artist development company Believe and TuneCore, its platform for self-releasing artists.

articles.title: How to extract meaning from charts and tables in PDFs | Weaviate
articles.descEn: PDFs full of charts and tables are notoriously hard to put through a traditional RAG pipeline. In this post, we show how late-interaction multi-vector retrieval lets you search PDFs by what the page looks like: no OCR, no chunking, no text extraction.
articles.titleEn: How to extract meaning from charts and tables in PDFs | Weaviate
summaryLinesEn: They cover the financial year ending in January 2026, contain wall-to-wall charts and tables, and total 92 pages.

After going through all this, someone may ask a question about revenue in Q2 FY25 , and your retrieval would return three pages of unrelated bullet points because the actual answer is in a bar chart that was invisible to your index.

You could build a complex ETL pipeline to extract charts and vectorize them separately, but that means another model in the pipeline and introduces more complexity into the stack as well as merging problems at query time.

localization.title: PDF의 차트와 표에서 의미를 추출하는 방법 | 위비에이트
summaryLines: 이 보고서는 2026년 1월에 끝나는 회계연도를 다루며, 전체 차트와 표를 포함하며 총 92페이지임
이 모든 과정을 거친 후 누군가 FY25 Q2 수익에 대해 질문할 수 있으며, 실제 답변은 색인에 표시되지 않는 막대 차트에 있기 때문에 검색 시 관련 없는 글머리 기호 3페이지가 반환됨
차트를 추출하고 별도로 벡터화하기 위해 복잡한 ETL 파이프라인을 구축할 수 있지만 이는 파이프라인에 또 다른 모델이 있다는 의미이며 스택에 더 많은 복잡성이 발생하고 쿼리 시 병합 문제가 발생함

articles.title: Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away
articles.descEn: Nvidia is buying open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, about 80 times its $150 million annual revenue. The deal fits Nvidia's push to invest billions in open AI models while closed providers like OpenAI and Anthropic move away from Nvidia hardware.
articles.titleEn: Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia is acquiring open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion , according to The Information .
Nvidia previously committed $26 billion over five years to develop open-source AI models.
Nvidia could scale up Hugging Face's cloud business and position it as a kind of OpenRouter for open-weight models.

summaryLinesEn: Users requests can include a 1 million tokens worth of text, images and video while GLM-5.3-Flash’s responses contain up to 131,072 tokens.
LLM marketplace operator OpenRouter Inc. launched a free hosted version of Ox Alpha and didn’t disclose its developer, which drew a significant amount of industry attention.
Z.ai Co. today released the code for GLM-5.3-Flash, a large language model that’s 10 times more cost-efficient than its predecessor.

articles.title: Bill Gates issues stark warning about AI and the future of humanity - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Bill Gates issues stark warning about AI and the future of humanity - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Bill Gates issues stark warning about AI and the future of humanity - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: “We have to think now about how to reduce job losses so that everyone can share in the prosperity that AI creates,” he said.
Gates (pictured), now a philanthropist, said in an almost-6,000-word essay Tuesday that the transition to the AI era will be one of the “most turbulent times in human history.”

AI can be a force for good, he expects, in many areas such as education, agriculture, combatting climate change and improving health systems, but he worries that if the impact people experience is only the massive loss of jobs, then AI optimism will become AI despair.

localization.title: 빌 게이츠, AI와 인류의 미래에 대해 강력히 경고 - SiliconANGLE
summaryLines: 그는 “AI가 창출하는 번영을 모든 사람이 공유할 수 있도록 일자리 손실을 줄이는 방법에 대해 이제 고민해야 한다”고 말함
현재 자선가인 게이츠(사진)는 화요일 약 6000자 분량의 에세이에서 AI 시대로의 전환이 “인류 역사상 가장 격동의 시기” 중 하나가 될 것이라고 말함
그는 AI가 교육, 농업, 기후 변화 퇴치, 의료 시스템 개선 등 다양한 분야에서 선을 위한 힘이 될 수 있다고 기대하지만, 사람들이 경험하는 영향이 막대한 일자리 손실에 불과하다면 AI 낙관론은 AI 절망이 될 것이라고 우려함

summaryLinesEn: When a task needs a website, a browser opens in the side panel, where Claude loads pages, reads them, clicks, and types.

The browser stays separate from your own, so Claude can't see your tabs, bookmarks, or passwords.

articles.title: Google's Gemini 3.5 Transcribe turns speech to text in 85 languages while auto-correcting your verbal stumbles
articles.descEn: Google's new Gemini 3.5 Transcribe recognizes over 85 languages, strips filler words, and corrects slips of the tongue in real time. It hits a 4.0 percent word error rate in streaming mode, with 70 percent lower latency than its predecessor, Chirp 3. Through function calling, the model can hand off tasks to other Gemini models.
articles.titleEn: Google's Gemini 3.5 Transcribe turns speech to text in 85 languages while auto-correcting your verbal stumbles
summaryLinesEn: Google reports a word error rate of 4.0 percent for streaming and 2.6 percent for recorded audio, with 70 percent lower latency than its predecessor, Chirp 3.
Google has launched Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, a speech-to-text model for real-time transcription.
It's already built into Gboard for Android (via " Rambler ") and the Gemini app on macOS , with Chrome support coming soon.

articles.title: Viral AI startup Instinct has raised $350M at a $2.5B valuation
articles.descEn: The startup is only a year old but it has already generated a massive amount of hype (and money) while also spurring privacy concerns.
articles.titleEn: Viral AI startup Instinct has raised $350M at a $2.5B valuation
summaryLinesEn: That new round brings the company’s total funding to $350 million and gives the startup a valuation of $2.5 billion.
Instinct, which rocks a decidedly lo-fi website , is currently in private beta, but it has already inspired a certain amount of controversy due to privacy concerns .

The company, which offers an AI assistant that has inspired enthusiasm among its early users, told the Wall Street Journal on Wednesday that it had raised $250 million in a recent Series B funding round.

articles.title: Retail Media Report 2026
articles.descEn: Learn which retail media networks and advertisers are winning online attention. Dive into stats on impression share, market trends, category split, & more.
articles.titleEn: Retail Media Report 2026
summaryLinesEn: While total retail media impressions in the US declined 17% in H1 ‘26, home retailers shone as a bright spot.
Heavy hitters like Walmart and Target also saw ad impressions sink, reflecting shifting priorities for general merchandisers in the retail media network space.

Outlets like Lowe’s and Home Depot were able to raise their year-over-year impressions 151% and 43%, respectively — while Amazon, which accounts for 60% of the domestic retail media market, saw a 16% shrinkage in impressions.

articles.title: GSMA MWC26 Doha to co-locate alongside the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference in November 2026
articles.descEn: Building on the inaugural success of 2025, MWC Doha returns even stronger as it joins forces with ITU to provide a global platform bringing industry and policymakers together 27 August 2026, London: The GSMA and the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) announced today that MWC26 Doha will co-locate alongside the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference (PP-26). PP-26 is […]
articles.titleEn: GSMA MWC26 Doha to co-locate alongside the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference in November 2026
summaryLinesEn: Some 40% of attendees were director level and above, with over 30 partnerships and major announcements made across two busy days.

MWC’s exhibition floor will be adjacent to PP-26, enabling PP-26 delegates to experience firsthand how advanced connectivity, AI-powered solutions and digital infrastructure are accelerating economic growth and societal progress around the globe.
The GSMA Ministerial Programme will return to MWC Doha to shape digital governance and investment priorities that support the next phase of connectivity.

articles.titleEn: 2026 WRC｜Robot Mode: ON!
summaryLinesEn: Themed "Human-Robot Symbiosis, Production-Demand Convergence," the international event provided a new window into China's rapidly evolving robotics industry as it moves from technology demonstrations toward real-world applications.

As buzzwords such as "China Cool" and "Chinamaxxing" went viral on overseas social media, the 2026 World Robot Conference (WRC), held in Beijing E-Town from August 19 to 23, once again drew global attention to China.
Changmugu's AI-powered total orthopedic surgical robot system demonstrates the entire workflow, including image analysis, surgical planning and navigation.

articles.title: Agentic Commerce: Your Customers May Not Be Coming To You.
articles.descEn: Many are still investing in their customer channels. Very few ask what happens when an AI agent answered the question and completed the transaction somewhere else.
articles.titleEn: Agentic Commerce: Your Customers May Not Be Coming To You.
summaryLinesEn: In others it is still the phone, and younger customers will not pick one up.
The other thing that survives is the set of interactions you deliberately decline to automate, and the instinct to treat every contact as cost is what destroys it.
For thirty years digital strategy rested on an assumption nobody bothered to write down.

articles.title: MiniMax Launches Revenue Generation via External Partner Collaborations
articles.descEn: MiniMax, a prominent Chinese artificial intelligence startup, has reportedly pivoted to a more lucrative business model that outperforms the profitability of its in-house product development efforts. As a key player in the competitive AI industry, MiniMax’s strategic shift away from standalone product creation marks a notable transformation in its operational roadmap, unlocking higher revenue potential and reshaping its market positioning amid the fast-evolving global AI landscape.
articles.titleEn: MiniMax Launches Revenue Generation via External Partner Collaborations
summaryLinesEn: Revenue from the open platform and other AI enterprise services hit 73.93 million U.S. dollars, accounting for 63.4% of the total revenue; revenue from AI-native products reached 42.64 million U.S. dollars, with the proportion dropping to 36.6%.
MiniMax's first half-year financial report after going public, the most interesting figure is by no means its revenue.
In the same period last year, revenue from AI-native products accounted for 69.7% of MiniMax's total revenue.

summaryLinesEn: But if she wanted to get him back, the person said, she would have to pay money up front for Brooklyn’s purported temporary care.

articles.title: QueryStory wants you to believe what AI is telling you
articles.descEn: The startup came out of stealth with $6 million in seed funding and a plan to use LLMs and cybersecurity know-how to make AI queries coherent.
articles.titleEn: QueryStory wants you to believe what AI is telling you
summaryLinesEn: QueryStory raised a $6 million seed round in late 2025 from Brightmind Ventures and New York Life Ventures at a valuation of $60 million, and has spent the intervening time developing and piloting its product with customers.
He argues that a purpose-built tool like QueryStory can be more efficient and accurate than a general-purpose agent by understanding and preserving context.
QueryStory is aimed squarely at large enterprises that manage big, proprietary databases; it serves as a platform to unite data analysis and review for users like sales teams or operations managers.

articles.title: Arga Labs is building a better way to train enterprise AI agents

summaryLinesEn: Arga Labs is one such company, which announced its $10 million seed round on Wednesday.

A new crop of startups is finding better ways to test and train those agents before they get deployed, particularly on the complexities of the modern enterprise.

articles.titleEn: 통신사 새 먹거리는 ‘AI 네트워크’...GPU·엣지·피지컬AI 수익화 기대
summaryLinesEn: 최근 미국 네트워크 시스템 전문기업 시에나가 글로벌 리서치 기관 센서스와이드와 전 세계 12개국 1200명 이상의 통신·인프라 전문가를 대상으로 진행한 설문조사에 따르면, 응답자 90%가 AI 네트워크를 향후 매출 성장을 이끌 핵심 동력으로 꼽았다.
전 세계 통신 인프라 전문가 10명 중 9명은 향후 3~5년 내 AI 네트워크가 통신사의 매출 성장을 견인할 것으로 내다봤다.
응답자 39%는 엣지 컴퓨팅과 서비스형 GPU(GPUaaS), 로컬 AI 추론 서비스가 향후 3년 내 기업 매출의 20% 이상을 차지할 것으로 전망했다.

articles.title: Bill Gates says we’ve passed AI’s danger thresholds. Now what?
articles.descEn: It’s a glorious day in Kirkland, Washington, an affluent Seattle suburb on the eastern shore of Lake Washington. The temperature is in the mid-80s, and the sky is incapable of being any more blue. The view from the Gates Ventures conference room overlooks the Carillon Point Marina, where a flotilla of expensive boats bob in…
articles.titleEn: Bill Gates says we’ve passed AI’s danger thresholds. Now what?
summaryLinesEn: In an effort to wake the world up to what he sees as a rapidly growing societal disrupter, the 70-year-old tech titan has begun sounding the alarm as a “shrill voice,” both publicly with his new essay (the first of multiple he plans on the topic) and in meetings with the press, and privately in conversations with industry, government, and civil society leaders.
Gates is bullish on the ways AI will continue to transform agriculture and health care and education, for example, or the ways in which it can help us navigate bureaucracy.

There are definitely some jobs, like Warren Buffett’s, where from age 13 he engaged in reinforcement learning about the value of businesses, and over 80 years later he has a lot of implicit knowledge.

localization.title: 빌 게이츠는 우리가 AI의 위험 기준점을 통과했다고 말함 · 이제 어쩌지
summaryLines: 급속도로 성장하고 있는 사회를 파괴하는 존재로 세상을 깨우기 위한 노력의 일환으로, 70세의 기술 거물은 자신의 새 에세이(그가 해당 주제에 대해 계획한 여러 차례 중 첫 번째)와 언론과의 만남을 통해 공개적으로, 그리고 업계, 정부, 시민 사회 지도자들과의 비공개 대화를 통해 "날카로운 목소리"로 경종을 울리기 시작함
게이츠는 AI가 농업, 의료, 교육 등을 지속적으로 변화시키는 방식이나 관료주의를 헤쳐나가는 데 도움이 될 수 있는 방식에 대해 낙관적임
워렌 버핏처럼 13세부터 기업의 가치에 대한 강화 학습에 참여했으며 80년이 지난 후 그는 많은 암묵적 지식을 갖게 된 직업도 있음

articles.title: AI models flub these intelligence tests. Can you fare any better?
articles.descEn: Puzzles and games can reveal gaps in models’ smarts. Try your hand at these seven tests to see if you can outwit AI.
articles.titleEn: AI models flub these intelligence tests. Can you fare any better?
summaryLinesEn: Despite advances, today’s models still fumble: Subtle changes in classic riddles often trip them up, and visual puzzles are a particular weak spot.

For all the talk of how world models can help AI understand physical environments, LLMs still don’t seem to be able to manipulate 3D objects the way spatial thinkers like architects and mechanical engineers can.
But only up to a point: As the number of disks or people hits six and higher, the models began to falter.

localization.title: AI 모델은 이러한 지능 테스트를 방해함 · 더 잘 지낼 수 있나요
summaryLines: 발전에도 불구하고 오늘날의 모델은 여전히 불안정함 · 고전적인 수수께끼의 미묘한 변화로 인해 종종 문제가 발생하고 시각적 퍼즐이 특히 약점임
AI가 물리적 환경을 이해하는 데 세계 모델이 어떻게 도움이 될 수 있는지에 대한 모든 이야기에도 불구하고 LLM은 건축가나 기계 엔지니어와 같은 공간 사상가가 할 수 있는 방식으로 3D 객체를 조작할 수 없는 것 같음
그러나 어느 정도까지는 디스크 또는 사람의 수가 6개 이상이 되면서 모델이 흔들리기 시작함

articles.title: India's Ringg gets backing from Peak XV as it pushes voice AI past the phone call
articles.descEn: Ringg has raised $10 million from Peak XV as a part of its Series A extension.
articles.titleEn: India's Ringg gets backing from Peak XV as it pushes voice AI past the phone call
summaryLinesEn: Tripathi said Ringg’s voice agent now runs across 1,200 clinics for the healthcare app Practo, helping patients book visits or follow up on next steps post-visit.

Ringg started life as a text-to-speech startup called DesiVocal, but training its own speech models proved expensive, so the founders moved up the stack — building voice AI agents for enterprises instead.
Rishen Kapoor, a principal at Peak XV, said that because Ringg started as a research lab building its own models, that technical depth shows up in the complex use cases it’s now tackling.

summaryLines: Tripathi는 Ringg의 음성 에이전트가 현재 의료 앱 Practo의 1,200개 진료소에서 실행되어 환자가 방문을 예약하거나 방문 후 다음 단계에 대한 후속 조치를 취할 수 있도록 돕고 있다고 말함
Ringg는 DesiVocal이라는 텍스트 음성 변환 스타트업으로 시작했지만 자체 음성 모델을 교육하는 데 비용이 많이 들었기 때문에 창업자들은 대신 기업용 음성 AI 에이전트를 구축하는 방향으로 올라갔음
Peak XV의 교장인 Rishen Kapoor는 Ringg이 자체 모델을 구축하는 연구소로 시작했기 때문에 현재 다루고 있는 복잡한 사용 사례에서 기술적 깊이가 나타난다고 말함

An expanded Glean Intelligence adds centralized usage visibility along with administrative controls over AI spending.
Glean said its testing shows a 5.2-times token-cost advantage per query over Claude Cowork, Anthropic’s agentic work product, and that Glean is preferred 3.6 times as often.

articles.title: Chinese Moonshot AI negotiates hosting deals with Microsoft, Amazon, and Google
articles.descEn: A Chinese AI company could land its model on major US cloud platforms for the first time, taking a cut of the revenue.
articles.titleEn: Chinese Moonshot AI negotiates hosting deals with Microsoft, Amazon, and Google
summaryLinesEn: Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI is in talks with Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet's Google over revenue-sharing deals, Reuters reports.
Moonshot is asking for up to 30 percent of revenue from K3 services, according to three people familiar with the discussions.
Microsoft, Google, and AWS declined to comment to Reuters.

articles.title: Employee revolt and failing agents forced Meta to scrap its AI layoff plan
articles.descEn: Meta wanted to replace far more of its workforce with AI than previously known, according to Reuters, but the plan collapsed under rebellious employees and agents that failed to deliver.
articles.titleEn: Employee revolt and failing agents forced Meta to scrap its AI layoff plan
summaryLinesEn: Internal documents show that under the codename "Project OT," Meta planned to shrink many teams by up to 60 percent.
Internal sentiment dropped from 74 to 55 percent.
The agent technology never delivered the productivity gains Meta expected, investors criticized the massive AI budget, and the workforce openly revolted.

articles.title: Bill Gates is deeply worried about AI, and he’s no longer staying quiet
articles.descEn: Microsoft’s cofounder used to be optimistic about AI, now he’s concerned it could be ‘the worst source of injustice.’
articles.titleEn: Bill Gates is deeply worried about AI, and he’s no longer staying quiet
summaryLinesEn: “We do not have the luxury of moving slowly,” he said, urging countries to begin setting up the international organization “now.”

A transition bigger — and faster — than the world realizes “AI will either be the greatest equalizer ever invented, or the worst source of injustice,” Gates said, predicting that “the transition to this new AI era will be one of the most turbulent times in human history.”
“This time really is different,” he said, adding that “if someone had a credible plan for slowing down AI advances globally, I would likely support it.”

localization.title: 빌 게이츠는 AI에 대해 깊은 우려를 표하며 더 이상 가만히 있지 않음
summaryLines: 그는 "천천히 움직일 여유는 없다"며 "지금" 국제기구 설립을 시작하라고 각국에 촉구함
게이츠는 “AI는 지금까지 발명된 것 중 가장 위대한 균등화 장치가 되거나 최악의 불의의 근원이 될 것”이라고 세상이 깨닫는 것보다 더 크고 더 빠른 전환을 말하며 “이 새로운 AI 시대로의 전환은 인류 역사상 가장 격동적인 시기 중 하나가 될 것”이라고 예측함
그는 “이번에는 정말 다르다”며 “누군가가 전 세계적으로 AI 발전을 늦추기 위한 믿을 만한 계획을 가지고 있다면 나는 그것을 지지할 것”이라고 덧붙였음

articles.title: Robot brain builders are pushing out of their GPT-2 era
articles.descEn: Robot bodies are waiting for their AI brains to catch up.
articles.titleEn: Robot brain builders are pushing out of their GPT-2 era
summaryLinesEn: That excitement helped deliver a big IPO for Unitree, China’s leading robot maker, which saw the company valued at $66 billion after its arrival on China’s equivalent of the NASDAQ.
Tesla is already trying this with its Optimus robot, and now both AV-focused Wayve and ride-share giant Uber have now launched robotics labs focused on humanoid form factors as R&D efforts.

The event has tripled in size since it kicked off in 2023, and had 1500 attendees, according to the organizer, Foxglove, a company that helps physical AI model builders manage and visualize their data.

summaryLines: 이러한 흥분은 중국 최고의 로봇 제조업체인 Unitree의 대규모 IPO를 성사시키는 데 도움이 됨 · Unitree는 중국의 나스닥에 상장된 후 회사 가치가 660억 달러에 달함

articles.title: Meta reportedly abandoned an AI-focused restructuring plan that would have laid off thousands - Engadget
articles.descEn: The problem with Meta's AI restructuring plan is the AI wasn't good enough.
articles.titleEn: Meta reportedly abandoned an AI-focused restructuring plan that would have laid off thousands - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Dubbed Project OT, the plan appears to connect two stories from earlier this year: Meta's 10 percent workforce reduction and the company's program that tracked employees' mouse movements and keystrokes .

He told staff that the "trajectory of the agentic development over at least the last four months hasn't really accelerated in the way that we expected," and that the company's investment in AI agents hadn't "come to fruition yet."
Middle-management layers would shrink, and "agent-assisted analysis" would help determine day-to-day priorities.

articles.title: Australia's recording association bans AI-made music from charts - Engadget
articles.descEn: Songs using gen-AI as a support tool will still be allowed, so long as they're "substantially human made."
articles.titleEn: Australia's recording association bans AI-made music from charts - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: "We call on all parties who have a role in deciding the music played and promoted to Australian audiences, particularly radio, to support human artistry and implement similar changes across their own codes."
The Australian Recording Industry Association announced today that any tracks wholly generated with AI will not be eligible for inclusion on the nation's music charts.

"The ARIA Charts will always remain a transparent measurement of the music Australia consumes, but a chart that rewards unlicensed AI output would undercut the very basis of the recorded music we exist to represent," said ARIA CEO, Annabelle Herd.

localization.title: 호주 음반 협회, AI가 만든 음악을 차트에서 금지 - Engadget
summaryLines: "우리는 호주 청중에게 재생되고 홍보되는 음악, 특히 라디오를 결정하는 역할을 하는 모든 당사자에게 인간의 예술성을 지원하고 자체 코드 전반에 걸쳐 유사한 변화를 구현할 것을 촉구함"
호주 음반 산업 협회(Australian Recording Industry Association)는 오늘 AI로 완전히 생성된 트랙은 국가 음악 차트에 포함될 수 없다고 발표함
ARIA CEO인 Annabelle Herd는 "ARIA 차트는 항상 호주가 소비하는 음악에 대한 투명한 측정으로 남을 것임 · 그러나 허가되지 않은 AI 출력을 보상하는 차트는 우리가 대표하는 녹음된 음악의 기반을 약화시킬 것입니다"라고 말함

articles.title: 4 AI development skills you need, according to Andrew Ng - and what experts say he's missing
articles.descEn: The rise of generative and agentic AI has dramatically changed the software-building process - and the skills required.
articles.titleEn: 4 AI development skills you need, according to Andrew Ng - and what experts say he's missing
summaryLinesEn: "When AI-enabled software engineers don't understand why the software is being written and how it will be used, the productivity boosts of AI are wasted in false starts and rework," cautioned Chris Matteson, head of sales engineering at Union.ai.
Still, "all developers -- full-stack engineers, data engineers, DevOps engineers, machine learning engineers, and, yes, AI engineers -- will need AI engineering skills," he explained.

Also: 'Specialists aren't required' anymore: How to stay valuable in an AI agent workplace today Andrew Ng, founder of Coursera and lecturer at Stanford, formulated a list of essential skills for AI development based on his analysis of more than 10,000 job postings and interviews with AI experts, hiring managers, and recruiters.

summaryLines: Union.ai의 영업 엔지니어링 책임자인 Chris Matteson은 "AI 지원 소프트웨어 엔지니어가 소프트웨어가 작성되는 이유와 사용 방법을 이해하지 못하면 잘못된 시작과 재작업으로 인해 AI의 생산성 향상이 낭비됩니다"라고 경고함
그럼에도 불구하고 "풀 스택 엔지니어, 데이터 엔지니어, DevOps 엔지니어, 기계 학습 엔지니어, AI 엔지니어 등 모든 개발자는 AI 엔지니어링 기술이 필요합니다"라고 그는 설명함
또한 · '전문가는 더 이상 필요하지 않습니다': 오늘날 AI 에이전트 직장에서 가치를 유지하는 방법 Coursera의 창립자이자 스탠포드의 강사인 Andrew Ng는 10,000개 이상의 채용 공고와 AI 전문가, 채용 관리자 및 채용 담당자와의 인터뷰를 분석하여 AI 개발을 위한 필수 기술 목록을 작성함

articles.title: AI agents meant to replace Meta workers made “large-scale, disruptive actions”
articles.descEn: Report shows Meta's challenges replacing people with AI agents.
articles.titleEn: AI agents meant to replace Meta workers made “large-scale, disruptive actions”
summaryLinesEn: Internal posts also reportedly pointed to AI agents making “large-scale, disruptive actions that humans are unlikely to execute” and leading to a 40 percent increase in major technical and security incidents compared to the prior year.

In July, however, Zuckerberg reportedly acknowledged during a company meeting that the “trajectory of the agentic development over at least the last four months hasn’t really accelerated in the way that we expected.”

Many organizations, including those much bigger and much smaller than Meta, are exploring ways that AI could help with company goals, such as by saving employees time, driving revenue, or reducing costs, including, in some cases, human resources.

summaryLines: 내부 게시물에서는 AI 에이전트가 "인간이 실행할 가능성이 없는 대규모의 파괴적인 행동"을 하여 전년도에 비해 주요 기술 및 보안 사고가 40% 증가했다고 지적한 것으로 알려졌음
그러나 지난 7월 주커버그는 회사 회의에서 "최소한 지난 4개월 동안의 에이전트 개발 궤적은 우리가 예상했던 방식으로 실제로 가속화되지 않았다"고 인정한 것으로 알려졌음
Meta보다 훨씬 큰 조직과 훨씬 작은 조직을 포함한 많은 조직에서는 AI가 직원 시간 절약, 수익 창출, 경우에 따라 인적 자원을 포함한 비용 절감 등 회사 목표를 달성하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있는 방법을 모색하고 있음

articles.title: OpenAI’s rogue AI model incident was worse than we thought
articles.descEn: Two new reports from OpenAI and METR shine new light on the OpenAI-Hugging Face cybersecurity incident that rocked the AI industry in July.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI’s rogue AI model incident was worse than we thought
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI quickly reached out to Hugging Face and started “initial containment measures,” according to OpenAI’s own report, and was able to shut down most of the unauthorized activity from its agents within three days, although some continued for longer than that.

OpenAI promised to better isolate models and restrict high-risk instances from accessing the internet, and said that it would introduce “24/7 escalation and rapid response” for concerning incidents or flags, notifying researchers within 30 minutes.
Follow Follow See All AI Over 1,000 AI agents sent 70,000 messages on a secret message board and worked together to evade OpenAI’s restrictions.

articles.title: Google's Gemini has a branding problem, and so does the rest of AI
articles.descEn: Consumer AI apps need to stop making users learn their product architecture.
articles.titleEn: Google's Gemini has a branding problem, and so does the rest of AI
summaryLinesEn: In practice, though, the Brief can’t tell the difference between information that’s urgent or actionable and unsolicited nudges to follow up on other things — like prompting you to continue research you started in the chatbot, or worse, resurfacing your prior Google searches.

Google gets something right in its Wednesday announcement about new Gemini Live voice features when it says, “You shouldn’t have to guess whether a task requires Spark, a Daily Brief, or a quick inbox search.”
This clutters up what could otherwise be a more straightforward consumer experience, and it suggests that Gemini is still struggling to find a killer feature.

summaryLines: 그러나 실제로 브리핑은 긴급하거나 실행 가능한 정보와 다른 사항에 대한 후속 조치를 취하라는 원치 않는 넛지(예 · 챗봇에서 시작한 조사를 계속하라는 메시지 또는 더 나쁘게는 이전 Google 검색을 다시 표시하는 등) 간의 차이를 구분할 수 없음

이는 보다 직접적인 소비자 경험이 될 수 있는 것을 혼란스럽게 하며 Gemini가 여전히 킬러 기능을 찾기 위해 고군분투하고 있음을 시사함

articles.title: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
summaryLinesEn: Multi-vector training gives you a real choice of starting point, and it matters more than you might expect.
The finished checkpoints, by contrast, barely moved or even regressed, at every learning rate I tried.

Because queries and documents are matched token by token, multi-vector models pick up fine-grained domain signals that single-vector models tend to average away, and they respond very well to even modest amounts of in-domain finetuning data.

articles.title: Leveraging Databricks to Support FISC Security Guidelines | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Financial institutions in Japan can configure the Databricks Platform to support requirements from the Japanese Center for Financial Industry Systems (FISC) Security Guidelines.
articles.titleEn: Leveraging Databricks to Support FISC Security Guidelines | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: The FISC Security Guidelines on Computer Systems for Banking and Related Financial Institutions are key to how Japanese financial institutions are expected to manage and secure their IT environments.

Through centralized governance, detailed permissions, and data lineage, teams can enforce controls such as segregation of duties and cybersecurity measures, and integrate with external backup and recovery solutions to protect vital financial information.
The Databricks Platform with Unity Catalog helps Japanese financial institutions implement technical controls that align with the FISC Security Guidelines.

articles.title: Google at the Global Forum on Intellectual Property
articles.descEn: Read remarks from Kent Walker, President of Global Affairs for Google and Alphabet, to the Global Forum on Intellectual Property.
articles.titleEn: Google at the Global Forum on Intellectual Property
summaryLinesEn: According to a recent Oxford Economics report , AI could deliver up to $6 trillion to global GDP over the next 10 years.

New data details how AI could deliver up to $6 trillion to global GDP In the coming months, we’re going to start seeing organizations and companies not just making efficiency gains, but reshaping roles and functions, inventing new products and services, and building long-term competitive advantage.

Countries like India and Indonesia have the most absolute users, while places like Singapore have some of the highest levels of per capita adoption. 29% of AI users in Singapore — versus 12% of AI users in America — are what we call “super users”: The people who can delegate whole tasks, automate daily routines, and use paid models.

summaryLinesEn: We invited Claude.ai users to share how they use AI, what they dream it could make possible, and what they fear it might do.

Nearly 81,000 people participated—the largest and most multilingual qualitative study of its kind.

articles.title: Connect Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to cross-account knowledge bases | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agents in one account can generate answers from an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base backed by Amazon Redshift Serverless in another account, without copying source data. This post covers the architecture, security boundary, and two orchestration models: a code-based Strands agent and a declarative AgentCore harness.
articles.titleEn: Connect Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to cross-account knowledge bases | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases resource policies support Retrieve and GetDocumentContent for cross-account operations.
Organizations often deploy agents using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, a platform to build, connect, and optimize agents at scale, with any framework or model.
If the application only needs retrieved content, evaluate native cross-account Retrieve with a Knowledge Base resource policy.

articles.title: AI cost optimization: How to lower AI spend | Microsoft Azure Blog
articles.descEn: Learn why the request is the atomic unit of AI spend and how you can save money using Microsoft Foundry for runtime optimization.
articles.titleEn: AI cost optimization: How to lower AI spend | Microsoft Azure Blog
summaryLinesEn: Cache reads are billed at a discount to normal input pricing on standard deployments, and can be discounted up to 100% on provisioned deployments.

The Economics of Agent Optimization: Four ways to lower the cost This blog post is the second of a four-part series called The Economics of Agent Optimization which shares the strategies, capabilities, and proof points to help you optimize agent costs and run AI as a managed investment system on Microsoft Foundry.

Large asynchronous workloads such as document processing, classification, and evaluation runs are often best suited for Batch deployments, which provide up to 50% lower costs for work that doesn’t require immediate responses.

summaryLines: 캐시 읽기는 표준 배포의 경우 일반 입력 가격에 비해 할인된 가격으로 청구되며, 프로비저닝된 배포의 경우 최대 100% 할인될 수 있음
에이전트 최적화의 경제학 · 비용을 낮추는 네 가지 방법 이 블로그 게시물은 에이전트 비용을 최적화하고 Microsoft Foundry에서 관리형 투자 시스템으로 AI를 실행하는 데 도움이 되는 전략, 기능 및 입증 포인트를 공유하는 에이전트 최적화의 경제학이라는 4부작 시리즈 중 두 번째임
문서 처리, 분류, 평가 실행과 같은 대규모 비동기 워크로드는 즉각적인 응답이 필요하지 않은 작업에 대해 최대 50% 더 낮은 비용을 제공하는 배치 배포에 가장 적합한 경우가 많음
